# Dune: Awakening is Out Now!

## Publication Date
2025-06-10

### Launch Announcement
Dune: Awakening, a survival MMO game set in the Dune universe, is now available. As players arrive on Arrakis, the world becomes the center of the Known Universe, filled with secrets, powers, and beauty. The game invites players to let the spice flow and explore the vast desert landscape.

### Season Pass and Wildlife of Arrakis DLC
The Season Pass for Dune: Awakening is now available, including the first four DLCs. It is included in the Deluxe and Ultimate Editions. The first DLC, Wildlife of Arrakis, is available now, featuring:

- Sandworm Statue
- Chiroptera Statue
- Kulon Statue
- Muad’Dib Statue

### Twitch Drops and Support a Creator Event
Players can earn exclusive Observer building pieces by tuning into Dune: Awakening streams until June 24th. These pieces include:

- Foundation
- Floor
- Wall

Additional Twitch Drops will be rolled out later with more items. To earn Twitch Drops, follow these steps:

1. Log in to your account page on duneawakening.com/account.
2. Link your Steam account to your Dune account.
3. Link your Twitch account.
4. Watch streams and earn rewards.

The Support a Creator event runs from June 10th to July 8th. Players can earn four pieces of an exclusive Atreides Officer Suit by buying or gifting two subs to any Dune: Awakening content creator.

### Frequently Asked Questions

#### Game Editions
- **Deluxe Edition**: Includes the base game, Sunset Dye Swatch, Season Pass, and Sardaukar Bator Armor.
- **Ultimate Edition**: Includes all Deluxe Edition content plus Dust Rider Swatch, Blue Dasher Swatch, Caladan Palace Building Set, Dune (2021) Film Stillsuit, Digital Artbook, and Digital Soundtrack.

#### Accessing Deluxe and Ultimate Edition Content
- Swatches are available in the in-game item customization menu and can be switched at any time.
- Armors, the Terrarium of Muad’Dib, and the Caladan Palace Building Set are unlocked as schematics and must be crafted.
- The Soundtrack is unlocked as a separate product on Steam.
- The artbook can be found in the game files where Dune: Awakening is installed.

#### Server Information
- **Worlds and Servers**: Every World is a group of servers, allowing players to interact within the same World. Servers in the same World share Social Hubs and the Deep Desert, while the Hagga Basin is specific to each server.
- Detailed server information is available in the server blog.

#### Visiting Friends on Other Servers
Servers can be filtered by location, and players can see which servers their Steam friends are playing on.

title: 2025-06-02-Private Servers Announced
contents:
# Private Servers Announced

## Publication Date: 2025-06-02

### Introduction

On June 2, it was announced that rentable private servers will be available for Dune: Awakening from the head start launch on June 5th. This development comes ahead of the previously communicated post-launch timeline, indicating faster-than-expected progress.

### Unique Server Structure

Dune: Awakening features a distinctive server and world structure, detailed in a recent blog post. Each server is part of a World consisting of multiple servers, sharing social hubs and the Deep Desert. This setup maintains a neighborhood-like feel in the Hagga Basin and supports persistent, freeform building and other server-demanding mechanics typical of survival games. It also integrates large-scale multiplayer mechanics, allowing hundreds of players to interact in social hubs and the Deep Desert for activities such as socializing, trading, and conflict.

### Challenges and Solutions

Transferring this setup to a private server model posed challenges. The developers aimed to preserve the large-scale multiplayer aspects, crucial to the Dune: Awakening experience, without releasing a diminished version for private servers. The solution involved concessions regarding player control over private servers, resulting in fewer settings compared to other survival games like Conan Exiles. This decision ensures the retention of fundamental MMO-like features while allowing players control over server access.

### How Private Servers Work

- **Server Composition**: Renting a private server provides a server containing one Hagga Basin, identical to official servers, with full access to the Hagga Basin map and activities.
- **World Integration**: Private servers belong to a World consisting of other private servers. Players can choose a World for their private server when renting from a provider.
- **Multiplayer Features**: Players can fully utilize Dune: Awakening’s large-scale multiplayer content and mechanics, including visiting social hubs and the Deep Desert to interact with others.

### Conclusion

Players are encouraged to consider the available settings and control options when deciding to rent a private server. This announcement aims to provide clarity and enable informed decision-making regarding the rental of private servers in Dune: Awakening.

#### Composer's Message

Knut Avenstroup Haugen shared his thoughts on composing the soundtrack:

> "Composing the soundtrack for Dune: Awakening has been an epic journey—one that challenged and inspired me in equal measure. I wanted the score to reflect the depth and mystery of the lore, as well as the haunting majesty of Arrakis. The music is rich, colourful, and emotionally resonant. The orchestra—beautifully recorded at AIR Studios—along with synthesizers and a wide array of unique and amazing soloists and instruments, formed the fabric of a score full of contrasts: it’s both intimate and vast, dreamlike and raw. To contribute to the legacy of Dune in this way has been a true adventure—an experience I will always treasure."

The full launch of "Dune: Awakening" is set for June 10th. Players who pre-order the game will receive exclusive in-game items:

# A Message from the Creative Director on PvE and PvP

## Publication Date

2025-06-23

## Introduction

Hello Sleepers,

The Creative Director of "Dune: Awakening" addresses comments regarding the endgame experience, providing context for the game's design intentions.

## PvE and PvP Goals

- The aim is for PvE players to access endgame content without being forced into PvP interactions.
- The core concept revolves around the Deep Desert, an endlessly renewing location resetting weekly, creating a loop for great rewards.
- Players are encouraged to form guilds to navigate the challenges of the Deep Desert.

## Adjustments to the Deep Desert

Due to feedback about the competitive nature of the Deep Desert, adjustments are being made:

- **Partial Warfare (PvE) Areas**:
- Some areas will be flagged for PvE, allowing exploration of testing stations and harvesting T6 resources without unwanted conflict.
- The top tier of the game is balanced around guilds and groups, making solo play potentially grindy.

- **War of Assassins (PvP) Areas**:
- Landsraad control points, shipwrecks, and the largest spice fields will remain PvP flagged.
- The deepest parts of the Deep Desert will continue as high reward, high risk areas.

## Iterative Design and Player Feedback

- The weekly resets and renewals of the Deep Desert allow for experimentation with different layouts and setups.
- Surveys will be sent out to capture player thoughts as changes are implemented.

## PvP Issues and Upcoming Changes

PvP has several issues that need addressing, with initial changes focusing on Scout Ornithopters:

- **Scout Ornithopters**:
- Speed and maneuverability will be reduced for those equipped with rocket launchers.
- Further details on rockets fired are forthcoming.

## Conclusion

The Creative Director emphasizes the importance of player feedback in shaping the endgame experience. Adjustments are ongoing to ensure both PvE and PvP players can enjoy the game according to their preferences.

contents:
# Dune: Awakening 1.1.0.17 Patch Notes

## Publication Date

### June 26, 2025

---

Hey Sleepers,

This hotfix requires a client-side download. Players are reminded to restart their Steam client if the download does not appear automatically. Servers will be coming back up shortly.

For the list of known issues, please visit the Discord server or Steam discussion boards.

## Features and Changes

### Deep Desert

As outlined in "A Message from the Creative Director on PvE and PvP" for Dune: Awakening, this hotfix introduces the first iteration of changes to the balance between PvE and PvP in the Deep Desert. Feedback will continue to be considered for future adjustments.

- **PvE Area Adjustments**:
- The PvE area now encompasses the entire southern half of the Deep Desert map.
- Players uninterested in PvP can find their desired activities without engaging in PvP.
- Imperial Testing Stations, caves, and similar locations in this area are now designated as PvE.

- **PvP Elements**:
- Control Points and Shipwrecks remain PvP across the entire map, creating localized PvP pockets within the PvE section, similar to Shipwrecks in Hagga Basin.

- **Risk vs Reward Setup**:
- Resource density increases further north, including high-density clusters of valuable resources.
- The largest spice fields spawn in the northern region.
- The majority of Control Points are located in the northern part.

### Balancing Adjustments in the Deep Desert

- **PvE Loot**:
- The lower half of the Deep Desert offers PvE loot balanced toward shared loot and PvE activities.
- Better loot can be found in the more dangerous PvP area further north.
- In the PvE area, each player receives their own loot, typically one schematic.
- In the PvP area, loot is distributed on a "first come, first served" basis, with higher quantities, including 2–6 schematics, which are among the rarest.

- **Plasteel Plates**:
- Plasteel plates can be obtained from crashing ships, not just PvP zones.

- **Spice Fields**:
- Active medium spice fields reduced from 8 to 5.
- Active small spice fields increased from 20 to 22.

- **Resource Spawn Rates**:
- Titanium and Stravidium spawn rates reduced in PvE areas, with large quantities only spawning in far-out PvP areas.
- The number of nodes in resource hotspots in the PvE part of the map has been reduced.
- Respawn time for Titanium and Stravidium increased from 30 to 45 minutes.

- **Imperial Testing Stations**:
- Some remain in the PvP region.
- Players seeking all available schematics each week should visit both PvP and PvE Imperial Testing Stations.
- Loot in these stations rotates weekly, allowing players uninterested in PvP to obtain items at a later date if unable to trade or purchase them.

title: 2025-07-09-Developer Update
contents:
# Developer Update

## Publication Date
2025-07-09

### Introduction
Hello Sleepers,

The development team of "Dune: Awakening" begins this update with an apology. On Monday, July 7th, a patch was released that inadvertently altered the layout of the Deep Desert, causing several PvE areas to become PvP enabled. This oversight in the development process and internal communications led to players experiencing significant losses of bases and equipment. The change was intended to occur only with the next Coriolis cycle and should not have impacted the ongoing cycle.

### Apology and Reimbursement
The team expresses deep regret for the incident and acknowledges that it should have been handled better. As a result, internal processes have been revised to prevent future occurrences. Efforts are underway to reimburse affected players for lost vehicles and items. Players can expect to find reimbursed materials, items, and vehicle components in the in-game 'Claim Rewards' tab by the end of the week.

### Moving Forward
As the game approaches the end of its launch phase, the development team addresses ongoing issues:

- **Focus Areas**:
- Removal of identified exploits, including third-party cheat engines, client hacks, and in-game exploitation of mechanics.
- Improvement of game quality, addition of quality-of-life features, and addressing critical gameplay issues.

- **Player Behavior**:
- Zero tolerance for player behavior that negatively impacts others' experiences.
- Encouragement to report cheating or exploitation through available channels.

- **Actions Taken**:
- Several hundred players have been penalized for abusing exploits, cheats, and hacks.
- More waves of bans are anticipated as further culprits are identified.

### Fixed Exploits
The following exploits have been addressed:

- Account/Permission spoofing
- Building Dismantle Item Duplication
- Increased Damage/Insta Kill attacks
- Vehicle Inventory/VBT Item Duplication
- Vehicle Ownership takeover
- Projectile weapon rapid fire (rockets from ornithopters)
- Durability Repair

### Security and Exploit Prevention
A dedicated team is focused on combating hackers and fixing exploits. Upcoming patches will introduce additional security measures:

- Enhanced security on client/server communication layers
- Additional penetration testing against common attack vectors
- Auditing of item and inventory systems to resist item duplication

### Item & Vehicle Loss
The team apologizes for losses of vehicles and resources due to various game bugs. Distinguishing between legitimate item loss due to game mechanics and loss due to bugs is challenging. At launch, the necessary tooling and logging to identify such losses were lacking.

### Conclusion
The development team remains committed to improving "Dune: Awakening" and ensuring an enjoyable experience for all players. They appreciate the community's patience and support as they work to resolve these issues.

# Developer Update – Roadmap and Future Plans

## Publication Date
2025-08-19

---

### Introduction

On August 19, the developers of *Dune: Awakening*, a survival MMO game based on the Dune universe, released a comprehensive update detailing their roadmap and future plans. This update aims to address both short-term and long-term goals while improving communication with the community.

### Communication and Development Challenges

The developers acknowledge previous communication gaps regarding game issues and commit to enhancing this aspect. Due to a portion of the team being on state-mandated vacations, customer service and community teams have faced challenges accessing developers for immediate responses.

During July, efforts were concentrated on resolving bugs, cheats, and exploits. Thousands of cheaters were banned, and numerous duplication and exploit bugs were fixed. The team is working towards a patch cadence that balances stability and speed, ensuring issues like exploits are addressed promptly.

### Upcoming Content at Gamescom

At Gamescom, the developers will discuss the Chapter 2 Free Update and The Lost Harvest DLC, marking the first major additions to the game. These updates will release concurrently. Although Chapter 2 and the DLC introduce new content and cosmetics, they do not focus on endgame content as their development began prior to the game's launch.

### Roadmap Overview

The roadmap outlines both free updates and paid DLCs planned for the near future, alongside the monthly development cycle addressing player feedback, bugs, and cheats. While the monthly cadence is not always achieved, it provides insight into the development approach.

### Upcoming Features and Quality of Life Improvements

The developers will soon share more details about major content and features in Chapter 2 and the DLC. Quality of life improvements include:

- Ability to rename vehicles, storage containers, and other placeables
- More reliable ornithopter rockets for combat enthusiasts
- Option to swap seats in a vehicle with a hotkey

These features will be available for testing on the Public Test Client soon.

### Endgame Content and Player Feedback

Recent changes to the Deep Desert formula have attracted diverse demographics, each with unique requests. Core issues identified include:

- Loss of items/vehicles
- Players feeling forced into PvP
- Exploits and cheats
- Lack of endgame content/grind

Short-term solutions to address these issues are underway, with heavily requested changes coming soon, such as improved player logging.

---

This update reflects the developers' commitment to enhancing *Dune: Awakening* and addressing community concerns while planning for future content and improvements.

### Membership

Recruitment is open to all interested players. The guild operates on PC and communicates primarily in English, accommodating players in GMT and CET timezones. Activities include exploration, story-driven events, and light roleplaying in both PvP and PvE settings.

The guild engages in both PvE and PvP activities, with a focus on light roleplaying. It is affiliated with the Major House Atreides.

## Purpose / Ethos

The Silver Sisters is a European-based guild founded on inclusion, storytelling, and community-led gameplay. Inspired by the Bene Gesserit, the guild combines casual light roleplay with relaxed PvX gameplay on the Selene server (Sietch Fajr). It welcomes players interested in exploring Dune: Awakening at their own pace through activities like base-building, trading, exploration, light RP scenes, or friendly combat. The guild values atmosphere over min-maxing and connection over control, aiming to create a story-driven environment.

## Recruitment Process

Joining the Silver Sisters is straightforward. Players can find the guild in-game on Selene / Sietch Fajr or introduce themselves in the #general Discord channel. There are no trials or lengthy applications—just mutual respect and a shared love for the Dune world. Newcomers receive the **@Acolyte** role until they are settled.

## Ranks / Hierarchy

- **Reverend Mother** – Guild Lead: Manages Discord, oversees recruitment, sets direction, and has the final say on disputes.
- **Mother Superior** – Officer: Assists with recruitment, events, moderation, and supports guild stability.
- **Proctor Superior** – Event Coordinator / Mission Lead: Organizes in-game expeditions, PvP operations, and helps players learn game systems.
- **Truthsayer** – Community Support: Moderates chat, welcomes newcomers, and supports RP-lite scenes.
- **Sister** – Full Member: Active, trusted guildmate with input into decisions and events.
- **Acolyte** – New Member: New to the guild or Dune, learning the ropes with friendly guidance.
- **Desert Friend** – Ally Role: Given to trusted players who aren’t part of the guild but often play with us.

## Leadership

Silver Sisters leadership is collaborative. While the Reverend Mother makes final decisions when necessary, active members are involved in shaping guild policy, events, and direction. Officers and Proctors coordinate roles based on real-world availability and interest.

## Guild Lore

The Silver Sisters are inspired by the secretive desert offshoots of the Bene Gesserit, choosing freedom and vision over control. Although RP is not enforced, the guild's story serves as a backdrop for immersive gameplay, portraying members as nomads, traders, advisors, and seers navigating the ever-changing dunes. This thematic structure supports a shared identity without requiring players to act a part, respecting real-world time and headspace.

## Alliances & Diplomacy

- **Neutral / Cooperative:** The guild welcomes cooperation and trade with other guilds and individuals.
- **No Forced PvP:** Preferring consensual combat, the guild avoids random griefing or ganking.
- **Event Partnerships Welcome:** Open to co-running story events, desert excursions, or joint RP operations.

## Community Events

- **Desert Excursions:** Exploration missions with light RP and resource goals.
- **Campfire Nights:** Chill social evenings with storytelling and music.
- **Combat Drills:** Friendly PvP with a narrative twist.
- **Mentor Pairings:** Experienced players helping newcomers learn the game.

## External Engagement

The Silver Sisters contribute to the broader Dune community through storytelling and light RP events, supporting an inclusive and welcoming server culture, and collaborating with other guilds for non-toxic, lore-respecting gameplay.

## Contact

To join or learn more, visit the guild's website at www.silversisters.org.

### Guild Summary

The House of Oona is a player guild established on August 25, 2024, with over 100 members. It operates primarily as a mercenary group and is open for recruitment. The guild is based on the PC platform and conducts activities in English, primarily within the EST timezone. It engages in both PVE and PVP, and role-playing is a significant aspect of its operations. The guild is aligned with the major house, Harkonnen.

### The House of Oona the Water Witch

#### Oona the Enchantress: A Detailed Backstory

Oona was born into the infamous Tuek family, known for their smuggling and illicit activities across the galaxy. As the granddaughter of Esmar Tuek, she inherited the family's trade and reputation for cunning and ruthlessness. From a young age, Oona was immersed in subterfuge, mastering stealth, negotiation, and combat.

Her mother, a key figure in the Bene Gesserit sisterhood, recognized Oona's potential and ensured she received rigorous training in their secretive ways. This included honing her physical abilities, mastering the Voice, and developing her mental acuity to manipulate and influence others.

Tragedy struck when Oona's parents were betrayed and murdered by a rival smuggling faction, leaving her to fend for herself. Driven by revenge, Oona used her Bene Gesserit training and her family's network to rise to power, systematically eliminating her enemies and expanding her influence.

Despite facing assassination attempts, betrayals, and internal power struggles, Oona's strategic mind and fierce determination allowed her to overcome obstacles. Her reputation for extreme cruelty ensured swift and brutal ends for those who opposed her.

Oona established The House of Oona the Water Witch, a formidable guild feared and respected throughout the galaxy. Her alliance with House Harkonnen further strengthened her position, leveraging their resources and influence to achieve her ambitions.

Oona's loyalty to House Harkonnen is both strategic and personal, sharing a mutual understanding with Baron Vladimir Harkonnen. This alliance has led to numerous successful operations, cementing Oona's reputation as a master of the dark arts.

Despite her fearsome reputation, Oona is a shrewd and calculating leader who values loyalty above all else. Her followers revere her for her strategic brilliance and unwavering commitment to their cause.

### Purpose / Ethos

The House of Oona the Water Witch operates in the shadows, leveraging smuggling, assassination, and subterfuge. Members are bound by a strict code of loyalty and fear, trained to master manipulation, deception, and combat. The guild's ethos centers around the unyielding strength and authority of Oona the Enchantress, who commands her followers with an iron fist.

### Recruitment Process

Recruitment into The House of Oona the Water Witch involves surviving grueling trials testing physical endurance, mental fortitude, and loyalty. Only those demonstrating unwavering dedication and embracing the guild's ruthless methods are welcomed. Initiation rituals are secretive, and recruits are sworn to silence regarding the guild's inner workings. Initiation begins after accepting the Discord invite.

### Ranks/Hierarchy

The guild follows a rigid hierarchy:

- **Grand Enchantress:** Oona the Enchantress, the supreme leader.
- **High Council of Shadows:** Trusted members advising and executing commands.
- **Masters of Deception:** Elite operatives training recruits and overseeing missions.
- **Agents of the Dark Arts:** Skilled assassins and spies for clandestine operations.
- **Apprentices:** New recruits undergoing training and proving loyalty.

### Leadership

Oona the Water Witch, granddaughter of Esmar Tuek, is a formidable leader commanding fear and respect. Trained as a Bene Gesserit, she possesses exceptional combat skills, psychic abilities, and strategic acumen. Her reputation for extreme cruelty ensures absolute loyalty from followers.

### Guild Lore

The House of Oona the Water Witch traces its origins to Esmar Tuek, a notorious smuggler. Oona embraced her heritage, forming the guild to continue her family's tradition of smuggling and subterfuge. Under her leadership, the guild has flourished, gaining a fearsome reputation across the galaxy. Stories of Oona's cunning and cruelty are legendary, striking fear into her enemies.

### Known Allegiances or Rivalries

**Allegiance:** The guild is aligned with House Harkonnen, based on mutual interests in power and control, employing ruthless tactics.

**Rivalries:** The guild maintains rivalries with factions opposing House Harkonnen or threatening Oona's authority, including the Atreides and dissenting Bene Gesserit.

# Ethorium

**Categories:** Player Guild

## Information

**Founded:** February 1, 2019

**Members:** 290

**Website:** https://ethorium.de/

**Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/ethoriumgaming.de/

**YouTube:** https://www.youtube.com/@Ethorium

**Reddit:** r/Ethorium

## Overview

Ethorium is a guild founded on February 1, 2019, with 290 members. The guild focuses on exploration, trading, building, and combat. Recruitment is open, and it operates on PC, Xbox, and Playstation platforms. The primary language is German, and it operates in the CET time zone. Ethorium engages in PVE, PVP, and RP activities and is affiliated with House Atreides.

## Purpose / Ethos

Ethorium is a community of strategists, thinkers, and creators. Amidst the political intrigues, desert dangers, and power plays of Dune, the guild seeks not just survival but influence, depth, and permanence.

The strength of Ethorium lies in coordination, and its will in growth. Loyalty, foresight, and creativity define its actions both in the field and in dialogue. The guild believes in community, not blind obedience, and in development, not stagnation.

Whether in the shadows of the Great Houses or in the free play between powers, Ethorium forges its own path. It observes, analyzes, and acts decisively when it matters.

## Recruitment Process

Ethorium welcomes new members, especially those who think, contribute, and truly want to be part of a team.

The recruitment process begins with a conversation where you introduce yourself and get to know the guild. Ethorium values not just skills or playtime but whether you fit into the team both personally and strategically.

More important than your rank is your attitude: team spirit, initiative, and the desire to create something together. If these align, you are a good fit for Ethorium.

## Ranks/Hierarchy

1. **Archon**
- Archons form the leadership of Ethorium. They set the strategic direction, make high-level decisions, and uphold the guild's vision and values. They coordinate major operations, diplomacy, and the long-term direction of the house.

2. **Strategos**
- Strategoi are officers serving Ethorium. They lead troops in strategic conflicts, coordinate construction and infrastructure projects, and actively contribute to the guild's expansion. Strategoi are authorized to recruit, induct new members, and make operational decisions both in the field and in development.

3. **Initiate**
- As an Initiate, you join House Ethorium. You learn the guild's processes, play style, and philosophy. From the start, you are part of the team, with room to develop and take on responsibility.

## Leadership

Leadership in Ethorium is about responsibility, not control. Archons lead the guild with foresight, clarity, and a willingness to listen. They set impulses, create structures, and maintain the course, always in dialogue with the community.

They are supported by Strategoi, experienced members who lead operationally, make field decisions, recruit, and take on responsibility. Together, they form a network of leadership and trust, not command and obedience.

Ethorium's leadership style is clear, cooperative, and goal-oriented. The guild believes in strength through structure and freedom through participation.

## Guild Lore

Ethorium was founded in the shadows of great houses and ancient bloodlines, not out of greed for power but out of conviction. Established by outcasts, visionaries, and strategists, Ethorium grew away from old paths, unbound but not aimless.

Ethorium is not a house in the traditional sense, nor nobility or a corporation. It is a network, grown through alliances, strengthened by knowledge, united by shared principles. Where others rely on bloodlines, Ethorium relies on loyalty, foresight, and clear structures.

In the political entanglements of the empire, Ethorium acts quietly but effectively. It observes, decides, and when the moment comes, acts with precision.

Ethorium is more than a guild; it is an attitude.

## Known Allegiances or Rivalries

Ethorium operates independently but not in isolation. It forms alliances with organizations that share its values: structure, strategy, and respect. Titles or size do not matter, but reliability in action does.

Ethorium's alliances are built on trust, not expediency. The guild stands by its partners as long as principles are upheld.

Rivalries arise when others resort to oppression, chaos, or power demonstrations. Ethorium responds not impulsively but consistently. It does not engage in open warfare but does not forget those who challenge it.

In the game of houses, Ethorium keeps an overview and, if necessary, makes the first move.

## Other Activities

Beyond strategy, diplomacy, and warfare, Ethorium offers space for more. It promotes creative thinking, economic development, and social interaction. Whether infrastructure planning, resource trading, roleplay, or internal events, those who want to contribute will find a stage.

Ethorium believes that a strong community is built not only in battle but also in collaboration. It supports projects that go beyond the game, from lore writing to organizing joint actions.

Ethorium is more than a guild; it is part of a community that stands for collaboration, creativity, and sustainable structures. What begins in Dune is embedded in a larger whole: a multi-gaming-oriented platform where ideas grow, projects emerge, and people can contribute, whether in FiveM, Star Citizen, Minecraft, or here on Arrakis.

Ethorium believes in long-term community rather than short-term hype. It values not just what you play but how you think, act, and contribute. Ethorium connects players who want more than just the next battle.

Here, friendships, game worlds, and stories that endure are created.

The Assault Ornithopter is a four-seated aerial vehicle. It cannot be stored in the Vehicle Backup Tool, but as an aerial vehicle, it can be used to travel to the Overland Map. It can be fitted with a booster and optional upgrades for storage or combat. All six wings must be of the same tier, but other components can be mixed across different tiers.

## Guild Lore

**The Fremen Dune Guild Shai-hulud’s Will Origins**

Founded by Draleb, a legendary Fremen warrior, Shai-hulud’s Will emerged from conflict. Draleb's encounter with a sandworm led to a vision of Arrakis' past, present, and future, recognizing sandworms as divine arbiters. This vision inspired him to lead his people to victory, establishing the guild as a spiritual and martial order dedicated to Shai-Hulud’s will.

**Purpose**

The guild serves as the guardian of Arrakis, blending spiritual reverence for Shai-Hulud with a mission to defend the desert. They interpret the sandworms’ actions as divine commands to combat threats and ensure the Fremen thrive through sustainable spice harvesting and martial dominance.

**Structure**

- **Initiates:** Recruits trained in desert survival, combat, and the ways of Shai-Hulud.
- **Adepts:** Elite worm riders and warriors skilled in guerrilla tactics and sacred rituals.
- **Masters:** Veteran commanders leading in battle, training fighters, and interpreting spice visions.
- **Council of Elders:** Strategic leaders with a direct connection to Shai-Hulud, guiding the guild in conflict.

**Practices**

Guild members engage in the Spice Trance, revealing Shai-Hulud’s battle plans through visions. They perform War Consecrations, blessing weapons and armor before combat, and hold ceremonies to honor fallen warriors and sanctify spice harvests.

**Skills**

- **Worm Riding:** Using sandworms as siege engines.
- **Combat:** Mastery of crysknives, ranged weapons, and hand-to-hand fighting.
- **Guerrilla Warfare:** Expertise in ambushes and desert traps.
- **Desert Mastery:** Utilizing Arrakis’ terrain to outmaneuver invaders.

**Beliefs**

Shai-Hulud is seen as the divine embodiment of war and justice. The guild believes that through battle, they honor the sandworms and secure Arrakis’ future, envisioning a paradise won through blood and faith.

**Secrets**

The guild guards ancient texts suggesting sandworms were engineered as weapons by a forgotten civilization, fueling their conviction to reclaim Arrakis as a fortress world.

**Role in Fremen Society**

The guild leads tribes into battle, trains warriors, and advises on defense and strategy, rallying the people as holy warriors.

**Challenges**

External threats from off-world powers and internal tensions between militant factions test the guild’s strength and unity.

**The Legend of the First Warrior**

Draleb’s tale is central to the guild's identity. His vision and leadership turned the desert into a graveyard for invaders, proving the guild’s destiny as protectors of Arrakis.

**Triumph Over Adversity:**
- Farewell to gear fear.
- Thrive on the thrill of the fight and level the playing field.

**Team Before Self:**
- Teamwork makes the dreamwork.
- It's a we angle, not a me angle. Be respected and empowered.

**United as One:**
- No tangled alliances or the shadow of drama.
- Together, we are The Opposing Force, bound by common purpose, paving our own path.

Embrace the challenge, defy the odds, and be part of a community where camaraderie triumphs over conflict.

OP4S consists of a tight-knit group that has conquered multiple games together since 2019. The community functions as a senate of Directors, allowing influential members to rise and lead. Bright, energetic individuals are welcomed to build, fight, and grow with OP4S.

Established in 2019, OP4S (pronounced 'OP FORCE') was founded on the belief that the only constraints are the mental barriers we create. The community aims to transcend average experiences, offering benefits and fostering a strong community.

- Understands real-life commitments while maintaining competitiveness.

# House Tseida

**Categories:** Pages including data maps, Landsraad, Major Houses

## Content

House Tseida is one of the Major Houses of The Landsraad. Players can interact with them, complete weekly objectives, and earn rewards.

## House Lore

House Tseida is a Major House of the Landsraad, known for its peculiar nature. Governed by the Tseidan royal family, their trade specialty is Imperial Legal expertise. They have a dedicated Minor House, House Ikeni, which serves as their legal defense. House Tseida is a staunch supporter of Butlerian law, a stance they have maintained for several hundred years, dating back to the time of Duke Aramis Atreides. Despite their long-standing beliefs, their rapid rise to power suggests recent developments. Their envoy, Amadi Ikeni, is stationed at The Anvil Trading Post to monitor the interactions between Atreides and Harkonnen Lieutenants and gather any evidence of imperial law breaches.

## House Rewards

Contributing 14,000 points in the Landsraad for House Tseida allows players to claim the House Tseida Heavy Armour Swatch from the House Envoy. Currently, this is the only reward available for this House.

- The color swatch for House Tseida.
- A full set of the Atreides heavy armor variant with the House Tseida swatch applied.

## Envoy Location

The House Tseida Envoy, Amadi Ikeni, is located in Hagga Basin at The Anvil.

### Envoy Dialogue

**First Meeting:**

- **AMADI IKENI:** Someone new? Are you, by chance, looking for banter or legal advice?

**Afterwards:**

- **AMADI IKENI:** I presume you have some business with me or with House Tseida.

- **PLAYER:** Tell me about yourself.
- **AMADI IKENI:** You may call me Amadi Ikeni. I serve the interests of House Tseida on Arrakis. I am from the Minor House of Ikeni.

- **PLAYER:** Tell me more about House Ikeni.
- **AMADI IKENI:** We are a Tseida House Minor, specializing in Imperial law related to the governance of Houses and nobility conduct. We defend the Tseidan name.

- **PLAYER:** An entire Minor House devoted to one's legal defense. Seems peculiar.
- **AMADI IKENI:** Many find House Tseida peculiar, certainly the least conventional of the Great Houses. Is there anything else you'd like to know about me?

- **PLAYER:** Why set up shop in the Anvil?
- **AMADI IKENI:** The Anvil is a unique melting pot where enemies gather. Certain inquiries on behalf of my House keep me here. It's a fine place to offer legal advice, where even the most aggrieved parties must remain civil. Atreides and Harkonnen officers often argue over Kanly law here.

- **PLAYER:** Not at this time.
- **AMADI IKENI:** Very well.

- **PLAYER:** Sounds like a very focused existence.
- **AMADI IKENI:** In a chaotic universe, focus is truly a blessing. Is there anything else you'd like to know about me?

- **PLAYER:** Tell me more about House Tseida.
- **AMADI IKENI:** Many see Tseida as the least conventional of the Great Houses. We were staunch supporters of the Butlerian Jihad. Some say we arose from a fanatical theocratic regime, but these are the words of the unenlightened. Our rapid rise in power has caused envy among other houses.

- **PLAYER:** What was the consequence of this supposed envy?
- **AMADI IKENI:** Several Houses formed an anti-Tseidan league, spreading malicious propaganda that haunts us to this day. However, we continue to lead in legal consultation in the Empire, from Landsraad ordeals to spacing regulations. Our expertise is sought for criminal proceedings, kanly disputes, and Butlerian infractions.

- **PLAYER[HONORABLE]:** If I recall my history, Duke Aramis Atreides spoke up for House Tseida.
- **AMADI IKENI:** Correct. He said, "Such was the splendor of the risen phoenix that lesser birds could naught but call and hoot for all their plainness." Despite the propaganda, we remain leaders in legal consultation.

# Sandwalking Community Podcast

**Categories:** PreBeta, Community

## Content

The Sandwalking Community Podcast is a series of video podcasts hosted by Maegan, also known as DeadWoman Walking Gaming (DWW), a long-time Funcom partnered streamer. The cover art for the podcast is created by FailRogue.

## Episodes

### Episode 1

The first episode aired on January 30, 2025, at 16:00 UTC, featuring Stephen, known as FlamingMojo, as guest co-host. The hosts reviewed footage from a press and creator recording session at the Funcom office. With written approval, they disclosed their status as veteran Closed Beta testers, collectively having 2500 hours of playtime in the tests. The podcast covered the following topics:

#### Intro

DWW and Mojo revealed their participation in the beta, with 900 and 1600 hours of gameplay respectively. They outlined ground rules regarding what they could discuss:

**Can discuss:**

- Content shown in the videos
- The current state of the game
- Their beta participation and playtime

**Cannot discuss:**

- Specifics of personal beta experiences due to NDA
- Details about previous beta tests or timelines
- Story spoilers beyond what is shown in the videos

They reminded listeners that the game is still in beta, meaning changes are possible, and advised against messaging anyone involved in the test due to NDA restrictions.

#### Worm Video

- Explanation of the Sandworm threat, including multi-stage aggression and anti-exploit mechanics
- Details on Thumpers, which are crafted and not too expensive

#### Eco Lab Video

- Description of Testing Station #002 in the Hagga Basin south starting area
- Use of colored ID bands and penta shield barriers as a key-and-lock mechanism
- Combat demonstration using Mentat skills, including shield barriers, poison gas capsules, turrets, and the Exploit Weakness technique
- Overview of loot rooms, types of loot containers, and available water taps
- Recordings that narrate the story of the testing station, including Ixian shipments and scavengers
- Presentation of a secret room and its art direction, featuring Sandtrout in the floor
- Explanation of emotes and their functionality
- Details of the boss fight, including shield combat, poison attacks, and DBNO (Down But Not Out)
- Information on loot, including schematics, uniques, old imperial, great house, and fremen items
- Use of ID bands for exiting, providing a one-way quality of life improvement

#### Shipwreck

- Overview of resources in the world, such as ores, fuel cells, plant fiber, and wrecked thopters
- Explanation of the Wreck of the Alcyon and its environmental storytelling
- Description of cuttable doors leading to loot rooms or required paths
- Note that this area is normally PvP, but not in the starting zone, hence no end boss
- Mention of explosive barrels

### Episode 2

The second episode aired on February 21, 2025, at 19:00 UTC, featuring Funcom Community Manager Iggy as a guest host. The podcast covered the following topics:

#### Intro

DWW and Mojo provided a refresher on their beta participation and reiterated the NDA rules. Funcom Community Manager Iggy was introduced as a guest host.

#### Trial of Aql Video

Discussion of a video showcasing the first Trial of Aql:

- Early game setting in Hagga Basin South
- Visual storytelling through Fremen architecture and hidden caverns
- Changes in ambiance, sound, and music
- PSA on the dangers of faceplanting in a bowl of drugs at an abandoned cave altar
- Exploration of Spice Visions and the role of Spice in Dune
- How developers brought the universe of the books to life through the Fremen's Journey
- Accessibility for lore-agnostic survival gamers while offering depth for hardcore Dune fans

#### Fanart Submissions

A gallery of submitted fanart is planned, pending artists' permission.

#### Beauty of Arrakis Video

Discussion of the Beauty of Arrakis video:

- Appreciation of the game's visual beauty
- Confirmation of sand and rocks in the game
- Challenges during development, which began before Denis Villeneuve's movies were in production
- Public expectations set high by Hans Zimmer's music, with gradual acceptance of the game's soundtrack
- Addressing baseless accusations against FlamingMojo regarding harm to desert mice

### Episode 3

The third episode has yet to be announced. Stay tuned for updates. The podcast will stream live on Maegan's YouTube and Twitch channels, with VOD available afterward.

## Content

The Unbroken Fedaykin are warriors forged in the harshest sands of Arrakis. Bound by survival, strength, and loyalty, they strike swiftly and silently, never bowing to any ruler or empire. Their code is simple: endure, fight, and protect their freedom, no matter the cost.

### Guild Summary

The Unbroken Fedaykin focus on survival, combat mastery, and desert exploration. They are skilled in guerrilla warfare, stealth operations, and Crysknife crafting. Their activities include raiding, ambushing, resource gathering, and territory defense. They are open to recruitment and communicate primarily in English. The guild engages in both PVE and PVP, maintaining a neutral stance towards major houses.

### Purpose / Ethos

The Unbroken Fedaykin thrive in both PVP and PVE environments, focusing on survival, combat, and proving their strength. Their ethos makes them formidable opponents and deadly allies.

- **PVP (Player vs Player):** Skilled in ambushes, guerrilla tactics, and desert warfare, they strike quickly and disappear into the dunes. They utilize the harsh desert terrain to their advantage, relying on surprise and overwhelming force to defeat enemies.

- **PVE (Player vs Environment):** As desert guardians, they focus on survival, scavenging, and protecting their strongholds. They excel in tracking resources, hunting sandworms, and dealing with hostile wildlife. Their quest style includes completing dangerous missions and gathering critical resources to ensure their continued survival.

## Recruitment Process

### Recruitment Process of The Unbroken Fedaykin

To join the Unbroken Fedaykin, one must prove themselves worthy through a series of trials:

1. **The Call to the Sand:** Seek out the Unbroken or be found by them. Survival in the desert is the first step.

2. **The Trial of the Storm:** Survive the desert with no tools or resources. Only those who return victorious earn the right to join.

3. **The Mark of the Unbroken:** After surviving, undergo a sacred ritual to receive the Unbroken’s tattoo, marking you as one of them.

4. **Prove Your Loyalty:** New members are tested, trained, and given tasks to prove their worth, aiming to rise in the ranks.

## Ranks/Hierarchy

1. **Sfantul, the Unbroken - The First Blade, the Stormwalker:** Founder and supreme leader, Sfantul's vision shapes the faction's path. His leadership is respected and earned through strength and wisdom.

2. **Naib-Fedaykin - The Chosen Blades:** High commanders and advisors, responsible for leading in the field and maintaining order.

3. **Sayyid Blades - The Silent Fangs:** Elite assassins and duelists, experts in stealth and critical operations.

4. **Sietch Wardens - Keepers of the Hidden Strongholds:** Protectors of safehouses and resources, ensuring the faction's survival.

5. **Sandborn - Those Who Walk the Storm:** Initiates and warriors in training, proving their worth in combat and survival.

6. **The Desert Dwellers - The Unbroken’s Allies and Supporters:** Outsiders who share the faction’s goals, respected for their skills and survival instincts.

### The Unbroken Code

The Unbroken Fedaykin adhere to a code that stresses survival, loyalty to the desert, and the pursuit of independence. Leadership is earned through action and strength, not titles or lineage.

## Leadership

### Leadership of The Unbroken Fedaykin

Leadership is defined by strength, wisdom, and survival ability. Sfantul, the founder, leads by example, embodying the philosophy of strength through survival. The Naib-Fedaykin, Sayyid Blades, and Sietch Wardens each play crucial roles in maintaining the faction's integrity and purpose.

## Guild Lore

### The Fall of the Old Order

The Fedaykin were once elite warriors among the Fremen, but with the collapse of the old powers, they were scattered and betrayed. The name Fedaykin became a legend.

### The Birth of the Unbroken

Sfantul, a survivor of the Fedaykin’s fall, gathered outcasts to form a new brotherhood. The Unbroken Fedaykin were born from a vow to never serve another empire and to remain unyielding.

## Other Activities

- **Sandworm Hunting:** Track and hunt sandworms for valuable materials.
- **Stealth Missions:** Conduct covert operations and gather intelligence.
- **Survival Expeditions:** Scout uncharted areas and survive extreme conditions.
- **Scouting:** Gather information on potential threats and resources.
- **Training New Recruits:** Mentor initiates in survival and combat techniques.

The Unbroken Fedaykin are bound by the desert and their unwavering will. They thrive in harsh environments, united by their shared will to endure. Their battles are for survival, and their raids are for sustenance. They seek freedom to live on their own terms, standing as a brotherhood in the unforgiving sands of Arrakis.

## Livestream #1 - 24th March 2025

The first livestream aired on 24th March 2025, focusing on live gameplay, Funcom's business model for Dune: Awakening, and the making of its soundtrack. Commentary was provided by guests, including an interview with Knut Avenstroup Haugen and several members of the development team. The interview was hosted by Tascha Röösli, Global Senior PR at Funcom.

### Exploring Arrakis

#### Gameplay Mechanics

The gameplay segment highlighted various mechanics that players can expect:

**Exploration and Resource Gathering**
- Players can scan for resources using a scanning module.
- Climbing to high peaks allows for surveying large areas.
- Tools like the Shiga Wire Claw and Suspensor Belt aid in traversing difficult terrain.

**Crafting and Building**
- Players can craft shelters and vehicles, enhancing their survival chances.
- The game features a contract system for quests, allowing players to earn rewards.

**Dynamic Events**
- Sandstorms: These storms can change the landscape and reveal new resources.
- Dynamic Encounters: Players may encounter NPCs or other players while exploring.

**Combat**
- Players can engage in combat with various factions, utilizing a range of weapons and tactics.
- The game features a shield mechanic that adds depth to combat strategies.

#### World Design

The world of Arrakis is designed with verticality and diverse biomes to avoid monotony. Jeff G, the World Director, emphasized the importance of creating an engaging environment that is not just flat desert but filled with rock formations and varied landscapes.

**Notable Locations**
- Trade Posts: Neutral zones where players can interact with NPCs and accept contracts.
- Camps: Different factions inhabit various camps, each with unique aesthetics and challenges.

**Environmental Hazards**
Players must navigate various hazards, including:
- Sandworms: Territorial creatures that react to vibrations in the sand.
- Radiation Zones: Areas that pose risks to players if not approached carefully.

### Live Gameplay and Commentary

### Soundtrack Behind-The-Scenes

### Audio and Soundtrack Discussion

The audio design is a crucial aspect of Dune Awakening, enhancing the immersive experience. The soundtrack was recorded at the prestigious Air Studios in London, featuring a blend of orchestral and synthesized elements.

- **Adaptive Music**: The music changes dynamically based on gameplay events, enhancing emotional engagement.

#3 - 29th April 2025

The third episode aired on 29th April 2025, hosted by Tascha Röösli, which focused on building in Dune: Awakening. Funcom also held giveaways for copies of Dune: Awakening. In this stream, Funcom dove into Dune: Awakening’s in-depth building and crafting mechanics as well as the Exchange and the Landsraad system.

### Base Building

- **Base Construction**: Players can build bases alone or collaboratively, with unique architecture reflecting allegiance to one of the warring great houses.
- **Customization**: Bases can be customized using unique building pieces from different factions, such as the Atreides and Harkonnen.
- **Blueprint System**: Players can record their creations as blueprints, which can be shared, bought, or sold on the exchange.
- **Building Restrictions**: Players must adhere to certain restrictions to maintain game balance and performance.

### Narrative and Story

- **Alternate Timeline**: The game features an alternate timeline where key events differ from the original Dune lore, allowing for player agency and dynamic storytelling.
- **Character Interactions**: Players will encounter familiar characters, some of whom are still alive due to the alternate timeline.
- **Player Backgrounds**: Players can choose their character's background, influencing their starting abilities and interactions with NPCs.

### The Exchange System

- **Auction House**: The exchange functions as an auction house where players can buy and sell items, including blueprints and resources.
- **Dynamic Economy**: Players can engage in various economic activities, such as crafting and surveying, to contribute to the game's economy.
- **Surveying**: Players can survey areas to create sync charts, which can be sold to other players, enhancing the exploration aspect of the game.

### Landsraad System

- **Political Influence**: Players can participate in the launch rod system, which allows them to influence the game's political landscape by aligning with factions and completing tasks.
- **Voting Mechanics**: Players can earn votes for their faction by completing tasks, which can lead to powerful decrees that affect the entire game world.
- **Faction Dynamics**: The system encourages competition and collaboration among players, fostering a sense of community and strategy.

### Blueprint System

- **Base Construction**: Players can build bases that provide safety from environmental hazards like sandstorms.
- **Customization**: Bases can be personalized with unique architectural styles based on faction allegiance.
- **Collaboration**: Players can work together to design and build bases, sharing resources and blueprints.

### Q&A Session Highlights

- **Access Levels**: Players can set permissions for their bases, allowing friends or guild members to access specific areas or resources.
- **Base Movement**: Players cannot move entire bases but can copy designs to replicate them elsewhere.
- **Taxation System**: Players must pay taxes every two weeks to maintain their bases and avoid decay.
- **Faction Dynamics**: The game encourages competition and collaboration among factions, with systems in place to prevent one faction from dominating.

## Livestream #4 - 28th May 2025

The fourth episode aired on 28th May 2025. In the final developer live stream before the launch of Dune Awakening, the team shared insights into the game’s mechanics, mid and end-game content, and the overall vision for the game. Hosted by Natasha, the stream featured key developers Joel Boss and Scott Junior, who discussed the game’s combat system, exploration, and player interactions in the vast world of Arrakis.

### Combat Mechanics

- **Combat System**: A blend of melee, ranged abilities, and vehicles.
- **Melee Combat**: Players can stagger opponents and exploit weaknesses using different weapons like swords and daggers.
- **Ranged Combat**: Weapons like the pistol allow players to maintain distance, while specialized weapons can counteract enemy shields.
- **Abilities**: Players can harness unique abilities to turn the tide of battle, such as the Voice to manipulate enemies or Bindu Dash for quick movement.
- **Tactical Options**: Players can develop unique combat styles as they progress.
- **Holtzman Shields**: Introduce strategic depth, requiring players to adapt their combat strategies.
- **Abilities**: Various classes (e.g., Sword Masters, Troopers, Bene Gesserit) offer unique combat techniques.

### Mid and End-Game Content

- **Hagga Basin**: A key area for mid-game exploration and resource gathering.
- **Deep Desert**: The end-game zone where players face greater challenges and opportunities.
- **Social Hubs**: Locations for player interaction, trading, and faction alignment.

### Player Interaction and Factions

- Players can align with factions (Atreides or Harkonnen) to gain unique benefits and participate in the Landsraad council.
- The Landsraad influences the game world, allowing players to vote on decrees that affect gameplay.
- Faction alignment is crucial for participating in the Landsraad and accessing certain content.

### Resource Management

- **Spice**: The most valuable resource, essential for crafting high-tier gear and items. Players must venture into the deep desert to gather spice, facing environmental hazards and other players.
- **Crafting**: Players can create vehicles, weapons, and gear using resources collected throughout the game.

### Exploration and Discovery

- The game features a dynamic world with changing landscapes and hidden treasures.
- Players can discover unique locations, such as shipwrecks and ecological labs, which offer valuable resources and lore.
- **Sync Charts**: Players can create maps to reveal parts of the world, aiding exploration and resource gathering.

### PvP and Raiding Mechanics

- PvP is optional, with players able to choose their level of engagement.
- Bases in Hagga Basin are safe from raids, while those in the deep desert have vulnerability windows for potential raiding.
- Players can lose resources in PvP but not their gear unless specific decrees are in effect.

### Community and Player Dynamics

- The game encourages cooperation among players, with opportunities for guilds to work together on objectives.
- Players can trade resources and gear, fostering a sense of community.
- The developers aim to create a balanced environment where players can thrive, regardless of their playstyle.

### Future Updates and Content

- The team plans to release regular updates, expanding the game world and introducing new content.
- Players can expect new storylines, quests, and gameplay mechanics post-launch.
- The developers are committed to listening to player feedback to improve the game continuously.

It operates primarily on PC and communicates in English, accommodating members in the EST and MST timezones. The guild maintains a neutral stance among the major houses and is active in role-playing (RP) activities.

### Purpose / Ethos

**The Code of the Unbowed**

- In the shadow of oppression, we found our strength.
- In the crucible of pain, we forged our will.
- In the depths of the desert, we claimed our freedom.
- We are Ronin. We stand unbowed.

**Seeking**: Warriors who answer to no House, the discarded who seek purpose, and the strong who value freedom above all else.

**We Offer**: Brotherhood without servitude, strength without submission, and purpose without propaganda.

**We Stand**: Neutral in the wars of Arrakis, loyal to our own, and enemies to those who would control us.

Those who have walked through fire and emerged unbroken - find us.

### Recruitment Process

**The Path to Brotherhood**

**Become One of Us**: The road to becoming Ronin is challenging but rewarding. Those who endure emerge stronger, freer, and part of a brotherhood bound by choice, not chains.

**The Trials**:

- **Phase I: The Approach**: Initial contact and assessment.
- **Phase II: The Five Trials**: A fourteen-day test of body, mind, and spirit.
- **Phase III: The Vigil**: A time for reflection and final choice.
- **Phase IV: The Blooding**: Recitation of the sacred code and rebirth as a true Ronin.

**Do You Have What It Takes?**: Not strength alone, nor merely skill, but the unbreakable will to be truly free.

### Ranks/Hierarchy

**The Structure of Freedom**

In Ronin Rebellion, rank signifies responsibility, not authority. Every member's voice matters, and every member's path is their own.

**The Ascension Path**:

- **Ghost [White Band]**: Recruits in training.
- **Blade [Red Band]**: Full members who have survived the Blooding.

**The Four Paths**:

- **Scout [Black Band]**: Masters of stealth.
- **Vanguard [Blue Band]**: Combat specialists.
- **Adept [Green Band]**: Technical experts.
- **Emissary [Yellow Band]**: Negotiators.

**The Leadership**:

- **Master [Silver Band]**: Veterans who have proven exceptional.
- **Council of Seven [Gold Band]**: Elected guardians of our purpose.
- **First Speaker [Gold with Red Trim]**: The voice of the Council.

"Rank among the Ronin is not about who commands whom. It is about who has proven worthy to bear greater responsibility for our shared freedom."

### Leadership

**The Council of Seven**

The Ronin Rebellion is governed by the Council of Seven, veterans who guide our path while honoring our commitment to freedom.

**Structure & Selection**:

- Seven members elected by all full Ronin.
- Three-year terms, staggered for continuity.
- At least one representative from each specialist path.
- Gold arm band signifies Council membership.
- All major decisions require majority Council approval.

**Council Responsibilities**:

- Safeguarding independence and neutrality.
- Strategic direction of the Rebellion.
- Management of Substance S reserves.
- Final arbitration of internal disputes.
- Approval of major contracts and alliances.
- Oversight of recruitment and advancement.

**The First Speaker**:

- Selected from within the Council by vote.
- Serves as the voice and face of the Rebellion.
- One-year term, renewable once.
- Identified by gold arm band with red trim.
- Breaks tie votes within the Council.
- Has authority to call emergency assemblies.

### Guild Lore

**From Experiments to Warriors**

We were not born as Ronin. We were forged through fire and betrayal.

**Project Carrion**: House Harkonnen's secret military program created us. Soldiers, prisoners, and slaves became test subjects. They stripped us of identity, injected us with the experimental "Substance S," and sent us on suicide missions across Arrakis. The compound enhanced our combat abilities but gradually restored fragments of our will.

**The Breaking Point**: During Operation Dustwalker, our unit was abandoned in the desert. Seven of us survived and seized the transport, weapons, and remaining Substance S. We disappeared into the desert that was meant to be our grave.

**The Ronin Path**: Now we call ourselves the Ronin Rebellion. We owe allegiance to no House, no Baron, no Emperor. We are bound only to each other and to our freedom. The Substance S still flows through our veins, but we've learned to refine it. Our numbers have grown with others like us—discarded experiments, escaped prisoners, deserters seeking purpose. We stand neutral in the conflicts of Arrakis.

"They thought they created weapons. Instead, they forged warriors with the will to be free."

**Are You One of Us?**: Not all Ronin share our origins, but all share our commitment to freedom. The path is open to those with the will to walk it.

### Known Allegiances or Rivalries

- **Harkonnen**

### Other Activities

The Ronin Rebellion engages in various activities that align with their ethos and goals.

# Directional Melee Combat (meme)

**Categories:** DiscordLore, Community

## Content

**Important Note:** Dune: Awakening will NOT feature Directional Melee Combat (DMC).

Confessions of a false prophet

## Contents

- Discord Meme
- The early days
- The DMC Channel
- The Great Culling
- The Meme is born

- Game Mechanic
- Compatibility with games using modern/futuristic weapons

- References

### Discord Meme

Directional Melee Combat (DMC) is considered a meme within the official Dune: Awakening Discord community. However, it was not always perceived this way. The following recounts the events witnessed by those present during its evolution.

This serves as a cautionary tale of how unchecked trolling can disrupt a community.

#### The early days

In August 2022, the Official Discord Server for Dune: Awakening opened, attracting thousands of new members eager for a new Dune Survival MMO. Many of these newcomers were players from other survival games like Chivalry 2, Mordhau, Mortal Online, and Last Oasis, which feature a similar melee combat mechanic known as "DMC."

These players insisted that, given melee's prominence in the Dune universe, Dune: Awakening should incorporate DMC. Despite developers and staff confirming that this was not the intended direction for the game's combat system, the DMC advocates remained persistent.

Dune: Awakening aims to offer a "Combined Arms" experience, balancing melee, ranged, vehicles, and special abilities for dynamic PvP and PvE gameplay. However, this reasoning did not satisfy the DMC proponents.

#### The DMC Channel

The General channel became overwhelmed with increasingly toxic debates about why DMC should be the primary melee system, overshadowing other discussions and driving members away. Before paid moderation staff were in place, a dedicated channel, #directional-melee-combat-discussion, was created to contain the discussions, which had devolved into trolling and flaming dissenting opinions.

Despite this effort, further action was necessary.

#### The Great Culling

In early 2023, it was decided that the DMC trolling needed to be stopped for the community's sake. Overnight, numerous trolls were banned in what became known as the Great Cull, effectively dismantling the DMC army.

Rumors suggested that Natascha, the Senior PR Manager, ordered the ban, but this remains unconfirmed. The following day, the chat was eerily quiet, and the DMC channel was archived, never to be reopened.

#### The Meme is born

As time passed, the community began to recover, and those who had left due to the trolling returned. By mid-2023, a paid moderation team was established, including Dan, Paulo, Ian, and others, ensuring a more peaceful environment for the community.

The DMC saga became legendary, and the once-feared meme transformed into a humorous part of the community's history. The "Original Meme" of the Dune: Awakening community now resides on a dedicated website.

There are whispers of a Funcom insider, known as Ignasi, who continues to bring the meme into meetings and reviews, though his motives remain mysterious.

### Game Mechanic

Directional Melee Combat (DMC) is a game mechanic characterized by complex melee fighting beyond simple aiming and clicking. Attacks can be directed from various angles, including right, left, top, and bottom, with swords and pointed weapons offering a straight stab. Parrying and shield blocking also utilize directional inputs.

Games like Mortal Online 2, Mordhau, and Chivalry 2 feature these mechanics, often referred to as Slasher games. These games typically involve first-person combat, requiring players to use additional keypresses to direct attacks, parries, and blocks, demanding greater skill with the keyboard or controller.

The competitive nature of these games appeals to skilled players but can disadvantage newcomers and those preferring a casual play style. Experienced players often have an advantage over new players due to their familiarity with the mechanics.

#### Compatibility with games using modern/futuristic weapons

While DMC games include weapons like bows and arrows, they are not easily compatible with games featuring modern weapons such as assault rifles, sniper rifles, rocket launchers, and hand grenades. The compatibility with mage classes casting root spells and destructive area-of-effect spells is also uncertain. As DMC primarily involves melee combat, players may be disadvantaged in games with ranged weapons.

The Order of 9 aims to instill hope on the sands of Arrakis, embracing its stark beauty while purging it of the unworthy. They strive to be a gentle hand in a harsh world and a sharp blade against the guilty.

## Guild Lore

The Order of 9 was formed by outcasts, off-world prisoners left on Arrakis. Instead of breaking, they united with a single purpose. They embraced the Fremen's wisdom, creating the A.R.E.S. Protocol: Avenge, Rescue, Escort, Survey. This creed, recited in reverse, emphasizes that justice starts with awareness.

Honor is their currency, not just decoration. Their steadfast code has carved their legend into the sands, catching the attention of Duke Leto Atreides, who saw potential in them. Under the banner of House Atreides, they operate in the Hagga Basin, bringing light to the forgotten, enforcing law, and protecting the careless.

To Be Determined

# 21 Genders

## Backstory

Welcome to 21 Genders, a group of players who have transitioned from Ark to explore Dune: Awakening. We focus on PvP, strategy, and having a good time, with humor being a key element — no joke is off-limits here.

Whether dominating the battlefield or sharing laughs, we maintain a light-hearted and fun atmosphere. We embrace humor and resilience, regardless of how intense things become.

If you're here to conquer the sands of Dune, exchange strategies, and enjoy some unfiltered banter, you’re in the right place. Let’s make this journey as epic as it is entertaining.

## Organization

- **Sandworm Hatchling**: New Member – Welcome to the desert!
- Just joined the crew and starting to learn the ropes.
- You’re still getting a feel for the game and the group, but you’re here to have fun and contribute where you can.

- **Spice Raider**: Active Contributor – You've started making your mark.
- You’re getting the hang of things in Dune and have shown dedication to PvP and group activities.
- You actively participate in group missions, contribute to the team’s strategy, and share humor with the crew.

- **Fremen Commander**: Experienced Player – You’re a force to be reckoned with.
- You’ve mastered the fundamentals, contributed heavily to victories, and show leadership in battle.
- You’re a trusted member who helps train newcomers, leads group efforts, and strategizes for PvP dominance.

- **Dune Titan**: Unstoppable Force – The desert bows to you.
- You’re the ultimate player, feared and respected by all. Your skills and leadership are unmatched, ensuring victory on the battlefield.
- As a Dune Titan, you shape the future of the group, lead with authority, and your decisions have a lasting impact on the team’s success.

## Recruitment

- **No Sensitivity Allowed**: We keep things light, fun, and full of humor. Jokes are allowed, no matter how wild or inappropriate they might seem — just remember, it’s all in good fun. If you're easily offended, this might not be the place for you.

- **Must Be 18+**: This is an adult group. By joining, you confirm that you're 18 years old or older. Mature humor, language, and content are part of the package.

- **Discord is Required**: We use Discord as our primary communication tool. You need to be active in the server, check announcements, and participate in voice chats during raids, missions, or casual hangouts.

- **Respect Your Fellow Members**: While we love to joke around, respect is key. There’s a line when it comes to humor — even though for us that line is way out there, it’s not the same for everyone. If a joke bothers someone, be respectful. Avoid personal attacks, as they are not funny. Respect others, and it’ll come back to you.

We understand that everyone has a life outside of gaming, and sometimes you can’t be online all the time. If you need to step back for a while or can’t make it, just let us know. Communication is key, keeping us in the loop helps everyone stay on the same page and ensures we’re all still having a good time.

## Gallery

(Will be added once the game is released)

## Leadership

- **Quin – The Guild Leader**: Quin serves as the leader of the guild, holding the final say on all major decisions. Their authority ensures a clear vision and steady direction for the guild, guiding its actions and strategy on the shifting sands of Arrakis.

- **Yeet – The Diplomatic Envoy**: Yeet is the guild’s primary communicator with other factions and members. As the Diplomatic Envoy, they manage alliances, negotiate with rivals, and ensure the guild’s voice is heard beyond its borders.

- **Darock – The Strategist Equal**: Darock, standing on equal footing with Yeet, focuses on different aspects of leadership. Whether it’s internal coordination or tactical planning, Darock provides critical support to ensure the guild’s operations run smoothly.

## Known Allegiances or Rivalries

As the game has yet to launch, our guild currently has no formal alliances. However, we remain open to forging partnerships with like-minded groups once the sands of Arrakis shift into motion. Whether as allies or rivals, we are prepared to engage with other factions through diplomacy or conflict as needed.

## Other Activities

We all enjoy the games Smite and Ark. If you’re looking to claim the title of leader, all you have to do is challenge Quin in Smite. Watching him get defeated is the highlight of the day. Remember, to officially join, don’t forget to call Quin fat when you enter and to contact Yeet or Quin for roles to be applied to you.

## Content

### Guild Summary

The Ghosts of Salusa is a guild established on May 1, 2025, with over 10 members. The guild focuses on combat, trade, and exploration. Recruitment is open, and the guild operates on the PC platform, using English as the primary language. While primarily based in the OCE timezone, it welcomes members from all regions. Activities include role-playing events and normal gameplay, with participation in both PVE and PVP. The guild maintains a neutral stance regarding major houses.

### Purpose / Ethos

The Ghosts of Salusa are former Sardaukar who have turned away from tyranny. They uphold a code of discipline, loyalty, and strength, rejecting the throne they once served. Born from the ashes of Salusa Secundus, they fight for one another, bound by brotherhood and guided by vengeance. They are soldiers without masters, precise in their strikes, and echoes of a legacy that refuses to die. They are the true sons and daughters of Salusa Secundus, and they do not kneel.

### Recruitment Process

Recruitment is conducted through Discord, involving a brief evaluation and question-based process. The guild seeks individuals who adhere to their code of loyalty, brotherhood, and honor. Referrals from active members are prioritized. Strategic alliances with other houses or factions are considered individually, pending diplomatic approval.

### Ranks/Hierarchy

- **Sardaukar Khan**: Supreme commander, a legendary warrior and tactician leading with absolute authority.
- **Sardaukar Captain**: Senior battlefield commander responsible for divisions or operations, answering only to the Khan.
- **Sardaukar Lieutenant**: Mid-level officer commanding squads or missions, coordinating tactics and executing orders.
- **Sardaukar Sergeant**: Veteran non-commissioned officer leading small units, ensuring battlefield cohesion.
- **Sardaukar Bladehand**: Elite front-line trooper trusted with sensitive assignments, known for precision and loyalty.
- **Sardaukar Cadet**: Fresh recruit undergoing training and trials, aspiring to wield the blade of a true Ghost.

There are two focus paths:

- **The Khalisaar**: Warriors forged in Salusa Secundus, masters of Sardaukar martial traditions, known for swift and brutal strikes.
- **The Sarhaat**: The foundation of the Ghosts, handling logistics, intelligence, engineering, and medical aid, ensuring mission success.

### Leadership

Venn is the current Khan and leader of the Ghosts of Salusa.

### Guild Lore

**The Shattering of Salusa: Origin of the Ghosts**

Salusa Secundus was once a harsh but beautiful world, home to the Sardaukar. House Corrino sought to create an unbreakable war machine, bringing apocalypse upon their own vassals. Survivors were forged into living weapons, stripped of weakness. Among them were warriors who became the Ghosts of Salusa, once loyal to the throne. They uncovered the truth: the destruction of Salusa was a strategic genocide by their own leaders. Betrayed, they vanished from Corrino ranks, becoming mercenaries without masters. They haunt the Imperium that betrayed them, remembering what was lost and ensuring no throne forgets the cost of loyalty abused.

### Known Allegiances or Rivalries

The Ghosts of Salusa currently stand against the House of Corrino and their Sardaukar legion.

### Other Activities

The guild engages in various activities, maintaining its presence and influence within the gaming community.

- **Platform:** PC
- **Language:** English
- **Timezones:** PST/EST/GMT
- **Activities:** Roleplaying, gathering, exploring, gaming
- **PVE:** Yes
- **PVP:** Yes
- **RP:** Yes
- **Major House:** Harkonnen
- **Discord:** Available for members

## Purpose / Ethos

The Allied Arrakis branch of Harkonnen - Imperium Logistics and Trade is contracted through CHOAM. The guild ensures that critical goods and services unique to Arrakis are supplied to the Imperium, benefiting both the Great House Harkonnen and the Padishah Emperor Shaddam IV. As the saying goes, "the Spice must flow."

## Recruitment Process

Players can apply to join the guild through the Discord link or by seeking out members in the game on Narbog, Gara Kulon. A brief application is required for both methods.

## Ranks/Hierarchy

- **Head of Logistics:** Organizes and manages personnel, machinery, and vehicles.
- **Head of Trade:** Catalogues, stores, and transports goods and services supplied to CHOAM.
- **Security Specialists:** Ensure the safety and security of field workers, bases, and shipments.
- **Analytics Specialists:** Locate, assess, and chart raw resources for current and future harvests.
- **Pilots and Drivers:** Transport crews, vehicles, and goods across Arrakis.
- **Physicians:** Handle the health and well-being of workers on-site.
- **Mechanics:** Maintain machinery, vehicles, and operational structures.
- **Skilled Labourers:** Execute orders, gather resources, and manage day-to-day base upkeep.

## Leadership

The guild's leader, known as @TheGall, has been active in the Dune: Awakening community since early 2025 and has a long history in the roleplay community, dating back to World of Warcraft: Burning Crusade. The leadership team is composed of experienced adults who foster a welcoming space for roleplay and gaming.

- **Director:** Oversees the successful launch and prosperity of the guild.
- **Head of Logistics:** Lukaas Halvek, known for efficient management.
- **Head of Trade:** Pyor Yve, skilled in business and maximizing profits.

## Guild Lore

Following the failure of the previous Arrakis Logistics and Trade branch, HILT dissolved ALT and restructured the company under a new name. A Harkonnen Na-Familia representative now serves as acting Director. The stakes are high, with the risk of losing the CHOAM contract and the Baron's favor.

### Dust to Dust

Upon arrival at the old base, the new Director finds it in disrepair, with power long gone and sandstorms having taken their toll. The pervasive scent of spice fills the air, hinting at the challenges ahead.

### Damaged Goods

The Director takes inventory of the remaining supplies, discovering a nearly empty chest. A mysterious violet glimmer catches his eye, drawing him closer to a cracked floor tile, ensnaring him with its scent.

## Known Allegiances or Rivalries

HILT is closely tied to the Great House Harkonnen. However, Allied Arrakis Logistics and Trade is open to partnerships with individuals from Atreides, other Major and Minor Houses, Scavengers, and Smugglers, while observing Kanly as applicable. There are currently no in-game rivalries or allegiances, but this may change.

## Other Activities

The guild consists of gamers connected through real-life friendships, other games, and social networks. Members play games like Elder Scrolls Online, Final Fantasy FFXIV, Star Wars: The Old Republic, DnD, and Magic the Gathering. The guild is part of the larger Dune: Awakening Roleplay Community and hosts out-of-character social events such as Eurovision, movie watch parties, and holiday socials.

**Purpose:** The guild aims to prevent the great houses from mining spice and taking full control over Arrakis. Additionally, it seeks to learn from the legacy left by the Fremen.

Recruitment is strictly invite-only. Interested individuals can request to join by contacting the Guild Leader, Palasar17. Upon joining the Discord server, members will have limited access until they complete a guild application. Approval is required from the Guild Leader or other admins.
