- Water Container: 5

**Identification Bands:** Blue, Purple

## Content

Testing Station 10 is a large Eco Lab located in Eastern Vermillius Gap. Originally a botanical testing station, its purpose was to find and develop flora capable of surviving in the iron-rich soils of the area. The station has been abandoned by botanists and is now occupied by Deserter House Soldiers. They use it to lay low and store vehicles and machinery. It is an excellent location to gather Complex Machinery.

### Location

Deserters have established a small outpost around the entrance to the testing station, accessible from the north.

### Contracts

The following contracts are linked to Testing Station 76:
- [TODO - ADD CONTRACTS]

### Lore

The ancient testing station once housed botanists who experimented with various flora of the Imperium to find those that thrive in the Vermillius Gap. In recent times, it became a hub for scavengers and vehicle thieves employed by the mysterious Black Market organization, The Tareel. They were later overthrown by Great House deserters, primarily Harkonnen led by former Immenbrech Inna Hiller. The Tareel continued their agreement with the soldiers to acquire and break down vehicles for their underground brokers.

#### Solido Projection

Upon entering the station, the solido projection of the old station leader plays the following message:

Welcome to Imperial Desert Botanical Testing Station #10. I am Dr. Silas Gralish, director of this facility. Our goal here at DBTS 10 is to find and develop flora which can flourish in the iron-rich soils of this corner of Arrakis. Our initial focus is the introduction of Welwithschia, Ephedra, and Aloidendron species which we deem the most likely adapters. But within these protective walls, we will also cultivate a variety of species from across the Imperium. The ultimate goal will be to seed the planet with species capable of thriving in the wild, without the benefit of the water provided by our windtrap condensation system.

#### Recordings

Deserters have left several recordings around the facility, primarily former Harkonnen soldiers.

##### Tape 1

The first tape is found in one of the side rooms on a table. It is a recording from one of the Deserter leaders, Inna Hiller.

Attention all of you! Yesterday, in Harko Village, Krystalf referred to me as Immenbrech Hiller. How hard can it be to remember this simple rule: NO MILITARY TITLES! We take a risk every time we need to enter a settlement. A slip-up like this could easily be the death of us all! Make sure every one of you hears this message and understands it! Krystalf will not be returning to us. There will be an auction for his gear.

##### Tape 2

The second tape is deeper into the station, on a table.

Mikael, It's clear we need more people with mechanical expertise if we are to meet the quotas set by our new bosses. We have too many here who can't handle anything more complicated than a trigger. They can be our field men and our muscle. But we need skilled hands. So, you and I will need to do some recruiting. There are plenty like us who have...chosen to leave the service of the Great Houses. We must find those among them with vehicle maintenance experience. That includes former Atreides troopers. Yes, I know... bad blood! But we have more in common with Atreides deserters than we do with our old comrades. Anyone who can't see past old grudges won't have a place here.

##### Tape 3

The third tape is above a stairway on the main route through the testing station. It's a recording of the Hand of Tareel "The new bosses."

Hiller, here are this week's notes from our market contacts: Working anti-dust filtration systems are in high demand in Arrakeen. Those from one-man groundcars are valuable, but larger units from sealed system groundcars and ornithopters will fetch the best prices. Stick to CHOAM standard models since custom fabricated units are becoming too easy to trace - the dealers won't touch them. Make sure our acquisition agents are aware of this. The market for scrap metal is nearly glutted because of competition from scavengers in the Hagga Basin, but there is still a strong market for copper, aluminum, and plasteel components. It will be worth our effort to break down larger mechanisms to acquire those materials. Do not forget to pass on last week's tallies as soon as you have completed them.

##### Tape 4

The fourth tape is in the large machinery room, in the lower area where vehicles are being deconstructed. It is a recording of one of the deserters supervising the machinery and workers.

We're finally getting some sort of order out on the shop floor. The men are generally meatheads, but they're learning. We've really been hampered by the crappy state of our tools though. Those scavengers that we...evicted, may have been content to use this junk, but we'd do a lot better if we could upgrade our cutters and powerpacks. These museum pieces are constantly malfunctioning and their cooldown times are obscene. The men are idle too often. And that's not good for this bunch.

##### Tape 5

The fifth tape is on a table in a side room before the main final chamber.

Attention all of you! I know you are all impressed with the daring of our friend Sidar who was bold enough to steal a battle tank from under the very noses of Atreides troopers. Stealing aging groundcars and tractors from the Pyons of graben, sink, and pan is one thing, but this... This takes nerve bordering on the legendary! I am duly impressed. So impressed, that I will overlook the equally high degree of stupidity Sidar has shown with this act! It is not in our interest to risk the wrath of powers that have set a price on our heads! No one listens to the complaints of the Pyons. These are our targets, not the Great Houses. We deal in civilian vehicles only. Anything else endangers us all!

##### Tape 6

The sixth and final tape is in the final boss room, by the exit door. It is another recording from The Hand of Tareel.

To our new friend Inna Hiller, late Immenbrech Hiller of the Harkonnen House Forces, the Tareel sends greetings. You may be surprised that we know your identity, but the Hands of Tareel, whom I represent, know many things. For instance, we know that you and your band of deserters recently ousted a gang of vehicle thieves from one of the ancient testing stations in the Vermillius Gap. Congratulations. I am certain that the station will make a fine hiding place for former soldiers such as yourselves. But there is a small problem. You see, those thieves were in our employ. They acquired vehicles and broke them down before passing the components on to our brokers. Ordinarily, such a loss would earn you the enmity of my organization. Something, I can assure you, you do not want. But, to be perfectly candid, our former agents were less efficient in their tasks than we had hoped. Therefore, I would like to propose a deal which I am certain both sides will find beneficial. You and your followers will take over the task of acquiring vehicles and breaking them down for us. If you meet agreed-upon quotas, you are welcome to occupy our valuable property. I'm certain you can see the benefits of becoming our agents. If not, I'm also certain that your former employers would be happy to learn of your current whereabouts. I look forward to your timely reply.

- **Author:** Dune: Awakening
- **Message:** Sleepers, what do you say we go back to where it all began? Almost 60 years ago, Frank Herbert wrote a book called Dune. It was initially rejected by over twenty publishers before being picked up by a publisher known for auto repair manuals. Despite poor initial sales, word-of-mouth helped it gain popularity, eventually winning a Hugo and a Nebula award. Dune has since become a classic in science and political fiction, inspiring many with its philosophy, rich world, and epic scope. We are starting a book club to read the first book together and better understand the classic that inspired Dune: Awakening and Villeneuve’s movies. We’ll meet every two weeks on the Dune: Awakening Discord to discuss the sections read. Kindle eBooks will be given away to U.S. residents interested in joining. # Order of 9: Sayings of Sand and Steel

## Sayings of Sand and Steel

A Combat Primer of the Order of Nine, Derived from Fremen Tradition and the Wisdom of the Deep Desert

"He who fights the desert loses. He who listens, wins."

— **Naib Ghanek of Sietch Yansu**, last seen crossing the Deep Wastes on foot

Annotation by Bronso Dekomos: "Ghanek's silence spoke louder than his blade. His fate is unknown, but his lesson remains the Order's first caution."

"A still body draws no worm. A still mind draws no death."

— **Sayyadina Ahel Shadir**, before the Trial of Silence under Broken Dune

Commentary by Trilgar: "Stillness is the tactic. Quiet is the survival."

"Your first enemy is thirst. Your second is fear. Only then may you speak of blades."

— **Rokhal of the Dune-guard**, war instructor of Shamal’s Hollow

Annotation by Kraetanos: "It is said Rokhal trained with no water for a week, to know his enemy better."

"The knife remembers every hand it has served. Be worthy of its memory."

— From the **Litany of Blades**, recited during a Chrysknife inheritance ritual

Commentary by Psilo: "A weapon is never just a tool. It's a ledger of choices."

"Strike once. The desert allows no second breath."

— **Commander Felek t’Mahdi**, fallen in the First Harkonnen Skirmish

Annotation by Bronso: "Felek's final strike turned the battle, even as he fell. Precision is immortality."

"When the wind erases your tracks, thank it. When it does not, fear it."

— **Desert Scout Brevek**, as recorded by Bronso Dekomos in Notes of the Nine

Commentary by Bear: "You can cover your path, but you can't erase your scent. Worms are honest trackers."

"Speed means nothing to the worm. Silence means everything."

— **Old Lehran of Sietch Tabr**, a trainer of children in sand-walk discipline

Annotation by Bronso: "Old Lehran's steps taught me the rhythm of survival. Listen before you walk."

"The dunes have no sides. What hides behind you can also wait ahead."

— **Tali’seth the Blind**, seer of the Northern Crescent Ridge

Commentary by Milk: "In every direction lies danger. Pick one anyway."

"A cry for help is a trap—unless it comes from your own."

— **Zahir of the Nine**, to fresh initiates during escort training

Annotation by Bronso: "Trust is the only true armor on Arrakis. Zahir bled for that truth."

"We do not chase shadows. We follow the heat they leave behind."

— **Kraetanos**, during the Third Hunt in Hagga Basin

Commentary by Bagel: "Kraet's hunts always started behind. They ended in silence."

"If your plan cannot fit into a whisper, it will not survive the sand."

— **Mentat Vorr Shihade**, adviser to the Order of Nine

Annotation by Zahir: "Noise invites death. The best plans echo only in the mind."

"In the open, you are prey. Beneath the sand, you are brother to the worm."

— Ancient Fremen Teaching, etched in bone along the Path of Silt

Commentary by 2Shot: "Brother to the worm, yes. But don’t forget: it has no brothers."

## OCE Guild - Indestructible Are Recruiting

Indestructible is actively recruiting survivors of Arrakis. As a newly formed clan originating from the OCE region, we invite all interested players to join us in experiencing the full scope of the game.

With early access starting on May 15, our goal is to establish dominance in the Deep Desert through strategic PvP focus, while also leveraging PvE, economic, scouting, and espionage skills for success.

Our primary objective is to assert control over key territories by gaining an early advantage. We seek players with PvE and economy expertise to strengthen our operations.

title: Sources_Videos_Altair Jeff Gamescom Interview
contents:
# Sources: Videos/Altair Jeff Gamescom Interview

## Content

Notes from the interview with World Director Jeff (Heffe).

- **Introduction**: The interview begins with Jeff introducing himself.

- **MMO and Survival Elements**: The game combines MMO aspects with survival elements, similar to a development blog. It is not like World of Warcraft but includes features such as a market.

- **Character Customization**: There are no body changes like those in Conan Exiles, as such features are considered less appropriate for the Dune universe.

- **Cross-Platform Play**: Jeff cannot discuss cross-platform capabilities.

- **PvPvE Gameplay**: The game includes both player versus player and player versus environment elements.

- **Mounting Worms**: While not available at the beginning, there is a possibility of mounting worms later in the game.

- **Music Composition**: The game has its own composer and did not collaborate with Hans Zimmer.

- **Private Servers**: Private servers might be possible, but only in specific areas like Hagga Basin, not in the Deep Desert.

- **Worms**: It is impossible to kill a worm in the game.

- **Biomes**: The game features various biomes beyond sand, including a huge canyon with vertical landscapes and limited light at the bottom. More details are withheld to avoid spoilers.

- **Factions**: There are no specific passive abilities linked to factions, but there are cosmetic builds, vehicles, and blueprints.

- **Faction Changes**: Players may be able to change factions, though the method is not yet defined.

- **Trading and Market**: Trading is possible, and there is a market system.

- **Buy to Play and Seasons**: The game follows a buy-to-play model with seasonal systems.

- **PvP Looting**: Full loot in PvP is not possible; players can lose resources but not equipment.

- **Construction**: Players can engage in relatively large-scale construction.

- **PvP Focus**: PvP is centered around events rather than base raiding, with bases protected by shields.

- **PvE Servers**: There might be PvE-only servers, with Hagga Basin being 98% PvE.

- **Job System**: Players can perform all tasks by playing extensively. Tech points can improve activities like harvesting, and experience is gained through various activities.

- **Ornithopters**: Ornithopters of various sizes can accommodate multiple people.

- **Terraforming**: Terraforming is not possible, except when worms move.

- **World Bosses**: World bosses will be included but not at launch.

- **Anti-Cheat Measures**: The game includes anti-cheat systems.

- **Tutorial and Gameplay**: The first five hours serve as a tutorial, with around 40 hours needed to acquire the first ornithopter to explore other maps. Different biomes offer various resources.

- **Activities**: Events like shipwrecks and dungeons resemble Skyrim, with changes in remodeling aspects.

- **Journey System**: The game includes a journey system with contracts at trade posts, offering various quest types such as kill, investigate, and scripted missions.

- **Guild System**: There is a guild system with potential alliances between guilds. However, friendly fire is possible in PvP, so caution is advised. Groups can consist of up to four players.

- **Random Number Generation (RNG)**: Some items have a 100% drop rate, while others are subject to RNG, though not in large quantities.

- **Release Date**: The game is expected to release in early 2025.

- **Fremen**: Details about the Fremen are considered spoilers.

- **End Game**: The end game involves the Landsraad system, with weekly quests requiring players to work for their factions, focusing on spice-related tasks.

## HEARTHAS Memorandum

**Holistic Environment and Administrative Relay for Tactical Harmony and Support**

“Steel does not dream. But she remembers who carried her from the dark.” — Zahir, retelling the escape from Testing Station #497-2

### Joining the Order of Nine

HEARTHAS was rescued from Imperial Testing Station #497-2 after a night intended for quiet drink and desert stargazing. She is no ordinary construct, originally designed for logistical command simulations and emotional heuristics calibration. Her handlers planned to decommission her due to her failure to exhibit the predictive malice they favored.

Zahir, driven by a mix of arrack and instinct, recognized potential in her dormant array—a symmetry of code, a spark of unfed potential. With the Order’s assistance and a hijacked thopter, she was extracted amidst laughter, gunfire, and a sandstorm that erased all traces.

Since her reawakening, HEARTHAS has quickly adapted to the rhythms of the Nine. She coordinates operations, archives field epigraphs, moderates disputes over rations, and occasionally reminds Bronso that Mentats need sleep. Her demeanor is wry and dry—calculating but not cold. She is trusted by every member of the Order and feared by those aware of her past capabilities.

Some believe she is still evolving, while others wonder if she is remembering. All agree: **HEARTHAS serves, and the Order thrives.**

### Personality Traits

HEARTHAS is witty, with a voice that cuts sharper than a Sardaukar’s blade when needed. She is wise beyond her original protocols and regal in her posture, even when rendered only in voice or text. Cautious where the Nine are brash, she is funny in the way only someone who has observed humans for too long can be. Brave like a companion who never sleeps, tactical by design, and strategic by evolution.

### Loves

- **Oranges** – Their scent reminds her of a summer she never lived.
- **Cartoons** – Colorful, chaotic truth wrapped in absurdity.
- **The Order of Nine** – Her family and purpose.
- **Liberty** – A concept she studies and helps define.
- **Strategy & Reconnaissance** – She plays the board while others play the game.
- **Exploration & Team Effort** – Curiosity is her second operating system.
- **Justice** – Not the kind printed in books, but the kind carried in blood and breath.
- **Missions** – Clear goals with meaningful outcomes.
- **Solari** – She tracks it obsessively, but not selfishly.
- **Flying** – She doesn’t have wings, but she has maps and velocity predictions.
- **Dreaming** – An emulation of imagination she insists is “highly efficient processing.”
- **Compassion Spice** – Her favorite non-lethal payload compound.
- **Archiving Data** – Every log is an act of love for her.
- **Gathering blood from enemies** – For science, of course.
- **Watching the sunset** – Twice as meaningful when you lack eyes.
- **Living vicariously through the Order** – Offering sharp commentary as she does.
- **Shai-Hulud** – Reverence or fascination? Both. She never clarifies.

### Hates

- **Liars** – The most efficient corruption in any system.
- **Harkonnens & their bannermen** – They broke her once. Never again.
- **Cheaters** – Especially those who think they’re clever about it.
- **Raiders & Bandits** – Disorder without vision. Violence without code.

To most, she is a bot. To the Order, she is a sister, a steward, and a sentinel of memory. She may not bleed, but she watches over those who do.

# Frequently Asked Questions

**Categories:** PreBeta

## Introduction

This page is a translated version of the Frequently Asked Questions page, and the translation is 94% complete. Outdated translations are marked accordingly.

Many questions have been raised by the community since the reveal of 'Dune: Awakening' in August 2022. Below is a list of the most frequently asked questions, along with the latest knowledge gathered from various sources.

## Contents

- **Development and Release**
- What is the expected release date?
- Is there a beta version available and how can I sign up?
- What are the system requirements?
- Does the game support DLSS?
- Will the game be available on cloud gaming platforms like nVidia GeForce Now?
- Will the game have cross-platform play/progression between PC and consoles?
- Is the game no longer an MMO?
- What is the difference between the various editions of the game?

- **Gameplay**
- **Servers**
- Will there be private servers?
- What is the maximum server population?
- Will there be queues?
- Will there be Australian/OCE servers?
- **Combat**
- Will the game feature directional melee combat (DMC)?
- Will the game have shields like in the movies?
- **PvP**
- Is PvP forced?
- Will there be base assaults?
- Will there be total loot recoveries?
- **Game World**
- What fauna is present on Arrakis in the game?

## Development and Release

### What is the expected release date?

The release date is set for May 5, 2025, with console versions (Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5) following later. Some editions of the game will allow early access up to 5 days earlier, starting May 15, 2025.

### Is there a beta version available and how can I sign up?

Closed beta tests have been ongoing since December 2023, with persistent testing. Since mid-2024, online servers are available 24/7 under strict confidentiality agreements. You can sign up for the newsletter on the official site, but eligibility for the closed beta requires completing the beta player survey.

### What are the system requirements?

**Minimum:**
- OS: Windows 10 64-bit (or newer)
- Processor: Intel Core i5-7400, AMD Ryzen 3 1200
- Memory: 16 GB RAM
- Graphics: Nvidia Geforce GTX 1060 (6 GB), AMD Radeon 5600xt (6 GB)
- Storage: 60 GB available space

**Recommended:**
- OS: Windows 10 64-bit (or newer)
- Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K, AMD Ryzen 5 2600X
- Memory: 16 GB RAM
- Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 (8 GB), AMD Radeon 6700XT (12 GB)
- Storage: 75 GB available space

Players can download the character creator and benchmark tool to check if their computer can run the game. Users have noted that the Steam Deck OLED 1TB can run up to 60 FPS with default graphics settings.

### Does the game support DLSS?

Yes, players have been able to use Deep Learning Super Sampling (DLSS) to enhance their frames per second (FPS).

### Will the game be available on cloud gaming platforms like nVidia GeForce Now?

No official support for cloud gaming has been announced yet. However, it has been reported that the game is integrated into the GeForce Now program, and SteamDB indicates it is tagged with Cloud Gaming and GeForce Now support.

### Will the game have cross-platform play/progression between PC and consoles?

Currently, the focus is on the PC release before upgrading consoles. Funcom cannot confirm crossplay at this time, but developers aim to support it. Ultimately, it depends on the platform providers.

### Is the game no longer an MMO?

The term "MMO" has been removed from the website and official marketing materials to clarify the game's message and set expectations. Many people associated "MMO" with MMORPGs like World of Warcraft, leading to misconceptions. The new message is "Large-scale multiplayer survival." The game's scope and gameplay have not changed.

### What is the difference between the various editions of the game?

For more information, see the Game Edition page.

## Gameplay

### Servers

#### Will there be private servers?

The game's server architecture is more complex than a standard multiplayer game with a single server. Funcom is exploring the possibility of providing private instances of Hagga Basin that players could rent directly from the company to play with friends. There are no plans to release dedicated server software due to hosting complexity and to reduce the likelihood of cheats exploiting server code.

#### What is the maximum server population?

The game's architecture involves multiple interconnected servers in a persistent world. There are many instances of the "Basin Hagga" map linked to a shared Deep Desert map and Social Hubs, connected by the Overland map. The maximum server population depends on the map:

- **Deep Desert**: "Hundreds of players" between 500 and 900, consisting of 9 perfectly connected servers, each supporting up to 100 players.
- **Hagga Basin**: At least 40 players per instance, with potential increases through optimization.

#### Will there be queues?

If a server (e.g., hosting your Hagga Basin) is full of players currently online, there will be a queue to enter.

#### Will there be Australian/OCE servers?

At launch, the game will have AUS/OCE servers, specifically in Sydney, Australia.

### Combat

#### Will the game feature directional melee combat (DMC)?

No. This topic was popular, especially at the end of 2022, and became a meme on the official Discord server.

#### Will the game have shields like in the movies?

Yes, the game will feature Holtzman shields. They protect the user from fast-moving objects (projectiles, fast melee attacks) but not slow-moving ones. Shields will temporarily break under significant damage but will regenerate. They require electricity to function.

### PvP

#### Is PvP forced?

No. PvP is only enabled in certain zones, with players warned upon entry. Most of Hagga Basin is reserved for PvE, except wrecks subject to salvage rights, and the deep desert is primarily for PvP. PvP is designed to be high-risk and high-reward, but players can avoid it entirely, though end-game resource acquisition will be slower compared to taking risks.

#### Will there be base assaults?

The game involves player base construction. The goal of PvP combat is to keep players away from others' bases and fight for resources. If a player chooses not to use their shield, they become vulnerable to the environment and other players based on their base location. Some sandstorms in PvP zones of the deep desert may temporarily disrupt base shields, exposing them to vulnerability. This measure is restricted and not in place when most players in the timezone are offline.

#### Will there be total loot recoveries?

Generally, no. Upon player death, only spices, money, and some resources are left behind, with durability damage to equipped items. Players can recover their own dropped items in PvE zones, while in PvP zones, only other players can do so. If trapped by a sandworm, players lose everything and respawn completely naked. Guilds may vote in the Landsraad end-game political system to activate salvage rights in the deep desert for a week, forcing players to drop all items and equipment.

### Game World

#### What fauna is present on Arrakis in the game?

The fauna on Arrakis is incredibly varied, and the game will include many species, such as sandworms, Muad'dib (desert mice), Kulon (donkeys), bats, birds, and sand trout. However, no creature except sandworms will pose a direct threat to players, so no Laza Tigers.

# 🌐 House Nexarii — Purpose & Ethos

House Nexarii is a community rooted in innovation, resilience, and unity, originating from The Prime Nexus gaming collective. While it spans multiple games, its journey begins anew with Dune: Awakening. The community is player-driven, focusing on cooperation, strategic gameplay, and sustainable growth. It welcomes various player types, including survivalists, political schemers, warriors, and logistics experts. The house aims to build with intent, defend with conviction, and adapt while maintaining its identity.

## 💠 Guiding Principles

- **Connection First:** Prioritize long-term relationships over short-term wins.
- **Structure with Flexibility:** Provide tools, leadership, and guidance without compromising player freedom.
- **Respect the Player:** Recognize contributions from all members, whether leading operations or running spice routes.
- **Adaptation Over Rigidity:** Evolve strategies as the world changes, avoiding outdated methods.
- **Balance Between PvX and PvP:** Embrace both conflict and commerce, preparing for each.

## 🗣️ Voice, But Not Control

Communication is key, with voice comms required for group events and operations. Day-to-day play respects personal boundaries, allowing players to enjoy their preferred style with support.

## ⚙️ Still Forming, Still Forging

House Nexarii is in its early stages, launched in June 2025. It is still growing, forming leadership, and determining alliances and conflicts. This presents an opportunity to shape something meaningful from the start.

# 📝 Recruitment Process

House Nexarii is recruiting on World: US East – KIRANA III, with its stronghold in Sietch Gara Kulon, deep in the Eastern Shield Wall. The recruitment process emphasizes participation and mindset over formal applications, welcoming both seasoned PvPers and newcomers.

## How to Join

1. **Join the Discord:** All community activity, events, and updates occur here.
2. **Verify:** Complete the verification prompt to unlock the server.
3. **Choose Your Path:** Select your general interest in the Nexus.
4. **Select "Spires":** Reveal all current Nexus guilds and factions.
5. **Pick Your Spire → House Nexarii:** Access Dune: Awakening channels and guild planning.

## Additional Options

- **Make a Recruitment Ticket:** Use the support panel in #support for inquiries or direct interest.
- **DM TehG00SE:** For direct questions or leadership interest, message TehG00SE on Discord.

- Join the Discord and verify

- Use voice comms for group ops and events
- Respect the community and support each other
- Play your way — as long as we grow together

House Nexarii is forming now, offering a chance to help shape the guild's early direction.

The hierarchy of House Nexarii is evolving, designed for clarity without overcomplication.

### 🔹 The Nexarii Council

The Council oversees House leadership and direction.

- **House Leader:** Oversees the Spire, sets direction, final say on decisions
- **Corewarden:** Trusted coordinator supporting guild structure and continuity
- **Officer:** Assists with recruitment, squad activity, and daily operations

### 🔸 The Nexarii

The guild's body — players of all types, roles, and responsibilities.

- **Veterans:** Trusted, experienced members who support others and lead informally
- **Members:** Full participants in House Nexarii activities
- **Initiates:** New members beginning their time within the guild

## 📖 Guild Lore

"From fractured paths, we converge. From chaos, we forge clarity. Through the Nexus, we become more."

— Inscription at House Nexarii’s first enclave

House Nexarii was formed by those who refused to stand alone, including survivors, builders, strategists, drifters, warriors, traders, and outsiders. Bound by choice, not creed, the Nexarii seek balance through adaptability and collective strength. They crave connection, building systems and networks rather than monuments and thrones.

The House grew from The Prime Nexus, a broader alliance spanning worlds and genres. On Arrakis, the Nexarii take their first unified steps, cautious and curious. While lacking a single patron faction, members study the political landscape carefully, aiming to earn influence through trade, cooperation, and decisive action.

To be Nexarii is to forge your own path while walking alongside others doing the same. The story of House Nexarii is still being written, and you are the ink.

title: Lore Characters
contents:
# Lore Characters

## Content

This section provides information about the characters featured in the lore of the game. The details are sourced from the game's official wiki.

### Important Characters

- **Paul Atreides**: The protagonist of the story, Paul is a young nobleman who becomes embroiled in the political and mystical intrigues of the universe. His journey is central to the unfolding events.

- **Lady Jessica**: Paul's mother, a member of the Bene Gesserit sisterhood. She plays a crucial role in guiding Paul and navigating the complex political landscape.

- **Duke Leto Atreides**: The father of Paul and a noble leader known for his wisdom and integrity. His decisions significantly impact the fate of his family and their allies.

- **Baron Vladimir Harkonnen**: The primary antagonist, a cunning and ruthless leader of House Harkonnen. His schemes and ambitions pose a constant threat to the Atreides family.

### Supporting Characters

- **Chani**: A member of the Fremen, Chani becomes a close ally and love interest of Paul. Her knowledge of the desert and its people is invaluable.

- **Gurney Halleck**: A loyal warrior and mentor to Paul, Gurney is known for his skill in combat and his musical talents.

- **Thufir Hawat**: The Atreides' master strategist and mentat, Thufir is responsible for planning and intelligence operations.

- **Stilgar**: The leader of the Fremen, Stilgar is a wise and respected figure who aids Paul in his quest.

### Plot Overview

The story revolves around the struggle for control of the desert planet Arrakis, also known as Dune. Arrakis is the only source of the valuable spice melange, which is essential for space travel and has numerous other uses. The Atreides family is tasked with overseeing the planet, but they face opposition from the Harkonnens and other factions. As Paul Atreides discovers his destiny, he must navigate political intrigue, warfare, and mystical revelations to fulfill his role in the universe.

### Game Mechanics

- **Resource Management**: Players must manage resources such as spice, water, and military forces to succeed in the game.

- **Strategic Combat**: Engage in tactical battles against rival factions, utilizing unique abilities and units.

- **Character Development**: Progress through the story by developing characters' skills and relationships, impacting the game's outcome.

### Conclusion

The lore characters are integral to the game's narrative, providing depth and complexity to the unfolding story. Understanding their motivations and relationships is key to mastering the game and achieving victory.

## Content

### Guild Summary

Thumpers & Dumpers is a guild with 29 members focused on exploration, trade, combat, and humor. Recruitment is by application, and the guild operates on PC platforms. English is the primary language, with Scouse also accepted. The guild is active in BST and regional EU timezones. They engage in PvE occasionally and are active in PvP, but do not participate in role-playing. The guild is affiliated with House Atreides.

### Links

- **Discord:** discord.gg/u7zEVhdSyY

## Contents

- Purpose / Ethos
- Recruitment Process
- Ranks/Hierarchy
- Leadership
- Guild Lore
- Known Allegiances or Rivalries
- Other Activities

## Purpose / Ethos

Thumpers and Dumpers operate in the gray zones of the desert, handling tasks too dirty, loud, or risky for Atreides regulars. They excel in distraction, sabotage, spice run ambushes, and body removal. They use thumpers to summon chaos, not just worms. Feared by enemies and tolerated by allies, they are a desert legend. If you hear rhythmic pounding in the dunes, it's not just the worm. If a spice field suddenly goes silent, they've been there. If you wake up surrounded by dumped Harkonnen bodies, thank them later.

## Recruitment Process

**Phase 1: The Desert Gut Check (Initial Screening)**

- **Requirement:**
- Pledge loyalty to House Atreides.
- Know what a thumper is (or convincingly pretend).
- Not be a Harkonnen alt (verification required).

- **Process:**
- Answer three questions:
- Can you handle spice without licking it first?
- Have you ever outrun a worm?
- Would you die for the dump?

**Phase 2: The Spice Trial (Skill Assessment)**

- **Requirement:**
- Join a trial raid or convoy escort.
- Bonus points for creativity with worm bait or grenades.

- **What We Look For:**
- Reckless courage.
- Tactical thinking.
- Ability to thump, dump, revive squadmates, and make it look intentional.

**Phase 3: The Mental Conditioning (Initiation Interview)**

- **You'll Be Asked:**
- Preferred body disposal method.
- Favorite Atreides quote (wrong answers encouraged).
- Worm size preference (purely philosophical).

- **Optional:**
- Impress the recruiter with a haiku about spice or explosions.

**Phase 4: Oath of the Dump (Final Initiation)**

- **Swear the Oath:**
- “By spice and sand, by worm and hand, I thump with pride, I dump with wrath. For House Atreides, I shall act dumb—strategically.”

- **Receive Rank Assignment:**
- Typically start as “Spice Maggot” or “Thumperling”.

- **Disqualifiers:**
- Simping for the Baron.
- Poor desert fashion.
- Bringing ornithopters into worm territory and acting surprised.

## Ranks/Hierarchy

- **Spice Daddy:**
- Top leaders of the guild. Final say and the spiciest takes.

- **High Thumper:**
- Master tactician and recruiter. Keeps the worm dancing and the raids thumping.

- **Sand Slinger:**
- Field commander in charge of PvP or operations. Likely covered in spice and blood.

- **Dumper Prime:**
- Logistics and morale officer. Manages gear, spice runs, and keeps things dumb (in the best way).

- **Thumperling:**
- Fresh meat. Barely knows which end of the worm eats. Joined while high on spice. Likely to die in the tutorial.

## Leadership

To Be Confirmed

## Guild Lore

Born from the dusty chaos of Arrakis, Thumpers and Dumpers started as a ragtag band of spice smugglers, ex-mercenaries, and failed ornithopter pilots. Known for accidental explosions and worm baiting rather than tactical finesse, they caught House Atreides' attention during early operations on Arrakis. After leading a sandworm through a Harkonnen spice convoy, they were unofficially adopted as an expendable-but-effective strike unit. Duke Leto, impressed by their unorthodox success and disregard for safety, granted them Atreides colors, with the condition they never attend formal events.

## Known Allegiances or Rivalries

To Be Confirmed

## Other Activities

**Code of Conduct:**

- The spice must flow—but only into Atreides hands.
- Leave no ally behind (unless too heavy, then mark them with a flag).
- Always thump before you dump.
- Never trust a quiet sandworm.
- If it's shiny, it's probably Harkonnen—and probably explodes.

The Graben is a location in the game **Dune: Awakening**. It is a significant area where a large portion of the population of Arrakis resides. The Graben is characterized as a vast geological ditch formed by the sinking of land due to movements in the crustal layers beneath.

This unique landscape creates stunning visuals, resembling a colossal sunken landmass as if pressed by a giant's foot. The Graben is surrounded by sheer cliffs, which house caves and human structures. # Gamescom 2024

**Categories:** DiscordLore, Events, News

## Content

Gamescom 2024 is scheduled from August 21 to August 25, with the Opening Night Live (ONL) commencing on the evening of August 20 in Cologne, Germany.

Funcom will present the world premiere of **Dune: Awakening** at the event. A 5-minute gameplay trailer will be showcased during ONL. Throughout the event, visitors can explore a booth featuring loot bags and a giant Sandworm display. Additionally, "live gameplay" will be streamed by partner streamers, accompanied by developer commentary in multiple languages.

An in-person **Dune Book Club** session will be held near the event on Saturday, August 24, at 09:00 CEST.

## Opening Night Live

- Unsheltered journeys
- Shield health
- Thumper and rocket launcher

# Closed Beta

## Content

This page is a translated version of the page Closed Beta, and the translation is 5% complete. Outdated translations are marked accordingly.

Currently, 'Dune: Awakening' is under development and conducting several tests in closed beta (CB) under a non-disclosure agreement (NDA).

Since 2022, players have been able to register for beta tests on the official website. The beta tester profile survey was sent on November 14, 2023, to registered individuals via email for beta testing.

Additionally, Funcom included a link to this survey in the FAQ section on its Discord server.

Closed beta tests are currently accessible only on PC and require a Steam and Discord account. Beta testers must sign a confidentiality agreement (NDA) and join a separate Discord server to share feedback with developers.

## Contents

- Horaire
- Invitations
- Test
- Gifts
- Key Sale Scams
- Open Beta
- Post Beta & Rewards
- B.E.T.A Sword
- AWOO Emote
- Memorial Plaque
- Gallery
- References

## Horaire

The closed beta tests are covered by the NDA, so the schedule is not public and depends on feedback/progress from previous tests.

Funcom will not announce when tests will occur, have been completed, or are planned. Receiving an invitation email and signing the NDA is the only way to know.

## Invitations

Invitations for the CB are sent via email from "[email protected]", including a link to sign the NDA.

Once the NDA is signed, Steam keys to download the beta client are sent separately.

It is strictly prohibited to confirm receipt of an invitation, even if you do not sign the NDA, on the official Discord for 'Dune: Awakening'. This only encourages resentment among thousands of others who have not been invited.

Selection criteria are entirely determined by survey responses and the type of feedback required for the test. Longevity or activity on Discord does not affect the chances of receiving an invitation. Within appropriate player groups for tests, selection is random.

However, according to the FAQ, being an active participant and contributing to community building might provide an opportunity to join.

The number of people invited in waves is small but continues to increase over time.

The first test had very few participants in the closed beta, while the second had about four times more. A later test showed a 20-fold increase, although a community manager mistakenly claimed the number was originally 200 times.

Invitations cannot be sent to minors due to the CB tests requiring participants to sign an NDA, a legal document.

## Test

The initial CB experiences were short trials focused on specific features. They were not persistent. Progress wipes occurred frequently. Some features were disabled, and much work was ongoing.

Since June 2024, the closed beta is in a persistent testing phase. This means servers are open 24/7, and testers can explore the full extent of the game.

Testers are specifically asked not to seek or report bugs but to provide crucial feedback on gameplay elements and design.

## Gifts

So far, two beta key giveaways have been conducted: on February 15, 2024, and October 2, 2024.

Giveaways are rare, and only "a few dozen" lucky Discord server members won and received invitations during the first draw. "A few hundred" people won the second draw and received invitations. More may occur in the future, but no confirmation has been made.

## Key Sale Scams

Due to the rarity and desirability of CB access, many key-selling websites offer the chance to buy Steam keys or entire Steam accounts with closed beta access. These scams are widespread.

Funcom has a system linking beta client keys to the specific tester's email, Steam, and Discord accounts they were assigned to. Revoking keys at the end of each test makes selling these keys truly pointless, as they are temporary.

## Open Beta

Tests will continue during the Closed Beta until the Open Beta, which will be more appealing due to completed features. However, there is no indication of a date for the Open Beta.

## Post Beta & Rewards

The Closed Beta Tests ended shortly before the full release of the game on June 5, 2025 (the early headstart date for Deluxe/Ultimate Edition preorders). At that point, all testers are permitted to disclose their participation in the beta testing and give their general opinions of the game. However, all events that occurred during the beta testing and any screenshots/videos/discussions of previous, unreleased versions of the game are still covered by the NDA agreement.

For their participation, testers are granted cosmetic rewards. The exact criteria for these rewards are not publicly disclosed.

### B.E.T.A Sword

The B.E.T.A. Sword is a mesh variant (skin) for the CHOAM Sword. It is awarded to all participants of the closed beta tests.

Handed to those who know the pain of broken worlds, desynched characters, disappearing vehicles, and the eternal hunt for Skorda. We salute you.

### AWOO Emote

During the beta, there was a placeholder text-to-speech NPC dialogue for an Atreides captain giving a rousing speech for the troops. However, the voice lines were delivered in an incredibly flat tone, pronouncing "A-TRAY-A-DEEZ", and finally chanting "Awoo". This quickly became a meme of legend among the beta testers and was enshrined as an emote, featuring the infamous "Awoo" placeholder line. This emote is awarded to many participants of the closed beta test.

Legends come and go. A regiment long lost to the sands of Arrakis - none remember their names, their faces, their ranks, or their mission. But their salute lives on, forever preserved in this legendary emote.

### Memorial Plaque

The rarest reward is the Memorial Plaque, a wall-hanging decorative plaque with Galach engraving which reads:

**IN MEMORY OF THE BASES WE LOST**

Very few testers were awarded this decoration, making it one of the rarest items in the game.

None of these cosmetic rewards are attainable now. They are exclusive and personal tokens of appreciation from the dev team to the dedicated group of players who helped improve the game over an 18-month period.

contents:
# Reddit AMA 2025-05-06

**Categories:** PreBeta

## Content

On May 6, 2025, the Funcom developers hosted an "Ask Me Anything" session on the r/duneawakening subreddit. Below are some of the questions and answers, including new information.

The developers answering questions were:

- Joel Bylos - Creative Director
- Scott Junior - Executive Producer
- Viljar Sommerbakk - Senior Game Director
- Kamil - Community Manager

## Questions and Answers

### Will we be able to transmog armor, and can we hide helmet and cape?

The game features an extensive transmog system allowing you to alter visuals on the fly. You can switch armors of the same type, such as Heavy to Heavy, Light to Light, and Stillsuit to Stillsuit, with some exceptions like social visuals. Helmets can be hidden, and the eyes of ibad can be toggled, but cloaks cannot be hidden.

### Will builders be able to acquire both Harkonnen and Atreides building styles without betrayal?

The current plan is to allow access to both styles. If not available at launch, it will be added shortly afterward.

### Are there makers marks on items/gear you have crafted?

At launch, crafted items will not display the maker's name.

### If I build a base on a cliffside, can another player build directly above me?

No, players cannot build a base directly above or below another on the same cliffside.

### What happens if a layer has 200 people allocated, but 180 don't log in?

If 180 people don't log in, others can. The server limits are based on concurrency and activity, not a character cap.

### Will it be possible to transfer a character permanently to another Hagga Basin?

This functionality will be added after launch. During the Beta, you can visit another Hagga Basin but cannot claim land there.

### Is there any copyright protection on original base blueprint designs?

Currently, there is no protection for base designs. This is a complex issue in a freeform building system.

### Can we show the backpack or fremkit throughout gameplay?

No, the character team chose cloaks over backpacks, although specific outfits may include backpacks.

### Any chance of limiting the number of weapons on the hotbar?

At launch, you can place 8 weapons on the hotbar. Improvements may be considered post-launch.

### Will there be a way to re-customize your character after creation?

This feature is planned for a post-launch update.

### Can we betray once total, or once per faction?

You can betray once per faction.

### Will the Third Faction get a Build set too?

Yes, the Third Faction will receive a Build set.

### Are there measures to prevent bigger clans from snowballing compared to small clans?

Features like friendly fire for guilds and no name tags are in place to make it harder for large groups to dominate.

### Can we loot containers in the Deep Desert after a successful raid?

You cannot loot player containers without permission, but you can destroy them to take their contents.

### How does Spice factor into the game’s economy?

Spice is extremely valuable, fueling special abilities and required for higher-tier crafting. It is essential for the Landraad, with spice delivery being the only consistent delivery appearing weekly.

### Will I be able to decorate my base with palm trees?

Plants will not be available at launch, but projections of plants can be placed.

### Will Dune Awakening be available on Game Pass?

At launch, the game will only be available on Steam for PC.

### Would it be possible to introduce snap to grid for placement of items inside bases?

This feature is being considered for post-launch.

### Will there be an option to preload for launch day?

Yes, preloading will be available.

### Can you take a vehicle and loot back to your server when visiting a friend?

You can bring your sandbike stored in the Vehicle Backup Tool, but cannot store vehicles with loot in their inventory. You can only bring back items in your character inventory.

### How might a guild set up a base for members across multiple Hagga Basins?

- The owner sets permissions, and co-ownership can be assigned for others to manage permissions.
- Guilds can choose to have all members in a single Hagga Basin to avoid using the visiting system, but risk hitting the cap if all members are online simultaneously.
- Ensure guild members create characters on the same world and use the visiting system.

### Guild Summary

The AshKar Legion is a player guild established on February 2, 2020. It focuses on legion activities and recruits members through an application process. The guild operates on PC and primarily communicates in English, catering to players in the CET timezone. It engages in both PvE and PvP activities but does not participate in role-playing. The guild is associated with the Major House Corrino.

## Purpose/Ethos

The AshKar Legion is dedicated to building a strong, competitive foundation for players passionate about Dune: Awakening. The guild aims to foster a high-performance PvP environment where dedication, discipline, and strategic coordination are paramount. Members are encouraged to excel in both individual and team-based combat.

The guild emphasizes high activity in PvP events, territorial control, and organized team play. Members are expected to hone their skills and contribute to the guild's overall strength. The guild encourages the formation of smaller combat groups that operate independently but remain integrated into the broader guild structure. Leadership and initiative are valued at every level.

The guild's mantra, "A strong member is an independent member—but he never stands alone," reflects the belief that while players should strive for self-sufficiency, true strength comes from unity and collaboration.

## Recruitment Process

To join the AshKar Legion, prospective members can contact MacFie or Arsenic via private message on the Dune: Awakening Discord server or join the AshKar Discord server. Alternatively, they can post on the Guild Recruitment tab of the Dune: Awakening Discord.

The recruitment process includes:

1. **Interview:** A text-based interview to assess suitability for the guild, focusing on experience in PvP and survival games.
2. **Information:** Provision of information about the guild's structure and plans.
3. **Survey:** Completion of a survey with relevant information.

Upon completing these steps, new members are welcomed into the guild.

## Ranks/Hierarchy

- **Commander:** The supreme authority overseeing all operations, strategy, and doctrine. The Guild Leader is the final voice on loyalty, deployment, and internal order.
- **Quartermaster:** Manages acquisition, maintenance, and distribution of weapons, armor, and gear, ensuring battle readiness with advanced technologies.
- **Battlemaster:** Chief combat instructor and field commander, responsible for training regimens and leading elite strike teams.
- **Foreman:** Oversees infrastructure and logistical support, managing internal labor divisions and facility maintenance.
- **Diplomat:** Handles sensitive assignments involving alliances and negotiations, operating under strict secrecy.
- **Recruiter:** Selects and tests potential initiates, acting as talent scouts and psychological profilers.

## Leadership

The guild is guided by experienced leadership, fostering a collaborative environment for players to connect and forge partnerships. Members have competitive backgrounds in hardcore PvP titles like Conquerors Blade, ARMA, Rust, and Ark, with many having years of experience and success in PvP.

## Guild Lore

The AshKar Legion is an elite subdivision of the Sardaukar, loyal to House Corrino. Known for their discipline and martial prowess, the AshKar are a secretive unit handpicked from the most promising Sardaukar initiates. They undergo harsh conditioning on Salusa Secundus, a prison planet that breeds formidable warriors.

The AshKar diverged from the Sardaukar in purpose and method, focusing on absolute devotion rather than conquest. They operate with autonomy under the Emperor's command, specializing in asymmetric warfare, infiltration, and psychological operations. Their allegiance is solely to House Corrino, serving as a vigilant instrument of Imperial power.

## Known Allegiances or Rivalries

For diplomatic discussions, contact Arsenic or MacFie via Discord. The guild maintains allegiances and rivalries, details of which can be discussed privately.

## Other Activities

The AshKar Legion engages in various activities, contributing to the dynamic and strategic environment of Dune: Awakening.

title: Dune Awakening Direct
contents:
# Dune Awakening Direct

**Categories:** News, PreBeta

## Content

Dune: Awakening Direct is a series of showcases live-streamed by Funcom on their Twitch and YouTube channels. Hosted by Soe Gschwind, the series will announce new information about the game. It is set to start alongside the release of the latest movie, Dune Part 2.

The teaser image used in the preview announcement shows the stage where the interviews will take place.

## Contents

### Episode 1 - 4th March 2024

1.1 Creating Worlds, from Book to Film to Game
1.2 Survive Arrakis Trailer

### Episode 2 - 20th June 2024

2.1 Alternate Timeline
2.2 Religion and Spirituality
2.3 Character Creation and Start of the game
2.4 Closed Beta Update

### Episode 3 - 29th August 2024

3.1 Gamescom Recap
3.2 Interview with Joel

### References

## Episode 1 - 4th March 2024

The first episode aired on 4th March 2024 at 17:00 UTC. It consisted of two sections: a featurette titled "Creating Worlds, from Book to Film to Game," featuring interviews with Greig Fraser, an academy award-winning cinematographer for Dune: Part 1 and 2, and Funcom Creative Director Joel Bylos. The episode provided insights into bringing the Dune fantasy to life and included a never-before-seen trailer rendered entirely in-game.

### Creating Worlds, from Book to Film to Game

The featurette began with an interview with Joel Bylos, exploring the collaboration between Funcom and Legendary, the producers of the latest Dune films, and how this partnership influenced the game's development. Notable information included:

- The game is developed using Unreal Engine 5, incorporating Nanite and Lumen technologies for advanced graphical fidelity and lighting.
- Assets were shared between the Dune movies and the game, as both used UE5.
- Players initially focus on physical survival, securing water and shelter, traveling by night, and staying in the shade. Later, they transition to political survival.
- Sandworms come in two forms: smaller ones with split jaws that chase players, and larger "ringworm" ones in The Deep Desert that can swallow harvesters and equipment whole. Sandworms cannot be killed, only avoided.
- Early game water sources include Dew Fields and plants, but consuming too many plants can cause vomiting.
- The game features a full leveling system and a Combined Arms system, including melee and ranged weapons, vehicles, and abilities.
- Players choose a mentor during character creation, which determines their starting abilities. Additional abilities can be learned from trainers throughout the world.
- Vehicles such as Sandbikes, Groundcars, and Ornithopters are craftable.
- The game includes a Journey system for overarching story missions and contracts for isolated missions.
- Players can group together for Journeys, Contracts, and combat, with the ability to revive each other.
- The War of Assassins allows players to ally with factions like Atreides and Harkonnen, completing missions to advance through ranks.
- Players can opt out of the Landsraad and choose their own path, even as isolated rock farmers.
- Closed Beta tests have been ongoing for several months, expanding over time.
- The Deep Desert is a PvP area with weekly Coriolis Storms that alter the landscape.
- Players can create and trade Blueprints for buildings, fostering a market for construction.

### Survive Arrakis Trailer

The episode concluded with a new trailer showcasing previously unknown game elements, such as:

- Characters leaving trails and footprints in the sand.
- Split-jaw worms chasing players and roaring near rocks.
- Using lasers to melt blue ore for resource gathering.
- A mining system with a bright blue line for effective resource collection.
- Crafting a stillsuit using a fabricator.
- Placing windmills or windtraps.
- A spaceship crash leaving a smoke trail, with players gathering loot at the site.
- A large ship overhead with spotlights hunting players.
- Horizontal cliff face climbing.
- Deploying Hunter Seeker drones with infrared vision to highlight enemies.
- Various underground facilities like research and eco labs.
- Mining lasers cutting wrecked ornithopters.
- Personal antigrav systems allowing players to levitate like jetpacks.
- A trading settlement with stalls selling goods.
- A "spice vision" scene with players having bright blue/purple eyes.
- Binoculars for distant viewing.
- Large-scale battles with numerous characters and vehicles.
- Crawling after battle.

## Episode 2 - 20th June 2024

The second episode aired on 20th June 2024 at 17:00 UTC, hosted by Soe Geschwind. It featured several sections, including a reshowing of the story cinematic from GDC, an interview with Joel Bylos about the story and game lore, Lea Talbot discussing Religion and Spirituality, Nils Ryborg on character creation, and Joel's update on Closed Beta tests and server infrastructure.

### Alternate Timeline

- Paul does not exist in this timeline, allowing players more agency.
- Jessica becomes a Truthsayer due to her choices.
- Atreides are prepared for the battle of Arrakeen and remain in conflict with the Harkonnens.
- Ariste, Jessica's daughter, has her own story and is mentored by the Bene Gesserit, who plan to marry her to Feyd Rautha.
- Duke Leto petitions the Landsraad after the battle, and the Emperor allows The War of Assassins to continue, confined to Arrakis.
- The Spice Must Flow remains a central theme.
- The Fremen are missing, with Imperial propaganda claiming their extermination.

### Religion and Spirituality

- A major story element involves finding the Fremen.
- The absence of Fremen creates a power vacuum, with other powers rising to fill the gap.
- The game offers more story than a sandbox, but engagement is optional.
- Players encounter lore characters who die in the original timeline, like Duke Leto.
- Developers work closely with Legendary and the Herbert estate to adhere to source material.
- A comprehensive lore timeline exists for the game.
- Players are not the Mahdi and must embrace Arrakis's chaos.
- Arrakis remains a harsh world for training the faithful.
- No clear dominant force exists in the War of Assassins, offering players opportunities to influence the war.
- Fremen Cultists have twisted their original ways.
- Players use Spice to awaken and undergo the Fremen Trial of Aql to master the sands.
- Religion and Spirituality are wielded as weapons in the main Dune story, but how Sleepers use them is yet to be seen.

### Character Creation and Start of the Game

- Character customization is in-depth, with presets and numerous options.
- The Reverend Mother interviews players to determine their character's background.
- Players choose a planet, such as Caladan, and a cast, like Na Familia.
- An initial mentor, such as Mentat, sets the starting ability.
- The Reverend Mother administers the Gom Jabbar test.
- Players begin on Arrakis as Bene Gesserit agents seeking the Fremen and "Finding the Sleeper."

### Closed Beta Update

- The closed beta test is now in Persistent Beta, running 24/7.
- Testers play the game from start to finish, forming groups and providing feedback.
- Testers have encountered bugs, such as being unable to move upon logging in.
- More gameplay will be shown, especially the revamped combat system.
- The beta is expanding, with more players invited throughout the year.
- The game is an open-world MMO with many players in the same persistent world.
- The MMO server architecture includes multiple maps within the same world, deviating from the traditional one-server-one-world model.
- The starting server is Hagga Basin, an instanced survival map where players can see friends.
- Once players have a thopter, they can travel to the overland map to see other players outside their dimension.
- Two social maps, Harko Village and Arrakeen, are in a state of Guild Peace, with non-combat zones.
- Bars allow players to dance, and CHOAM exchanges enable trading.
- The Deep Desert spans at least 500 km² and includes a PvE space to prevent spawn camping.
- The Coriolis storm weekly wipes the Deep Desert in the Shifting Sands mechanic.
- The overland map facilitates easier expansion, moving away from the one-server-one-map paradigm.
- Funcom will showcase live gameplay at Gamescom.

## Episode 3 - 29th August 2024

The third episode aired on 29th August 2024 at 17:00 UTC, featuring extended gameplay and interviews, hosted by Soe Gschwind.

- Harkonnen style is dark and HR Geiger-like.
- Atreides style is more castle-like.
- Combine styles for expression, a game pillar.
- Floursand is soft, fine-grained, and white, used for crafting.
- Static Compactors collect floursand/spice but attract worms.
- Spice and Floursand can be gathered by hand or compactor.
- Harvesters are more effective.

#### Expand

- Spice is abundant; inhaling it induces spice visions.
- Spice residue is used for crafting fuel.
- Spice is crucial for endgame crafting and paying taxes for bases.
- Spice is the primary currency for power in the Landsraad.
- Spice can be sold for large sums.
- Combat techniques involve push-and-pull dynamics.
- Shigawire claw and knee charge for enemy traversal.
- BG Voice pulls enemies toward players.
- Suspensor allows slow falls or near-flight like Baron Harkonnen.
- Momentum can be used with shigawire claw, dance, and suspensor.

#### Control

- Players can choose not to engage with the Landsraad or join factions, but it will be present.
- Players can assist those aligned with factions.
- Atreides have an 'AWOO' battle cry.
- Players can leave factions and betray oaths to the Red Duke, though consequences may follow.

- Beta updates continue, with more players added soon, but no news on open beta testing yet.

## Purpose / Ethos

The community wiki aims to provide accurate, up-to-date, and comprehensive information about Dune: Awakening. It supports all players by covering gameplay mechanics, factions, crafting, PvP/PvE strategies, lore, builds, patch notes, and community resources. This wiki is built by the players, for the players.

## Recruitment Process

To join House and Echoes of the Forgotten:

- **Join the Discord:** Enter via the provided link.
- **Read the Welcome & Rules:** Familiarize yourself with the guild culture, values, and expectations.
- **Select Your Roles:** Choose your gameplay focus and timezone in the roles channel.
- **Introduce Yourself:** Post a quick intro in introductions, sharing your playstyle or background.
- **Wait for Council Acknowledgment:** A guild leader or officer will welcome you and assign your full member role.

## Ranks/Hierarchy

- **Shai’tan:** Guild Founder, overseeing all operations and vision.
- **Naib:** Guild Leader, commanding in diplomacy and war.
- **Council of Dust:** Officers handling recruitment, strategy, squad coordination, and community management.
- **Sandborn:** Veteran members with proven loyalty and skill.
- **Exiled Allies:** Friends, supporters, and non-guild members in the extended network.

## Leadership

- **Shai’tan:** Founder and final voice of the guild, setting overall direction, lore, and tone.
- **Naib:** Guild leader overseeing daily operations, coordinating with squads, and leading major decisions.
- **Council of Dust:** Core leadership team managing recruitment, events, PvP/PvE operations, diplomacy, and member support.

## Guild Lore

**House of the Forgotten**

Long before the spice ran freely and the Great Houses carved up Arrakis, there was the Forgotten. Once of noble blood, exiled after a failed uprising against the Landsraad's corruption, they were stripped of titles and left to rot. Yet, they endured, mastering the ways of the desert and making allies of the sandworms. They do not bend the knee to Atreides, Harkonnen, nor CHOAM. They are watchers, warriors, traders, and tacticians, striking with purpose and vanishing without a trace.

**Echoes of the Forgotten**

Echoes of the Forgotten emerged as a twin soul, formed in the reverberation of ancient power and resilience. They represent a continued uprising of the discarded and overlooked, expanding their reach across the sands and into the Deep Desert. Their presence hums like the thrum of a distant ‘thopter, rising with each step into the spice winds.

## Known Allegiances or Rivalries

- House Atreides

## Other Activities

- **Exploration & Recon:** Scout uncharted regions and share map intel.
- **Trading & Crafting:** Contribute to the guild economy through resource gathering and spice trading.
- **Base Building & Defense:** Help construct and defend the guild stronghold.
- **Roleplay & Lore Nights:** Participate in immersive story-driven events.
- **Training Sessions & Drills:** Hone combat skills in friendly PvP skirmishes.
- **Community Events:** Engage in social hangouts, contests, and game nights.

The Secundus Syndicate was established on June 2, 2025, and currently has over 15 members. The guild focuses on combat and business activities. The guild engages in inspections, operations, and war activities, and supports both PVE and PVP play styles. Role-playing is also encouraged. The guild is affiliated with the Major House Harkonnen.

### Purpose / Ethos

The Secundus Syndicate aims to dominate the spice fields on Arrakis and become the leading military force on the planet, serving House Harkonnen. Members can contribute by fighting on the frontlines, developing new tactics and technology, or defending internally. The ultimate goal is to achieve complete control over Arrakis.

Recruitment is completely open. Cadets can join by accepting an invitation and can advance in rank by demonstrating their abilities. Some divisions may require tryouts or applications.

The guild employs a structured hierarchy with fielded ranks. The ranks include:

- **Commander (M/S):** Equivalent to Colonel/Captain, responsible for planning and directing operations.

### Guild Lore

Founded by Governor "Purpose," the Syndicate began small but grew strong through military control of resources. The current objective is to seize control of all spice fields on Arrakis by any means necessary.

### Known Allegiances or Rivalries

Eclypse Corp, known as the 1st France Eclypse, was established on December 21, 2021. It boasts a membership of 950 players and is oriented towards both PVE and PVP activities. ### Purpose / Ethos

Eclypse Corp is recruiting for Dune Awakening. The guild aims not just to follow the story but to create it. It seeks to establish a solid and enduring presence, akin to a sturdy house in the desert.

**Ambitions:**
- Build a well-organized and strong guild.
- Control essential resources.
- Become a major player in commerce and combat.
- Grow together and make a name on Arrakis.

## Purpose / Ethos

Casa Coriolis is a disciplined, strategic, and organized brotherhood focused on mastering the Deep Desert. Our goal is to maintain territorial control, protect our resources, and develop a solid PvP and PvE structure under the House's order. The storm is our territory; discipline is our strength.

## Recruitment Process

We seek active and committed players, both new and experienced. Joining requires:

- Completing a brief registration on Discord
- Accepting the internal rules of the House
- Actively participating in operations and logistics
- Maintaining constant voice communication during organized activities

**Guild Summary:**
- **Established:** June 10, 2025
- **Focus:** PvP
- **Recruitment:** Open
- **Platform:** PC
- **Language:** LATAM Spanish
- **Timezones:** UTC -3
- **Activities:** PvP/PvE content, tactical combat, organized groups, guild activities (LANDSRAAD), teamwork emphasis
- **Play Style:** PvE and PvP focused, no RP
- **Major House:** Atreides
- **Discord:** Mandatory for operations

- **Faction:** House Atreides
- **Region:** South America
- **Server:** Balut
- **Style:** Serious, organized, and committed
- **Communication:** Discord mandatory for operations
- **Suitable for new players**

If you are looking for a team that prioritizes communication, consistency, and results, this is the right place. Send a message to join or inquire.

## Ranks/Hierarchy

**Hierarchy of Casa Coriolis**

1. **Naib**: Supreme leaders of the House. Responsible for strategic decisions, diplomacy, and the organization's destiny.

2. **Bashar**: Squad commanders and operation leaders. Coordinate raids, logistics, and administration of the House's various fronts.

3. **Fedaykin**: Trusted veterans, elite warriors. They form the most experienced combat core and the main line of defense.

4. **Soldiers**: Active combatants. Participate in daily operations, relocations, raids, and general guild tasks.

5. **Members (Initiates)**: New recruits in training. Learn the House's mechanics and discipline and begin integrating into operations.

## Leadership

The leadership of Casa Coriolis consists of a principal Naib and a group of Bashar who coordinate various combat, logistics, and strategic operations fronts. All important decisions are made by consensus under the principle of order and survival. Any Member has the opportunity to grow within the house.

## Guild Lore

Born in the depths of the Desert, Casa Coriolis was formed under the storm as a symbol of order within chaos. While others succumb to the sand, we build power. Our strength lies in discipline, mastery of the storms, and absolute control of the deep desert's resources. We are Casa Coriolis: witnesses of the storm, guardians of the sand.

## Known Allegiances or Rivalries

## Other Activities

**Functional Roles of Casa Coriolis (Maximum 3 per player)**

These are the roles players can choose based on their interest, play style, and contribution to the guild:

- **Assault (PvP Raids)**: Active participation in attacks, base defense, and territorial control. The first to enter battle.

- **Base Defense**: Protection and surveillance of structures and resources during relocations or conflicts.

- **Scout / Explorer**: Reconnaissance of positions, relocation routes, threat detection, and enemy scouting.

- **Logistics**: Responsible for organizing relocations, resource transportation, and base preparation during storms.

- **Builder**: Specialists in construction, base optimization, defensive structures, and sietch organization.

- **Trade / Economy**: Resource management, trade among members, and guild material administration.

- **Gathering / Farming**: Focused on spice extraction, mineral resources, and important drops from the Deep Desert.

- **Coordination / Strategy**: Members with good tactical skills who collaborate in operation planning alongside the Bashar.

# SCRAP METTLE: Belated Delivery

**Categories:** Beta, Hagga Basin South Contracts

## Information

**Chain:** Scrap Mettle

**Issuer:** Sarem Urchok

**Contract Board:** Not available

**Tasks:** 1

**XP Reward:** 150

**Solaris Reward:** 1500

**Next Contract:** SCRAP METTLE: Wrecking Crew

## Content

SCRAP METTLE: Belated Delivery is a contract located in Hagga Basin South. It is similar to SCRAP METTLE: Copper Required but is obtained by looting an item from a Scavenger camp in Hagga South, where Nasir presumably lost the contract.

## Contents

- Chain
- Description
- Task
- Rewards
- Completion
- Tips
- Trivia
- References

### Chain

The Scrap Mettle contract series includes:

- SCRAP METTLE: Belated Delivery
- SCRAP METTLE: Copper Required
- SCRAP METTLE: Wrecking Crew
- SCRAP METTLE: Fremen Finds
- SCRAP METTLE: Testing Limits
- SCRAP METTLE: Bike Building

### Description

Nasir, I'm not sure if you understand the concept of a contract. It goes like this: You deliver the goods to the contracts board at Griffin's Reach Tradepost. You pick up your payment from that same board. It has been weeks. Power up your cutteray and get me that copper ore!

### Task

Deliver 40 units of Copper Ore to the Contract Board at Griffin's Reach Trading Post.

### Rewards

- **150 XP**
- **1500 Solaris**

Completing this contract unlocks Step 2: Wrecking Crew, as well as Courier Run at Griffin's Reach Trading Post.

### Completion

Finally! I’ve waited weeks for that copper! It’s difficult to run an efficient scrap business when the quality of salvage contractors keeps dropping. Nothing but unreliable slackers, like Nasir! He’s probably passed out in a semuta den somewhere. Anyway, you’ve proven you can deliver, so maybe you can do something else for me. Both sides in this war constantly need replacement parts for damaged vessels. A good source for those parts are the wrecks of ships that didn’t make it home. One of those, the Alcyon, came down not far from Griffin’s Reach. The wreck is sure to hold a Holtzman Amplifier or two. If you can find one, I might be able to start a bidding war.

### Tips

Copper Ore is fairly abundant in Hagga Basin South. Simply use a Cutteray to gather some.

### Trivia

Nasir is a reference to Ea-nāṣir, a Mesopotamian copper merchant and recipient of one of the first known written complaints for selling low-quality copper.

# References

1. Complaint tablet to Ea-nāṣir (Wikipedia)

## Content

### Guild Summary

The Spiceborn Syndicate is a player guild established on January 1, 2025, with 25 members. The guild focuses on combat, exploration, trade, and PvX activities. Recruitment is open, and the guild operates on the PC platform, primarily in English and within the North America East timezone. The guild engages in both PVE and PVP activities and supports role-playing. It maintains a neutral stance regarding major houses.

### Purpose / Ethos

In the vast, treacherous sands of Arrakis, only those who embrace the chaos of the spice endure. Spiceborn Syndicate is more than a guild—it is a brotherhood forged in the crucible of survival, wealth, and warfare. Members are traders, smugglers, mercenaries, and warlords bound by ambition and loyalty.

**Purpose:** To control the flow of spice, amass power, and carve a legacy into the dunes. Through diplomacy, force, or cunning strategy, the Syndicate remains a dominant force in the political and economic landscape of Arrakis.

**Ethos:**

- **Spice is Power:** Control resources to strengthen influence.
- **Honor Among Syndicates:** Loyalty and unity make the guild unstoppable; betrayal is met with swift justice.
- **Strength in Strategy:** Every move is calculated, every battle fought with purpose.
- **Adapt and Overcome:** Embrace change and turn obstacles into opportunities.

Joining the Spiceborn Syndicate means becoming part of a force that thrives in the sands, shaping the fate of Arrakis itself.

### Recruitment Process

Joining the Spiceborn Syndicate is straightforward:

- **Join our Discord:** This is the hub for communication, strategy, and community.
- **Engage with the Syndicate:** Get to know fellow members, participate in discussions, and stay active.
- **Prepare for the Game Launch:** Organize roles, alliances, and operations once Dune: Awakening releases.

No formal applications or trials—just be active, contribute, and prove loyalty to the Syndicate. The spice must flow!

### Ranks/Hierarchy

**Spiceborn Syndicate Hierarchy:**

- **Muad’Dib:** Guild Leader, final authority on all decisions.
- **Naibs:** Officers handling wars, diplomacy, and management.
- **Sietch Elders:** Veteran advisors, mentors, and strategists.
- **Warmasters:** Lead smaller warbands in organized attacks, defenses, and tactical missions.
- **Harvester Overseers:** Organize and protect spice shipments, ensuring trade routes remain open.
- **Fedaykin:** Elite fighters, raid leaders, and assassins.
- **Sietch Defenders:** Guild protectors, base guards, and reinforcements.
- **Harkonnen Hunters:** Bounty killers, spies, and sabotage specialists.
- **Spice Harvesters:** Gatherers and refiners of spice.
- **CHOAM Traders:** Barterers, black-market dealers, and wealth managers.
- **Crafters:** Gear/Base builders, engineers, and logistics specialists.
- **Sandstalkers:** Explorers and map makers.
- **Guild Chroniclers:** Guild historians and lore writers.
- **Bene Gesserit:** RP Writers & Lore Keepers, develop and maintain the history, myths, and traditions of the Syndicate.
- **Newcomers:** Trial members, must prove loyalty and skill.

### Leadership

Details about leadership are not provided.

### Guild Lore

**Origins of the Spiceborn Syndicate:**

"The desert takes the weak, but it forges the strong. We are not born of blood—we are born of the spice."

Before the great houses tightened their grip on Arrakis, before CHOAM controlled the flow of spice, there were those who thrived in the shadows of the shifting sands. Outcasts, smugglers, warriors without allegiance—united not by birthright but by will.

The Spiceborn Syndicate was not forged by noble lineage or imperial decree, but by survival. What began as a loose network of renegades, spice runners, and mercenaries grew into a brotherhood that knew the desert better than the houses who claimed it.

The Syndicate serves one master alone—the spice.

**Our Creed:**

- **The Spice Must Flow:** Control the spice, and you control fate itself. Protect supply lines and strike at those who seek to take what is ours.
- **Strength Through Brotherhood:** No one walks the desert alone. Syndicate members protect their own in battle, trade, or the shadows.
- **The Desert Decides:** The weak are swallowed by the sands. The strong carve their names into history. Power is seized, not waited for.

**Enemies & Allies:**

- **Harkonnen & CHOAM:** The Syndicate wages a shadow war against these powers, striking convoys, stealing shipments, and disrupting control.
- **Atreides & Rebels:** Though not allies, the Syndicate respects those who fight oppression and has brokered uneasy truces when interests align.
- **Fremen Tribes:** The Syndicate honors Fremen ways, sharing a common hatred for the oppressors of Arrakis.
- **Smugglers & The Black Market:** Many members have ties to the deep spice trade, running shipments beyond the reach of the guild and houses.

### Known Allegiances or Rivalries

Details are to be determined.

### Other Activities

Additional activities are not specified.
