title: 14671_Dianne
contents:
**Categories:** Characters in Dying Light 2 Stay Human

Dianne is a **survivor** in Dying Light 2 Stay Human.

## Interactions

### The Essence of Survival

Help Nyra and Dianne in creating a new perfume.

**Conversations:**

**Aiden:** "The essence of survival? What are you talking about?"

**Nyra:** "Wanna find out? Just close your eyes."

**Aiden:** "(Don't close your eyes.) No way. One of you might stab me, for all I know."

**Dianne:** "You bet she would!"

**Nyra:** "Oh, stop it, Dianne."

**Aiden:** "(Close your eyes.)"

**Nyra:** "What do you perceive?"

**Aiden:** "(Sounds) Well, I hear noises..."

**Nyra:** "Yeah, what else?"

**Aiden:** "(Smells) Ugh. Something stinks!"

**Nyra:** "Exactly. The smell. Impulses going straight from the senses to the limbic system. Triggering an emotional response. Memories. The well-being of the mind."

**Aiden:** "But... that smells like... That smells like shit."

**Dianne:** "What did you expect? What do you think people use as fertilizers around here?"

**Aiden:** "Too much information."

**Dianne:** "Sorry."

**Aiden:** "(Who are you?) So, who are you and what are you doing here?"

**Nyra:** "Before the Fall, I used to work in a fragrance manufacturing company. I consider myself lucky to have been professionally active within the only century when the world actually smelled nice. Now... it's back to normal. So... I asked myself - how can I change that? What scent would make people the most happy in this miserable world?"

**Aiden:** "(What's the essence of survival?) I sure hope you don't mean smelling like shit is the essence of survival."

**Nyra:** "Of course not. I have this really exciting idea for a new fragrance. People are gonna pay a fortune for just a whiff. I called it 'Turn me on'. And, it's almost finished. I just need some scraps for the heart note."

**Aiden:** "(Parts?)"

**Aiden:** "(Heart note?) Heart note?"

**Nyra:** "Hmm. The middle note of the perfume. Metal scraps and lavender. That's all I'm missing."

**Aiden:** "Of course. Metal scraps and lavender. The obvious blend."

**Dianne:** "Nyra goes out of her way to be controversial."

**Nyra:** "If you bring me some, I'll tell you everything about my secret formula."

(After obtaining the required parts)

**Aiden:** "Here. Your... ingredients."

**Nyra:** "Hmmm... good. I wish there was more oil on the metal scraps, but..."

**Dianne:** "Oh, Nyra. Can't you just be thankful for what you've got for once? She gives me this shit every day, I swear."

**Nyra:** "Ok, okay... voila, it's ready. Here, smell it."

**Aiden:** "Wow... it smells... it's... oh boy, it's like heaven. What is it?!"

**Nyra:** "Silly little boy. Too young to know, aren't you? It's new car smell!"

**Aiden:** "A- a car?"

**Nyra:** "Are you disappointed? The scent of luxury is the base note, the smell of confidence is the heart note, and the fragrance of risk and adventure is the head note. All you dream about is to turn it on and drive away into the distance. Thanks so much for helping me out. Unlike some people. Here, have this - I rubbed it with 'Turn me on'. This'll remind you to tune in to your sense of smell now and then."

title: 16311_Patches and Updates_Update 1_6_0
contents:
# Dying Light 2 Stay Human Update 16.0

Update 16.0 for **Dying Light 2 Stay Human** was released on September 13, 2022.

## Features

- **New Chapter Agent**: Meet Shen Xiu, also known as The Huntress. She is the newest Chapter Agent and a skilled tracker. Shen Xiu is an expert in ranged weapons and represents the Hunters, a mysterious faction tasked with eliminating the most dangerous Infected. Her pursuit of a new target has brought her to the City.

- **New Enemies**: Encounter the Hag, a dangerous Banshee Variant, and Plaguebearers, human enemies infected by the Hag. The Hag is fast and difficult to hit in close combat, and she can resist daylight and UV light. Plaguebearers appear normal but can be detected with Survivor Sense. Upon death, they release a toxic fog that turns nearby humans into Infected.

- **New Weapons**: Unlock powerful weapons like the Hunter’s Crossbow and Ballista Bow. Melee weapon enthusiasts can enjoy new options like the Basher.

- **New Bounties**: Take on new bounties that challenge you to defeat enemies using traps, ranged weapons, or without taking damage.

- **Revisit Chapter 1**: Content from the first Chapter remains available. Harper, the previous Chapter Agent, offers a new weapon, blueprint, pack, and bounties.

## Game Updates

Following Update 1.5.0, known as the “Community Update,” efforts were made to address bugs and improve gameplay performance.

## Gameplay Updates

- Resolved a glitch that prevented game completion.
- Players can now retrieve regular arrows and bolts after shooting enemies.
- Fixed vendor functionality issues after co-op sessions.
- Player outfits no longer reset after changing gear.
- Resolved issues with consumables disappearing from the inventory, which blocked story progression.
- Fixed spawn location issues during the "A Place to Call Home" mission.
- Resolved issues with sleeping or fast traveling after reaching the second region.
- Additional inhibitors were added for certain cases after a recent update.
- Adjusted the storyline so that Dylan now hands over the GRE Key.
- Fixed a prompt issue during the "Welcome on Board" quest.

## Co-op Updates

- Fixed path collision issues that blocked story progression if a friend obstructed a pathway.

## UI/UX Updates

- Improved performance and visuals of the particle system.
- Enhanced journal performance, reducing quest detail load times.
- Improved background texture quality in vendor and craftmaster menus.
- Fixed appearance issues with some meshes.
- Corrected gear display errors after re-equipping items.
- Improved sound effects for barrels and Molotov cocktails.
- Clarified the Landing Jump description.

## Technical Updates

- Reduced crashes on PlayStation 5.
- Fixed black screen issues after the game intro on PlayStation 5 VRR.
- Resolved corrupted texture issues on PlayStation 5.
- The Municipal Services achievement can now be obtained as usual.
- Fixed crashes when accessing the Player tab in the menu.
- Addressed issues with falling through the map.

**It's Alive!** is a side quest in Dying Light 2 Stay Human.

## Walkthrough

While exploring the rooftops in the northern part of Downtown, Aiden encounters a man named George. George is frustrated because he cannot restore electricity to his apartment. He believes that restoring power is his chance to bring his wife back to life. Aiden offers to help by retrieving the fuses needed for the electricity, which are located inside the building along with several Biters. In gratitude, George promises to give Aiden everything precious he owns.

To proceed, go down to the ground level and activate the switch in the passage through the building. Be cautious, as a nearby electrical box can be easily damaged and cause electrical harm. Once the switch is activated, George will claim that Megan is alive again. Aiden should then visit George's apartment to check on him.

Upon arrival, it becomes evident that Megan is not physically present. The electricity merely powered the answering machine, which played a saved voicemail from Megan. As a reward for Aiden's help, George offers some jewelry. Aiden can choose to either accept the jewelry or leave it with George. Either choice will complete the quest.

title: 14679_Kevin
contents:
# Categories: Characters in Dying Light 2 Stay Human

**Kevin** is a child and a survivor who appears in Dying Light 2 Stay Human.

## Interactions

### The Breadwinner

Help Kevin in collecting food for his parents from a Forsaken Store.

## Conversations

**Aiden:** "Hey little guy. Where are your parents?"

**Kevin:** "I'm not little!"

**Aiden:** "Okay... sure. What are you doing here alone?"

**Kevin:** "I'm on an important mission."

**Aiden:** "A mission, huh? What kind of mission?"

**Kevin:** "Secret mission, of course. Super secret. And I ain't tellin' you!"

**Aiden:** "Would you tell me if I offered to help?"

**Kevin:** "I don't need any help, but if you gotta know I'm fetching food for my parents. I do it all the time. No biggie."

**Aiden:** "Seems dangerous. Couldn't your parents at least come with you?"

**Kevin:** "Nope. Like I said. No biggie. I can handle it. I can handle anything."

**Aiden:** "Hey, listen. You're incredibly brave, but I'd really like to help."

**Kevin:** "I suppose I could bring ya on board. Heck, I can even pay ya. How's that?"

**Aiden:** "So now kids are hiring me? Why not? What are your orders, sir?"

**Kevin:** "There's a shop, on West Horizon Lane, just before you hit the chemical zone. I was loading backpacks with food when those nasties showed up and chased me out. Bring me those backpacks and I'll give you a superweapon. My dad's weapon."

**Aiden:** "So the mission's to get food for your parents."

**Kevin:** "Yes, that's right. And you can deliver it to our home. We live on the edge of the chemical zone. Only place where my parents are safe."

**Aiden:** "Hmm... Would be best to get the backpacks at night, when the infected aren't around..."

**Kevin:** "Sure... If you say so. I don't know. But you'll do it, right?"

**Aiden:** "Can't promise anything. We'll see."

**Kevin:** "Aww... okay. Well, see you soon, hopefully!"

(After obtaining the backpacks)

**Kevin:** "He's here! Finally! Did you get the supplies?"

**Aiden:** "(Give the food without asking.) Right. Here."

**Kevin:** "Awesome! Thanks! Here mom, here dad. Enjoy. Bye now. See you tomorrow. Don't worry, I'll be back to feed you again. And here you go... this is the superweapon. My dad won't be needing it anymore. Thanks again. My parents are also grateful. As you can see."

**Aiden:** "(Ask about the pair of virals.) Hey, listen. Those two... you are aware that you have--"

**Kevin:** "You talking about my parents?"

**Aiden:** "Well... that is... those are your parents?"

**Kevin:** "That's what I said, isn't it? Mom, Dad, look who's here. I told you he wouldn't take the food and run! I know... I know you're hungry."

**Aiden:** "(Give the boy the food.) Right. Here."

**Kevin:** "Awesome! Thanks! Here mom, here dad. Enjoy. Bye now. See you tomorrow. Don't worry, I'll be back to feed you again. And here you go... this is the superweapon. My dad won't be needing it anymore. Thanks again. My parents are also grateful. As you can see."

**Aiden:** "(Tell the boy his parents are virals.) Listen, kid... you know what it means to transform, right?"

**Kevin:** "What do you think, I've been hiding under a rock? Of course I know."

**Aiden:** "That's good. So... your parents. They're not with us anymore. They've transformed."

**Kevin:** "No way... look. Hey, dad, you hungry?"

**Aiden:** "They're virals. That could be dangerous for you."

**Kevin:** "I'll handle them. Meanwhile, let's get down to business. I told you if I hired you for the mission, I'd pay you. Got the food?"

**Aiden:** "Right. Here."

**Kevin:** "Awesome! Thanks! Here mom, here dad. Enjoy. Bye now. See you tomorrow. Don't worry, I'll be back to feed you again. And here you go... this is the superweapon. My dad won't be needing it anymore. Thanks again. My parents are also grateful. As you can see."

# Crane Bundle Overview

The Crane Bundle is a special pack for **Dying Light 2 Stay Human**, released on January 31, 2023. This bundle includes one new weapon, a new skin for the Paraglider, and a new outfit.

## Contents

- **Crane Outfit**: This outfit belonged to special agent Kyle Crane. Known for his empathy, Crane was unable to complete his original mission but played a crucial role in saving many lives during the Harran Outbreak and contributed significantly to the research for a cure.

## Description

Take control and become a savior for the survivors in the infested City, embodying the legendary hero of Harran. The time has come to roam the rooftops, gather supplies, and confront hordes of infected while doing what is right.

Equip yourself with Crane's outfit, use the Spectral Bat to defeat enemies, and utilize the Crane's Paraglider skin to swiftly reach any location where you are needed.

title: 12000_Aiden Caldwell
contents:
# Categories

**Characters in Dying Light 2 Stay Human, Protagonists**

"What do we quote?" Sometimes... You have to become a Monster to Stay Human.

Aiden Caldwell is the playable protagonist of Dying Light 2 Stay Human.

## Biography

Aiden's exact date and place of birth are unknown, but he was likely born in 2013 or 2016, either before or during the Harran Virus pandemic that eventually spread worldwide. His father saved his life when he was young, telling him never to forget who he was or where he came from. Aiden is an unknowingly infected survivor in a dying world, where forming attachments can be deadly.

He is a member of an outcast group known as the Pilgrims, who wander the world and are compared to Japanese Ronin and Old West desperadoes. Aiden claims to have traveled over 2,000 kilometers (1,242 miles) from Crossdale River. His journey leads him to the City in search of his lost sister, Mia, the only person he remembers from his past, who he believes holds the key to unlocking his memories and identity.

## Events of Dying Light 2 Stay Human

After escaping a group of virals in a tunnel, Aiden meets a fellow pilgrim named Spike. They walk through the forest to a mansion, where Spike tells Aiden about a lead on a man named Waltz and advises him to contact an informant at a nearby house. After securing a safe zone, Aiden dreams of being in a hospital with his sister Mia, where they are experimented on, and a fire causes them to be separated.

The next morning, Aiden contacts the informant, who confirms Mia is alive. Aiden heads to the sewer, encounters a volatile, and is bitten. The informant saves him, but Aiden has a seizure and passes out. Upon waking, Aiden hears the informant being interrogated by bandits. After defeating the bandits, the informant gives Aiden a GRE Access Key and instructs him to find Lawan at Fisheye. The informant is killed by Waltz, who then sends his men after Aiden. Aiden escapes and finds an entrance into Villedor.

In the Bazaar, a major faction's home, Aiden is nearly hanged for being infected and without a biomarker. He is saved by Hakon, who injects him with an inhibitor. Despite the injection, Aiden attacks Sarah but is knocked unconscious by Jana. Upon waking, Hakon tells Aiden he needs a biomarker to reach Fisheye. They find a military crate, and Aiden uses the GRE Access Key to open it. Night falls, and Aiden has a seizure but is saved by Hakon. They run to Cillian's Hideout after being turned away from the Bazaar.

At Cillian's hideout, Hakon and Cillian argue before Hakon scouts Saint Joseph's Hospital. Aiden dreams of Mia taunting him before Hakon calls him to meet at the hospital. They sneak past infected, and Aiden finds an inhibitor to climb up to Hakon. After receiving a biomarker, Aiden's low immunity triggers an alarm, and he must escape quickly. Hakon asks Aiden about his plans for finding his sister and shares his own dream of living by the ocean.

## Events of Bloody Ties

Aiden receives a call to qualify for Carnage Hall to stop Skullface from destroying the city. At the tryouts, he meets Roy, Tatsuo, and Ciro, the thief. They fight other competitors and are victorious until Skullface attacks. Skullface shuts off the UV lights, letting virals in. Aiden fights them while Ciro fixes the generators.

Ciro's father, Ogar, scolds him for fighting. Ciro reveals Ogar is the ex-champion of Carnage Hall, and Skullface is the current champion. To qualify for Carnage Hall, Aiden completes three challenges and meets Ciro for drinks after each. Ogar asks Aiden to stop Ciro from fighting. At the final challenge, Ciro disappears, and Aiden wins. Ogar and Aiden find a guard's body, and Ogar sends Aiden to find Ciro at Carnage Hall.

At Carnage Hall, Aiden learns it's a bloodsport event. He fights and wins, gaining a new name from Astrid.

## Skills and Abilities

Aiden is an exceptional survivor with strength, speed, and combat skills. He can perform feats others dare not attempt, similar to Kyle Crane, a survivor of the 2015 Harran pandemic. Aiden was experimented on by Waltz, causing blackouts where he mindlessly attacks others. He gains control over this during confrontations with Waltz.

Aiden can enhance his physical capabilities with Inhibitors, drugs created by the G.R.E. to boost strength and immunity. His unique skills make him an agent of change in Villedor, humanity's last stronghold.

## Appearance and Personality

Aiden is a young Caucasian male in his early 20s, with short brown hair and blue eyes. He has a weary, slightly scarred face and an athletic physique. His main outfit is the Stay Human outfit, consisting of a denim jacket with a red hood, a white T-shirt, running pants, shin guards, and sneakers.

Aiden is friendly and helpful but opportunistic, only assisting others if they can aid him. He is sympathetic and introspective, capable of seeing the bigger picture. As a Pilgrim, he remains neutral in conflicts between factions, focusing on his own goals.

## Trivia

- Jonah Scott, Aiden's voice actor, was a fan of Dying Light and Kyle Crane's voice actor, Roger Craig Smith.
- A running joke in the community is how often Aiden gets punched in the face during quests.
- Aiden was inspired by the DC comic character Nightwing.
- Despite experiments, Aiden cannot permanently turn; he regains his senses by morning.
- Aiden can have a Scarecrow made for him after the Scarecrow Queen quest.
- In cut content, Aiden could lose his hand.
- Aiden's face models differ between in-game and ending cutscenes.

title: 15904_The Deserter
contents:
# Categories: Dying Light 2 Stay Human Side Quests

**The Deserter** is a Side Quest in Dying Light 2 Stay Human.

**Quest Description**: Meyer accused a Peacekeeper named Bart not only of desertion but claimed that he stole a map with top-secret information. If this information got out, it would spell disaster for the Peacekeepers.

## Objectives

## Walkthrough

While on the PK Floating Fortress in The Wharf, at the mission dispatch, Meyer will ask Aiden for help. She mentions that a Peacekeeper named Bart deserted his post after having problems with other soldiers. Bart not only deserted but also stole a "map" which could endanger other Peacekeepers if it fell into the wrong hands. Meyer asks Aiden to return the "map" and leave Bart for her, recommending starting by checking out his bunk a floor above, in the barracks.

Use survivor sense at Bart's bunk, which features a Peacekeeper helmet next to the pillow, a locker, and a Peacekeeper chestpiece. Underneath the top bunk bed is a drawing: Liam's Drawing #1. Upon taking it, a nearby Conscript will ask if Aiden "found something." Approach the man and ask if he knows anything about Bart. He will eventually point Aiden to Stach, over at the Fish Eye Canteen, as he has seen the two together a few times.

Head over to the Fish Eye Canteen in New Dawn Park. Enter the bar and go to the top floor, where Stach can be found leaning on a wooden railing. Aiden will have the option to declare that Bart is a thief or that he is a deserter. If mentioned that he deserted, Stach will be happy for Bart and ask Aiden if he heard anything else, to which the thief option becomes available. Stach will deny the accusation as Bart is an honest man but will say he has had a problem with the other Peacekeepers. He will recommend Aiden go to the fieldworkers on top of a nearby old office building for more intel.

The office building is located just east of the Fish Eye, so head over there and speak to the fieldworkers. Some of them will not provide useful information, but some do. One mentions that Bart has not been in the fields for a while and is probably watching the kid of Andy, Liam, as Bart was doing that a lot recently. He does not know where Andy or Liam are but recommends asking around to find out. Another worker, located at the end of the bridge connecting the two buildings, describes Bart as brave, kind, caring, and loving of children. He mentions Andy again and elaborates that Andy and Bart are best friends. When asked where Bart may be found, the worker recommends going to Andy's home as they were there the night before handing out drinks.

Head over to the building just east of the rooftop plantation and go inside. Jump up a floor and use survivor sense when entering the hall connected to the bedchamber. Here, the fifth drawing of Liam is found on the floor. Enter the room at the end of the hallway and use survivor sense to find the third and fourth drawings on the couch. On the bed, using survivor sense, a playing card addressing a "Steve" can be found. Upon picking it up, a man named Clint will enter the room and believe Aiden to be Bart.

If told Aiden is Bart, Clint will attack. After dealing with Clint, Aiden will contact Stach to ask him about Steve, who is apparently a shady character. Stach will mention knowing Steve and will inform Aiden that he will contact him when he shows up at the Fish Eye. Wait until nightfall and Stach will call Aiden to inform him that Steve is at the Fish Eye. Head over there. Steve can be found leaning against a wall of the bar.

If Clint is told Aiden is not Bart, Clint will ask if Aiden is Andy. If told no again, Clint will explain that he was also hired to find the "map" that Bart stole. Unlike with Stach, working with Clint enables Aiden to approach Steve directly.

When showing him the card, Steve offers Aiden his services. He will deny knowing Bart and Andy, leaving Aiden to either offer an exchange or threaten with the Peacekeepers. If the Peacekeepers are mentioned, Steve will start to panic and eventually admit that Bart and Andy hired Steve to bring them and Liam to the Colonel safely but left him when they ran into a Peacekeeper patrol. He will give directions to where he dropped them off: near an old coffee shop not far from the Fish Eye, by the offramp from the E12.

The coffee shop in question is found in Garrison, just north of GRE Anomaly C-A-55. Head over there and use survivor sense. A dead infected can be investigated in one of the corners of a building, with a weapon still stuck in the body. Use survivor sense to find and follow a nearby trail, which leads to the entrance into a building where the second of Liam's drawings can be found. Climb up the building until it can be entered, then head inside and use survivor sense to further follow the trail.

The trail leads to a door. Upon knocking on it, the deserter, Bart, will open it and demand to know who Aiden is and what he wants. Bart will recognize Aiden and ask if Meyer sent him, to which Aiden responds by saying he was sent to find Bart and retrieve what he stole. Shortly after, Andy will come to the door and ask the two to keep it down. He will state that the "map" is technically not a map but does detail the location of some secret Peacekeeper stash. Bart will state he was planning to use it as payment to the Colonel in return for safe passage for Andy, Liam, and himself. He will ask Aiden to return to Meyer and lie to her by telling Bart and Andy are killed, offering to give him his dog tags and the coded message as proof.

Aiden can either agree to help or decline.

If chosen to help, Andy and Bart will be grateful and give Aiden the required items to fake his death. Before parting with it, they will mention that they will stay at their hideout for now until deciding what to do. If chosen not to help, Bart will fight Aiden and have to be killed. After doing so, head to Andy and ask for the map. He will give Aiden both the "map" and Bart's dog tags and tell Aiden to go.

Regardless of the choice made, a group of bounty hunters will appear on the site. Aiden can either choose to fight or try to avoid it if Clint was partnered with. If Clint was killed or not partnered with, the bounty hunters will attack. Regardless of the choice made, head back to Meyer on the PK Floating Fortress and report about the situation. Aiden can either be truthful and say Bart is alive or say that Bart is dead. If told he is dead, Aiden will say that he had to kill him out of self-defense. If truthful, Aiden will tell Meyer that Bart, Andy, and Liam tried to escape and he let Bart live.

Meyer will then ask if Aiden has the map, to which Aiden can either choose to give or keep it. If chosen to give it, Meyer will be grateful and thank Aiden, finishing the quest. If chosen to keep it, Aiden will deny having it and Meyer will ask what happened to it, to which Aiden responds by saying Bart ditched it, which makes Meyer more frustrated as not knowing where it is could be worse than it falling into enemy hands. Aiden will point out the location where he found Bart as a way to "help" Meyer, who will be annoyed as she will have to bring this news to Jack Matt. Upon ending the conversation, the quest is finished.

title: 12756_Mia
contents:
# Categories

- Deceased
- Characters in Dying Light 2 Stay Human

**Quote:** "Promise you'll never leave me alone here. Never."
**Speaker:** Mia to Aiden when they were little kids

Mia is a major supporting character featured in Dying Light 2 Stay Human. Although she mainly stays in the background for most of the story, Mia is the driving motivation for Aiden Caldwell as he tries to find her after being separated for years, falsely believing Mia was his sister.

## Biography

From what Aiden Caldwell remembers from his childhood, he and Mia were kidnapped when they were both five years old. They were brutally tortured, but the place they were held suddenly erupted in flames, explosions, and chaos. Mia was left behind in the city, but Aiden escaped with soldiers. He blames himself and remains traumatized to this day.

Several years later, Aiden discovers a lead on Mia's whereabouts in the City. He sets off to brave the dangers of the City to reunite with his beloved sister.

However, Aiden's memories were not as accurate as he thought. In reality, he and Mia were not related at all. Mia was the daughter of Vincent Waltz and had been infected with a new unknown strain of the THV virus. The experiments performed on the children at the X13 facility, including Aiden and Mia, were conducted to find a cure not just for the virus but for Mia as well. During this time, Mia and Aiden developed a sibling-like relationship, with Mia giving Aiden a nickname. Her father treated Aiden with kindness despite the nature of the experiments. When part of the facility erupted in flames, Aiden and Mia became separated. For the next 15 years, Waltz continued his research to find a cure for his daughter, while Aiden's memories became muddled, leading him to believe Mia was his sister.

## Death

15 years later, Aiden was finally reunited with Mia. It was then that he learned the truth from Waltz: Mia and Aiden were not related, and she was Waltz's daughter. To prevent anyone from stopping him from finding a cure for Mia, Waltz could not let Aiden stop the nuclear missiles that would destroy Villedor. This led to a confrontation between Aiden and Waltz. After Aiden defeats Waltz, he either tries to save Mia from the laboratory before the missiles explode because of Lawan, or stops Lawan from blowing up the laboratory. Either way, Mia ultimately dies from the strain.

title: 14687_Nyra
contents:

Nyra is a survivor in Dying Light 2 Stay Human.

## Interactions

### The Essence of Survival

Help Nyra and Dianne in creating a new perfume.

**Conversations**

**Aiden:** "The essence of survival? What are you talking about?"

**Nyra:** "Wanna find out? Just close your eyes."

- **Aiden:** "(Don't close your eyes.) No way. One of you might stab me, for all I know."
- **Dianne:** "You bet she would!"
- **Nyra:** "Oh, stop it, Dianne."
- **Aiden:** "(Close your eyes.)"

**Nyra:** "What do you perceive?"

- **Aiden:** "(Sounds) Well, I hear noises..."
- **Nyra:** "Yeah, what else?"
- **Aiden:** "(Smells) Ugh. Something stinks!"
- **Nyra:** "Exactly. The smell. Impulses going straight from the senses to the limbic system. Triggering an emotional response. Memories. The well-being of the mind."
- **Aiden:** "But... that smells like... That smells like shit."
- **Dianne:** "What did you expect? What do you think people use as fertilizers around here?"
- **Aiden:** "Too much information."
- **Dianne:** "Sorry."

**Aiden:** "(Who are you?) So, who are you and what are you doing here?"

**Nyra:** "Before the Fall, I used to work in a fragrance manufacturing company. I consider myself lucky to have been professionally active within the only century when the world actually smelled nice. Now... it's back to normal. So... I asked myself - how can I change that? What scent would make people the most happy in this miserable world?"

**Aiden:** "(What's the essence of survival?) I sure hope you don't mean smelling like shit is the essence of survival."

**Nyra:** "Of course not. I have this really exciting idea for a new fragrance. People are gonna pay a fortune for just a whiff. I called it 'Turn me on'. And, it's almost finished. I just need some scraps for the heart note."

- **Aiden:** "(Parts?)"
- **Aiden:** "(Heart note?) Heart note?"

**Nyra:** "Hmm. The middle note of the perfume. Metal scraps and lavender. That's all I'm missing."

- **Aiden:** "Of course. Metal scraps and lavender. The obvious blend."
- **Dianne:** "Nyra goes out of her way to be controversial."
- **Nyra:** "If you bring me some, I'll tell you everything about my secret formula."

(After obtaining the required parts)

**Aiden:** "Here. Your... ingredients."

**Nyra:** "Hmmm... good. I wish there was more oil on the metal scraps, but..."

- **Dianne:** "Oh, Nyra. Can't you just be thankful for what you've got for once? She gives me this shit every day, I swear."
- **Nyra:** "Ok, okay... voila, it's ready. Here, smell it."

**Aiden:** "Wow... it smells... it's... oh boy, it's like heaven. What is it?!"

**Nyra:** "Silly little boy. Too young to know, aren't you? It's new car smell!"

**Quest Introduction:**
Will asked me to rescue his sister's boyfriend, the menacing Theodore. Will had trapped the man inside a dark zone. Will had his back turned against a wall because his sister was furious with him and announced that she was pregnant with Theodore's child.

**All in the Family** is a nighttime side quest in Dying Light 2 Stay Human.

## Objectives

## Walkthrough

In Trinity, on a rooftop to the east of the Bazaar, two survivors can be overheard in a conversation. The two survivors, Monika and Will, were talking about Theodore, who is Monika's boyfriend and who got lost in a Dark Hollow after Will lured him in there. Monika is upset about the ordeal and demands that Will gets Theodore out again.

Will is hesitant to go as the Dark Hollow is soaked in chemicals, and if those do not kill him, Theodore probably will. As such, Will asks Aiden to rescue Theodore in his stead. Monika also reveals that she is pregnant with Theodore's child. Before Aiden sets off, Monika gives a warning that Theodore can be dangerous.

The Dark Hollow is located roughly 200 meters north of the two survivors, southeast of the 'Alder' Windmill. Head in that direction and look for Theodore in the Dark Hollow on its first floor. Keep an eye open for the Inhibitor container located in the building.

Upon reaching Theodore, his response is hostile. He demands to know who Aiden is. Once Aiden mentions Will, Theodore's aggression switches over to Will. In order to calm Theodore down, Aiden mentions that Monika is pregnant. This works, as Theodore's mood switches when he hears the news and he becomes overjoyed to hear he will be a father. He will ask Aiden for his name because he wants to name his child after him. There are three options: either tell Aiden's name, tell Theodore to name him "Theodore, Jr." or to tell Theodore that he should decide himself.

title: 14107_Skills _Dying Light 2 Stay Human
contents:
# Categories: Dying Light 2 Stay Human

In **Dying Light 2 Stay Human**, players can enhance their "Combat" and "Parkour" skills.

## Summary

- **Health**: Increases your ability to withstand damage from falls or enemy attacks. To boost Health, collect 3 Inhibitors and apply them in the Skills menu.
- **Immunity**: Extends the time you can remain in darkness. Immunity automatically increases each time you level up your Stamina or Health.
- **Stamina**: Enhances your ability to climb higher and fight longer without losing breath. To improve Stamina, collect 3 Inhibitors and apply them in the Skills menu.

Skill trees are divided into "Combat" and "Parkour". You earn skill points in combat by defeating or attacking enemies, and in parkour by climbing or freerunning. Points earned can be doubled during nighttime. Unlike the first game, skill points alone are insufficient to unlock the entire skill tree; you must also level up your stamina and health to access advanced skills. Combat skills require certain health levels, while parkour skills depend on stamina levels.

## Combat

Increase your Combat Proficiency by engaging and defeating enemies. More advanced moves yield more proficiency points.

- **Vault Kick**: Leap over staggered enemies and follow up with a kick.
- **Perfect Dodge**: Dodge precisely to stagger your enemy.
- **Grapple**: Use the momentum of attacking enemies to throw them aside.
- **Grapple Throw**: Enhance the momentum of enemies thrown with Grapple to knock them down.
- **Air Kick**: Deliver a powerful kick when dropping onto enemies from above.
- **Vault Power Kick**: Add force to your Vault Kick to send enemies flying.
- **Head Stomp**: Stomp on enemies lying on the ground.
- **Power Attack**: Execute a powerful attack that deals more damage, interrupts enemy attacks, and blocks.
- **Dropkick**: Perform a powerful kick while jumping.
- **Perfect Parry**: Execute a perfect block to stagger your enemy longer and trigger a slow-motion effect for easier follow-up actions.
- **Block Projectiles**: Block incoming projectiles like knives and arrows.
- **Deflect Projectiles**: Deflect an incoming projectile back to your attacker.
- **Windmill**: Perform a powerful attack that hits all surrounding enemies.
- **Ground Pound**: Execute a powerful attack while mid-air.
- **Stab**: Quickly take down an unaware enemy (requires a knife).
- **Block Charge**: Charge at an enemy while blocking and knock them down.
- **Precise Aiming**: Improve your aim with all ranged weapons.
- **Power Shot**: Adds piercing and bonus damage to all ranged weapon shots.
- **Parkour Shot**: Use ranged weapons while performing parkour.
- **Serial Shot**: Fire up to 3 projectiles simultaneously.
- **Smash**: Smash enemy heads while dropping onto them from above.
- **Smash Jump**: Jump immediately after Smash, allowing for another aerial attack.
- **Stab Followup**: Automatically throw a knife at another enemy after performing Stab (requires a knife).
- **Ledge Takedown**: Quickly take down enemies by pulling them from a ledge.

## Parkour

Increase your Parkour Proficiency by performing actions like jumping, climbing, and sliding. More advanced moves yield more proficiency points.

- **High Jump**: Jump higher to reach elevated ledges.
- **Active Landing**: Reduce fall damage and maintain momentum.
- **Safe Landing**: Increase the height from which you can land without damage.
- **Landing Jump**: Jump instantly from an Active Landing.
- **Firm Grip**: Maintain grip on ledges even when stamina is depleted and briefly hold on when landing from great heights.
- **Fast Climb**: Move faster on ledges when climbing up or sideways.
- **Ledge Jump**: Jump while climbing to ascend more quickly.
- **Far Jump**: Use obstacles to spring and jump further.
- **Double Jump**: Achieve greater heights while jumping off obstacles.
- **Rotate Jump**: Turn 180 degrees during a jump.
- **Sleek Runner**: Increase speed while navigating tricky obstacles like slopes, balance boards, pipes, and wall openings.
- **Slide**: Slide while running to pass through low openings in walls and passages.
- **Slide Jump**: Jump directly from a Slide without losing momentum.
- **Dart**: Temporarily boost movement speed to jump across wider gaps, reach higher ledges, or run longer on walls.
- **Dash**: Dash as long as stamina lasts.
- **Afterboost**: Gain a brief speed burst after specific parkour moves.
- **Stealth Movement**: Increase speed and mobility while sneaking, and gain the ability to perform a Crouch Jump.
- **Crowd Runner**: Run through groups of enemies without losing momentum and reduce damage received.
- **Enemy Jump**: Jump off enemies while in Dart/Dash.
- **Bash**: Bash through obstacles and enemies without stopping.
- **Tic Tac**: Run alongside vertical surfaces.
- **Wall Run**: Run upwards on vertical surfaces.
- **Wall Run Jump**: Jump while performing a Wall Run.
- **Wall Combo**: Combine Tic Tacs or Wall Runs into longer combos.

## Trivia

- **Slide Jump**: Performed by sliding and pressing the button used for Far Jump.
- **Landing Jump**: Triggered by pressing the Active Landing button while midair at any height if you double-tap jump.
- **Kacper's Flip Flops**: Allow Active Landing to be used even if not unlocked.

title: 14651_The Runaways
contents:
**Categories:** Dying Light 2 Stay Human, Dying Light 2 Stay Human Side Quests

**The Runaways** is a side quest in Dying Light 2 Stay Human.

## Objectives

## Walkthrough

While in the northern part of Trinity, Aiden encounters a Peacekeeper named Wash after activating a military container. Wash initially claims to be on a "top secret" mission but quickly reveals that he was supposed to meet a girl from the Bazaar. He explains that they both want to leave Villedor and go beyond the walls.

Wash has not yet informed Chloe that the water supply issue at the Bazaar has been resolved, which was her main reason for wanting to leave. He asks Aiden to visit the house of Chloe's friend, Liz, in case Chloe has gone there. Wash provides directions and ends the conversation.

Liz's house is located on the roof of a building in northeastern Houndfield. Inside, Aiden encounters several Biters and a Viral. After dealing with them, Aiden activates a door to find Liz. However, Chloe is not there, and Liz reveals that Chloe is "gone" and would leave with her instead of Wash. Liz explains that they are tired of the fighting and want to try living elsewhere, using Wash as a means to escape.

When Wash arrives at the apartment, it becomes clear that the "Liz" Aiden spoke to was actually Chloe. Chloe states that Liz does not want Wash to join them, but Wash insists and asks Aiden for support. Aiden is given three options:

### Chloe does as she wants

If Aiden supports Chloe's decision, he tells Wash to let her go. Wash refuses to accept Aiden's decision, claiming his military training makes him more capable than Chloe and Liz. Chloe challenges Wash's assumption that she is helpless without him and tells him to leave. Wash blames Aiden for the situation and departs, completing the quest.

### Everyone dies outside

If Aiden suggests that everyone dies outside the walls, he argues that they won't survive outside, whether it's two or three people. Wash agrees, noting that with the water issue resolved, they might as well stay in Villedor. Chloe insists she wants to leave the city, but when Aiden questions how they will survive without UV lamps or get past the Peacekeepers, Chloe concedes that Aiden is right. She decides to stay but no longer wants to see Wash, as she only contacted him as a means to an end. Wash leaves, blaming Aiden, and the quest concludes.

### Wash is right

If Aiden sides with Wash, he argues that only the three of them have a chance of surviving outside the walls. Chloe expresses doubt, as Liz won't agree due to Wash being a Peacekeeper. Aiden counters that Wash is willing to desert, and Chloe reluctantly agrees to let Wash join them, completing the quest.

title: 14274_Missing Persons _Dying Light 2 Stay Human
contents:
# Dying Light 2 Stay Human Side Quests

**Missing Persons** is a side quest in Dying Light 2 Stay Human.

## Quest Introduction

A guy at the Bazaar named Damien told me about a place to go if I wanted to earn money. It seemed sketchy at best.

## Objectives

## Walkthrough

Near the entrance to the Bazaar in Trinity, a man named Damien can be spoken to. During a brief conversation, he will mention a job offering and tells Aiden where to go to find out more.

The job offering can be found in a building just northeast of the Quarry End-Trinity border, slightly east of Houndfield. Along the way, Aiden will contact Aitor about the deal. The building can be entered from the roof. The guards are shady but tell Aiden to go down a floor for the job. One floor down, an interrogator and his men are found. He will ask some questions but eventually attack Aiden after learning Aiden is not well-known around the Bazaar.

Defeat the interrogator and his thugs, and after defeating them, go back upstairs and head to the exit. Damien is found here, confront him. Damien will deny having anything to do with the murder attempt at first, but will eventually break after a brief conversation. He will explain that the bandits have his brother, Cliff, and only sent people to the bandits to keep him safe. Aiden will be given two choices: either hand Damien over or cooperate with him. Saying he will be handed over will cause a brief fight, after which the quest is completed. Cooperating with Damien will make the quest last longer.

### Cooperate with Damien

If chosen to cooperate, Damien will explain the situation of his brother and how he is tired of being played and just wants his brother back. He asks Aiden for help to achieve this goal. Aiden is reluctant but can agree. Go back downstairs and go to an easy-locked door. Unlock it to clear the investigation mark. Also, check a similar door upstairs to draw the conclusion that Cliff is nowhere to be found.

During the conversation with Damien, he reveals that his brother was captured while the two of them were in east Quarry End, close to Devil's Bridge. Go to that area and investigate. It is located in northeastern Quarry End, on the border with Horseshoe. Enter the building from one of the windows on the roof.

Inside the building are several floors containing Biters and Virals, but also bandits on the lower floor. Deal with them and continue looking for Cliff. Upon activating a door, a cutscene will play featuring Cliff. In conversation, it becomes clear that he has become a bandit himself. He will explain how he and his gang were hired by Waltz to find Aiden and obtain the GRE access key. After the conversation, Cliff calls upon more bandits while he himself moves away. Dispatch the bandits and chase him.

"Damien! Are you still there? Come in, Damien. Can you hear me?" - Aiden

Cliff himself is a boss fight. After defeating him, Aiden will call on Damien but be met with silence. Instead of backtracking through the entire building, there is a pin-locked door that can be opened which leads outside in the room before Cliff was found. Regardless of which exit is chosen, return to the Bazaar and look for Damien.

Once inside the Bazaar, a survivor named Roger can be heard speaking to Damien on Aiden's side of a door. Roger will state that Damien locked himself into the tower of the church. Aiden will have to climb up the side of the church to reach Damien. When leaving the Bazaar, turn south and walk up the planks onto a shed. Turn left and jump to the monkey bars and then onto a wooden ladder from which the lower roof of the church is accessed.

From there, get to the buttress and use the monkey bars to get to another one. Keep following the planks around the church until the bell tower is reached. Once inside, climb up to the top and go back outside. Follow the spaces marked in yellow until Damien is reached.

Damien has become suicidal and, while difficult, can be talked out of it. Choose the dialogue option to talk about life and then follow it up by saying Aiden will jump too. This will keep Damien from jumping. Roger will then show up again, interrupt him. After the conversation is over, it finishes the quest. The alternative results in Damien jumping, also completing the quest.

title: 16118_Patches and Updates_Patch 1_2_0
contents:
# Patch 1.2.0 Overview

Patch 1.2.0 for **Dying Light 2 Stay Human** was released on March 9, 2022. This update includes a variety of fixes and improvements across different aspects of the game.

## Story Progression Fixes

- Resolved all known "Deathloops."
- Fixed blocks in several quests, including "Into The Dark," "Assassination," "Sophie in The Raid Quest," "Hubert in The Only Way Out," "Veronika," "Nightrunners," "The Lost Light," and "Double Time."
- Addressed issues with safe zones where the in-game clock would stop, and players couldn't sleep.

## Co-op Fixes

- Improved stability by fixing crashes and black screens in certain situations.
- Resolved numerous story progression blocks.
- Fixed issues with accepting invites.
- Addressed challenges issues, including no weapon availability when inventory is full, improved difficulty balance, and proper handling of tool requirements.
- Fixed co-op parties spawning in distant locations.
- Enhanced replication of city open-world activities, such as windmills, hanging cages, loot chests, and NPC rescue issues.
- Fixed instances of enemies and players falling through the ground.
- Resolved several performance drops.

## Nightrunner Tools Fixes

- Paraglider and Grappling Hook upgrades can now be correctly applied for players who obtained them during cooperative sessions.
- The PK Crossbow reward is now correctly given to players in cooperative mode, preventing new issues from arising.

## Important Combat Improvements

- Enhanced Biter behavior during the day, making enemies latch onto players more frequently, diversifying encounters.
- Improved the performance of blunt weapons to better reflect their weight.
- Enhanced enemy reactions based on weapon type to better reflect weapon weight.
- Human opponents can now block players' attacks during light hit reaction time.
- Shortened light hit reactions for human enemies.

## New Ragdoll Behaviors

- Opponents enter ragdoll state more frequently and naturally.
- Ragdoll behavior varies depending on the weapon type used.
- Appropriate forces are applied when falling from heights and when hitting different body parts, maintaining the force direction.
- Improved sound and visual effects when ragdolls collide with surroundings, based on the surface.
- Enhanced spikes detection, ensuring enemies are always impaled on spikes after a hit, with improved audio feedback and new effects.

## Night Improvements and Balance

- Increased Howler senses range and resistance to ranged weapons.
- A chase is triggered when a Howler is hit by a ranged weapon and survives.
- Volatiles emerge from hiding spots faster during chases.
- Level 4 chases are now more challenging.

## UI/UX Improvements

- Survivor Sense now functions correctly without cooldowns after hits or parkour actions.
- Enhanced Options Menu with a dedicated Accessibility Tab.
- Added features to show, hide, or dynamically display the Player Health Bar, Item Selector, and Time of Day Indicator.
- Dynamic settings for Player Health Bar, Item Selector, and Time of Day Indicator are now default, adjusting visibility based on context.
- Extended HUD makes hidden or dynamic widgets visible.
- Visual improvements to Player HP and Stamina bars, making them lighter with more neutral colors.
- Enhanced visual indication of enemies' stance meter in relation to blunt weapons.

## Improvements to the Final Boss Fight

- Fixed issues where the opponent did not react correctly to other players, causing glitches during co-op play.
- Introduced alternate opponent behaviors in Phase 2 during co-op play.
- Opponent performs area attacks more frequently in co-op sessions.
- Shortened narrative scenes between boss fight phases.
- Improved boss fight pacing.

## Outro Improvements

- Enhanced game ending sequences with additional scenes to better align gameplay and outro.

## Balance Tweaks

- Higher Rank Bows are now more accessible at Merchants and in the world.
- Banshees and Chargers are more easily spotted in Infected hordes at night.

## Technical Improvements

- Introduced a high-performance preset to optimize graphics for older computers and laptops.
- Improved PC DX12 cache, resulting in smoother gameplay upon first launch.
- Removed AVX technology, resolving game launch crashes.
- Enhanced outdoor lighting, sun shadows, spotlight shadows, and Motion Blur customization.

## Brutality Pack

- Improved precision of sharp weapon hits, allowing players to dismember opponents more easily.
- Reworked audio for enemy hit responses, with different sounds based on hit strength and damage.
- Blood splats appear on the ground when hitting opponents.
- Blood splashes on the screen if the player is close to the enemy during attacks.
- Enhanced blood effects on enemy bodies after hits.
- Dead enemies now interactively react to blows and injuries.
- Added new blood effects on enemies' bodies after hits.

contents:

**Quest Description:**
"Some punk challenged me to a race. He seemed cocky, so I decided to knock him down a peg or two."

**Double Time** is a Side Quest in Dying Light 2 Stay Human.

## Objectives

## Walkthrough

On a rooftop in northern Houndfield, southwest of the Saint Joseph Hospital, a man can be heard provoking Aiden by calling him a slowpoke. Upon approach, he challenges Aiden to a bet for 200 Old World Money for a race.

The race goes through a GRE Dark Hollow and ends on its roof. There are arrows inside the Dark Zone showing which way to go. Upon reaching the roof, Aiden appears to have lost. His opponent says that if Aiden wants to do a new race, he needs to come to the roof of the building across from the old Military Base on Mill Street.

The second race is started in southern Houndfield, just north of GRE Anomaly C-A-22. Upon arrival, the challenger provokes Aiden a bit and proposes to increase the bet, another 200 Old World Money.

The second race goes through another Dark Hollow, again, going from the ground up to its roof. Upon reaching the roof, the challenger can be heard screaming for help as he is being attacked by the infected. Slay the infected and check in on him.

Upon reaching him, his twin also appears on the roof. Babin and Babel had set up Aiden in a ruse in an attempt to get money off of him. They explain that they only do the scams because they got into some serious debts trying to do legitimate work. You get three options:

- **Option 1:** If you tell them that they can keep the money, they will express gratitude and the quest is completed with only a Parkour XP reward.
- **Option 2:** If you tell them that you accept, they will give back the wager and the quest is completed with a Parkour XP reward as well.
- **Option 3:** If you tell them that you demand more, they will give back the wager alongside another 150 Old World Money, as well as the Parkour XP reward.

**Categories:** Dying Light 2 Stay Human, Accessories, Dying Light 2 Equipment

**Description:**
"Throw to create a flaming pool that deals damage to anyone caught within it."

Molotov is a throwable accessory and a blueprint in Dying Light 2 Stay Human.

## Usage

Molotovs are used to ignite targets, set pools of oil on fire, or trigger explosions from gas canisters. They are effective in combat as they can stun Biters and human enemies with flame damage. Molotovs are considered safer than DIY Grenades and mines because they deal pure Fire damage, which can be mitigated using the Fire Resistance booster to reduce self-inflicted damage.

contents:

**Gerhardt** is a Peacekeeper who appears in Dying Light 2 Stay Human. He is involved in a mission where players are tasked with delivering letters to wounded men under his command.

## Interactions

### Wounded in Action Challenge

In this challenge, players must deliver letters to the wounded men under Gerhardt's command. These letters are from relatives and loved ones, providing emotional support to the injured.

## Conversations

During the "Wounded in Action Challenge," the following conversation takes place between Aiden and Gerhardt:

- **Aiden:** "You need a doctor."
- **Gerhardt:** "I'll be fine. I used to be a surgeon. I've set my broken leg... just can't get up. Will you save my men?"
- **Aiden:** "How do I save them?"
- **Gerhardt:** "There are many injured. They fell into dark zones and barely managed to get out. I know where. But I can't bring them what's most important. Will you go?"
- **Aiden:** "What's 'most important'?"
- **Gerhardt:** "Painkillers and..."
- **Aiden:** "And what? If you don't tell me, I can't help."
- **Gerhardt:** "And letters. I am the one who passes out the letters. But I don't do this the moment I get them. I wait for the right moment. They're letters from relatives. From mothers. Girlfriends or boyfriends. I even have two letters from someone's grandparents!"
- **Aiden:** "I see. I assume they were already given meds?"
- **Gerhardt:** "Sometimes a letter is all it takes to keep a man alive. People need something to fight for."
- **Aiden:** "And how do I find them?"
- **Gerhardt:** "You have to deliver the letters in order. Just like I arranged them in the box. Nobody wants to be given the wrong letter at the wrong time... like someone else's love letter going to a guy whose poor girlfriend got torn up by the infected last week... or a letter from a mother, going to a guy whose family is all dead... you get the responsibility here, don't you?"
- **Aiden:** "I do. I won't confuse the order."
- **Gerhardt:** "Leave them in the designated mailboxes as you go. People'll pick them up later."
- **Aiden:** "Okay."
- **Gerhardt:** "Great. Now pick up the letters and get going. Quick!"

After completing the challenge:

- **Aiden:** "I'm back."
- **Gerhardt:** "Did you know everyone made it back to the ward? And they cried like babies. Because of these letters. Thanks a lot, kid."
- **Aiden:** "Awesome."
- **Gerhardt:** "But now, there are more injured... in another area!"

This interaction highlights the importance of emotional support and the role of Gerhardt in maintaining morale among his men.

**Karsten:** "Mom, come home. I'm so worried about you."

**Brigitte:** "Is that stray you took in still there?"

**Karsten:** "Please don't talk like that about my future wife. Her name is Sylvia."

**Brigitte:** "You've known her for a week and you're calling her your 'wife'? What do you even know about her?"

**Karsten:** "I love her."

**Brigitte:** "More than your own mother? I must have been a terrible mother. You see? This nice young man promised to get me a container where I can live out my days alone."

**Karsten:** "But Mom..."

**Brigitte:** "Quiet! Now. How did it go... my hero?"

**Aiden:** "You can move in."

**Brigitte:** "Here, is your well-earned payment. I could have left it to my son, but he deserves nothing!"

**Karsten:** "Please talk some sense to her, because I don't have the strength anymore."

**Aiden:** "(Mother comes first.) Mother comes first."

**Karsten:** "You don't know what you're talking about."

**Brigitte:** "But he's right! Who loves you more than anyone in the world? And who will always take care of you?"

**Karsten:** "Fine. I'll pack Sylvia's things and tell her to leave."

**Brigitte:** "Finally. Well, it's about time you came around. Thank you. I have no idea what I would do if it weren't for your help."

**Aiden:** "(Children have to go their own way someday.) Children have to go their own way someday."

**Karsten:** "Did you hear, mom? If you want to leave because of Sylvia, then... I won't be stopping you."

**Brigitte:** "And you had such a kind look in your eyes..."

**Aiden:** "Will she be all right?"

**Karsten:** "I'll look after her somehow. After all, she's my mother. Thanks for helping her."

**Aiden:** "Don't mention it. Good luck on your new path in life."

The Survivors are a Faction featured in Dying Light 2 Stay Human.

## Overview

The Survivors are one of the three main Factions in Villedor. They pride themselves on being able to adapt to any situation and seek peace in the new world. The group is heavily pacifist and commonly engages in renewable activities such as farming.

The Survivors originated during The Fall and the Black Monday bombings, where surviving civilians in the city joined together to survive the apocalypse and defend themselves from the infected. Seeking a free, healthy, and peaceful future, this semi-organized coalition quickly arose to build a new civilization atop the ashes of the old one. While working with the Nightrunners, the Survivors gradually gained influence in the city through the growth of their population and infrastructure.

The Survivors are mainly focused in Trinity and New Dawn Park, although the player can grant them territorial expansions in Houndfield, Horseshoe, Downtown, Garrison, Muddy Grounds, Saint Paul Island, and the Lower Dam Ayre.

The Bazaar serves as the Survivors' center of gathering in Old Villedor, while the Fish Eye Canteen is an equivalent for the Central Loop. Smaller establishments can be encountered in Survivor territory, including schools, artist houses, bakeries, farms, and trading posts.

## Characteristics

Architecture used by the Survivors is bright, colorful, and agrarian. Spaces are built around the community and emphasize living peacefully without a strict government or hierarchy. Their ethos is often described as anarchist or communal in nature, built around a shared sense of community and mutual trust. Survivor living spaces are characterized by horticulture and craftsmanship, with small garden plots and wooden structures being particularly common.

In terms of appearance, the Survivors frequently feature makeshift garb and weaponry. Most Survivors can be found wearing worn-out pants, jackets, old tuques, sweaters, and running shoes. Unlike the Renegades and Peacekeepers, two Factions that are customarily in uniform, the Survivors are heavily varied physically. They are typically armed with improvised weapons like pipes, machetes, and broken tools.

The Survivors will avoid conflict against human enemies like Renegades, only resorting to violence when no other option is available. When attacked by the player, Survivors will often flee or surrender instead of engaging in combat. However, when encountering infected, Survivors will almost always go on the offensive. Survivors also partake in unique activities within their territory, such as funerals, plays, and book-readings.

## Known Members

### Notable Characters

- Carl (Former Bazaar Leader)
- Sophie (Bazaar Leader)
- Frank Marwey (Fish Eye Canteen Leader)
- Barney (Sophie's Brother)
- Alberto (Craftmaster, Deceased)
- Vincenzo (Craftmaster)

### Other Characters

- Hermann (Sophie's Bodyguard)
- Ahab
- Carlos (Craftmaster Apprentice)
- Ed
- Julian
- Lena
- Urban
- Damien
- Cillian

## Conversations

**Teresa:** "I've never felt so betrayed. How could you, Anna?! Got nothing to say? Where's my flour, thief?"

**Anna:** "But... it's you who owes me, Teresa! Months of wages!"

**Survivor:** "That's it. Last chance to move your asses outta here. With my boot!"

**Teresa:** "You bitch!"

**Survivor:** "Break it up!"

(After the conversation)

**Survivor:** "Normally I like a cat fight, but bloody hell! Can you believe just yesterday, those two were best friends?"

**Aiden:** "What happened?"

**Survivor:** "Last night, someone stole Teresa's flour. All of it. A major harvest, too. She coulda made a killing. Without it, she's got nuthin'. No flour. No sales. No money. She 'n her son won't last another month without the income."

**Aiden:** "(Why is she blaming her best friend?) She must be desperate to blame her best friend."

**Survivor:** "Ex-best friend. But it's just an accusation. It's not like she's got any evidence. She's a bit hot-headed, that's for sure. But you'd have to ask her yourself."

**Aiden:** "(Seems like Teresa needs some help) Do you think she needs help?"

**Survivor:** "Teresa? Why? Looking to earn some cash?"

**Aiden:** "That's not why I--"

**Survivor:** "You're a pilgrim, aren't you? You guys don't do anything for free. How much they fork over for the water? She'll be near her shop."

**Aiden:** "Thanks for the tip."

## Notes

- The Bazaar, a main Survivor establishment, will end up completely abandoned if the player aligns themselves with the Peacekeepers in the story. However, Trinity will still remain a Survivor territory.
- The Survivors are not necessarily a fully connected or centralized group. Instead, the Faction's namesake typically refers to a loosely-related group of civilians that have aligned themselves together to succeed in the new world. Some Survivors are not found in the Bazaar or Fish Eye Canteen, alternatively residing in local apartments and homes.
- The Survivors aren't to be confused with random, unassimilated survivors of the apocalypse. Many characters the player can encounter are survivors themselves, but are not aligned or associated with the actual group.
- Contrary to the Peacekeepers and particularly the Renegades, the Survivors lack special types of units. This was likely done to further demonstrate that the Survivors tend to avoid fighting altogether.

## Walkthrough

Aiden wakes up on a roof surrounded by infected corpses for unknown reasons. He decides to meet Major Jack Matt, who suggested they meet in person. Upon visiting the Peacekeepers' cargo ship, Missy - The Floating Fortress, Aiden is greeted by Lieutenant Meyer, who informs him that Major Jack Matt is waiting in his office. Jack agrees to help Aiden search for his sister Mia, but in return, Aiden must assist in the Peacekeepers' mission to capture the antenna on the tallest building in Villedor, the VNC Tower. Aiden's first task is to find Juan Rainer, the leader of Supplier, and inquire about the UV lamp order. Aiden heads to Fish Eye to confront him.

Juan, who boldly stands against Jack, is difficult to persuade unless Aiden proves his worth. Lawan mentions a rumor about a famous art collector who lived in Central Loop and fled before The Fall, leaving behind potentially valuable paintings. Aiden searches for something to attract Juan's passion for antiques. Although the paintings are gone, Aiden finds wine that piques Juan's interest, leading him to discuss the main subject.

Juan suggests that Jack Matt's excessive UV lamp order is suspicious and hints at questionable actions. He accepts the Peacekeepers' order but also encourages Aiden to spy on Jack to uncover his true intentions. Aiden must choose whether to remain loyal to Jack Matt or side with Juan and spy on him, leading to different outcomes.

**Jack Matt** is a major character and the true secondary antagonist in *Dying Light 2 Stay Human*.

## Biography

Jack Matt was in the Army and later became the leader of the **Peacekeepers**. His pride leads him to believe that only he can bring peace and order to **Villedor**.

### Life in the Army

Jack Matt held the rank of Major in the military forces of Villedor. On December 16th, 2024, Captain Posner began an investigation into Jack Matt for Colonel Williams. Jack had a group of loyal soldiers and was perceived by Posner as someone who relished power and constantly sought more. Jack Matt was known for running a tight ship, being both an efficient commander and highly respected. When he heard about the potential THV GenMod bombardment, he was agitated, not believing it was the last chance to save the city. Jack Matt also held a strong grudge against Colonel Chris Williams, believing the Colonel had hindered his career.

Following the Black Monday bombings, which resulted in thousands of deaths and caused the infected to mutate, Captain Posner and his troops returned to a military outpost to resupply. They found the ammunition racks destroyed and were confronted by a furious Jack Matt and a few of his soldiers, as the rest had perished in the bombings. Jack Matt claimed he received no warnings from Colonel Williams, which led to the troops not being evacuated.

Between January 6th and February 10th, 2025, Jack Matt organized a rebellion against the military. By February 10th, the rebellion gained momentum, with many soldiers deserting the military to join Jack Matt. The soldiers believed Colonel Williams intentionally withheld evacuation orders, abandoning them to die. Captain Posner's investigations suggested that Jack Matt did receive the order but ignored it. Regardless, the military's belief was shared by the citizens of Villedor, who despised the army. The civilians, led by Juan Rainer and his Revolutionary Committee, also attacked the military. Sharing a common enemy, Juan Rainer and Jack Matt joined forces, with Old Villedor as the primary battleground.

### Founding of the Peacekeepers

By May 7th, 2025, Jack Matt's rebels began calling themselves the Peacekeepers, establishing their headquarters on a container ship in the Central Loop. Matt created his own hierarchy and ranks, insisting his followers pledge allegiance solely to him. Captain Posner believed Major Matt was obsessed with killing Colonel Williams to conceal the truth about himself. Jack Matt often recruited individuals with unique skills, such as Manfred, who accidentally contacted Jack Matt while attempting to hack a Chinese satellite, and Aiden, whom he wanted as his successor.

## Interactions

### Satellite Dream

Manfred attempts to contact Asia but accidentally reaches Jack Matt instead.

## Conversations

**Aiden:** "Okay, it's on. I'm calling from Villedor... in Europe... Until now, we thought... that we were the last surviving city in the world... We have some medicine and supplies... What's it like there in Asia... over? Can anyone hear me? Over."

**Manfred:** "Can anybody hear us?!! Over! We're losing the signal, Aiden! We have to hurry!"

**Aiden:** "Villedor here... pick up!"

**Jack Matt:** "He... Who... Er?!"

**Manfred:** "Keep trying, Aiden... we're losing them! Europe to Asia!!"

**Jack Matt:** "Aa... Wha... Fu..."

**Aiden:** "EUROPE TO ASIA! EUROPE TO ASIA!"

**Manfred:** "It worked! Aiden, you hear that? It's them!"

**Jack Matt:** "Aa... Fu... What the fuck, Aiden? What crazy shit are you up to now?"

**Aiden:** "I know that voice..."

**Jack Matt:** "This is Jack. How the hell did you hack into an encrypted channel?"

**Manfred:** "The PK commander? I'm dead. I'm SO dead..."

**Jack Matt:** "I don't know how you did it, but..."

**Aiden:** "Jack... this guy here... Manfred... thought he was hacking an old Chinese satellite."

**Jack Matt:** "Is that so?! I could use a man with his skills. Tell this Manfred to come meet me at the ship."

**Manfred:** "What..? Me? Th-thank you, I..."

**Jack Matt:** "And no more hacking... unless it's on MY ORDERS!!"

**Aiden:** "Well, Manfred, looks like you got yourself a new job."

**Manfred:** "Yes! And I'll have access to better equipment with the PK too! I'll be able to contact Asia now, for sure... Thank you! Help yourselves to the valuables I've stored under the tower."

**Categories:** Dying Light 2 Stay Human

The Revolution was a significant event during the THV pandemic in Villedor that occurred after Black Monday.

## Overview

Colonel Chris Williams's bombing of the city plunged Villedor into chaos. Jack Matt formed the Peacekeepers and led them into battle with the help of the Nightrunner commander, Frank Marwey, and the plutocrat, Juan Rainer. The war was brutal, resulting in many civilian casualties under the Colonel's orders. With the military leader of Villedor, General Pratt, proving incompetent, Williams ended the war by leading his remaining loyal soldiers to the dam, where he established his base. Matt was unable to defeat Williams, as the Colonel now had the capability to destroy most of the city with toxic water.

### Consequences of the Revolution

Major Matt became known as the benevolent leader of the Peacekeepers, who considered themselves the true rulers of the city. Juan formed the Suppliers and gained enough authority to challenge Matt and his Peacekeepers by controlling their supply chain. The Colonel formed the marauding Renegades, effectively driving his people and the Peacekeepers into a tense truce, with only occasional skirmishes between the two.

title: 16638_Peacekeeper Rewards
contents:
# Peacekeeper Rewards in Dying Light 2 Stay Human

Peacekeeper Rewards are incentives provided by the Peacekeepers for assigning city districts in Villedor to their control. There are seven distinct rewards, each with a unique function and benefit. Below is a detailed description of each reward.

## Rewards

### Car Traps

Car Traps are vehicles modified to serve as explosive traps. When activated, they emit a honking sound to attract nearby infected before detonating.

**Description**: When triggered, Car Traps lure infected and then explode, effectively eliminating large groups.

### PK Razor Cannon

The PK Razor Cannon is a mounted weapon typically found on the backs of low trucks. It is designed for high damage output but cannot rotate fully, leaving the rear vulnerable.

**Description**: Fast-shooting Razor Cannons excel at decimating packs of incoming Virals.

### Electrical Traps

Electrical Traps are designed to electrocute enemies standing within them. The electrical shock can transfer to nearby enemies, blocking passage through the area.

**Description**: Electrical Traps electrocute enemies caught in them, obstructing movement through the surrounding area.

### Crossbow Pack

The Crossbow Pack provides access to the PK Crossbow, a semi-automatic crossbow, along with blueprints for crafting bolts.

**Description**: Obtain a semi-automatic Crossbow and a set of blueprints for unique Elemental Bolts.

### Molotov Lanterns

Molotov Lanterns are spherical lanterns that can be shot down with a projectile. They ignite a large fire upon falling due to the flammable source beneath them.

**Description**: When struck with a projectile, Molotov Lanterns fall and ignite a large area around them.

### Pendulum Traps

Pendulum Traps are large, spiked devices that attract and damage infected as they pass through.

**Description**: Massive Pendulum Traps can mow down entire groups of enemies beneath them.

### UV Trap

UV Traps are UV lights placed on ramps, used to stun nearby infected and provide an opportunity to escape. At night, they also help restore some immunity.

**Description**: UV Traps are beneficial during chases, serving as both a trap for infected and an additional source of UV Light.

**Wash:** "Chloe, wait, please! I had no choice..."

**Aiden:** "You did what you had to."

**Wash:** "I'm a murderer... I only wanted to help Chloe... I betrayed my unit for her..."

**Aiden:** "Sorry."

### The Runaways

**Wash:** "Thanks. My name's Wash."

**Aiden:** "Aiden."

**Wash:** "How noble of you, saving an enemy."

**Aiden:** "You're not my enemy."

**Aiden:** "What're you doing here?"

**Wash:** "I'm afraid that's top secret."

**Aiden:** "So you're a spy. Should I warn the locals about you?"

**Wash:** "Alright, I'll tell you. It's a secret, just not a military secret. I was supposed to meet a girl here. From the Bazaar."

**Aiden:** "Don't see anyone here. Looks like she stood you up."

**Wash:** "This wasn't a date. We wanted to leave the city. Get beyond the walls."

**Aiden:** "It's not that easy."

**Wash:** "We would find a way."

**Aiden:** "Why do you want to leave?"

**Wash:** "Chloe's had enough of there being shortages of everything at the Bazaar, especially water."

**Aiden:** "But the Bazaar has water now."

**Wash:** "Chloe doesn't know that yet. She lives outside the Bazaar."

**Aiden:** "Then just go to her and check."

**Wash:** "I will. And... can I ask you a favor? To save time. I'll go to Chloe's place. Can you go to her friend Liz's? Chloe's always over there. She lives at twenty-five, Wuthering Mews. Third floor. Above the old vegetarian restaurant. It's near the clinic."

**Aiden:** "I'll see what I can do."

**Wash:** "Thanks. Let me know over the radio when you get there."

**Survivor:** "What for?! She's not here."

**Aiden:** "Wash? Chloe's not here."

**Wash:** "She's not at home either... Aiden - she must be at Liz's. Don't know where else she could be?"

**Aiden:** "Going somewhere?"

**Survivor:** "None of your business."

**Aiden:** "I'll wait for her here. Hope you don't mind?"

**Survivor:** "I do."

**Survivor:** "Chloe's gone. Like, 'gone' gone. Got it? Tell Wash to just forget about her. Chloe's left without him."

**Aiden:** "Left? Or about to leave... with you, I gather?"

**Survivor:** "Maybe."

**Survivor:** "Yesterday, they were fighting over water. Tomorrow, it'll be another thing. Blood's always flowing here. We've had enough. We want to try somewhere else."

**Aiden:** "We... that is, you and Chloe... so what about Wash?"

**Newspaper Article – November 11th, 2024** is one of the mementos found in Dying Light 2. It is part of the Artifact Collectable set.

## Text

**THE MAN WE NEED**

For some time, Villedor has been the calm eye of the storm during the THV Pandemic. However, this calm has been shattered. Tensions rose as the rapid influx of refugees quickly overwhelmed the city, its inhabitants, and its resources.

On June 24th, the first THV outbreak occurred. Following this, the Council of Mankind was disbanded, and the military, led by General Pratt, took control of all GRE resources and facilities. Unfortunately, Pratt was ill-suited for his role, and soon the city was overrun by the infected.

This situation led to a mutiny within the military, after which Colonel Williams assumed command of all armed forces. By all accounts, Williams possesses an iron will and does not shy away from making difficult decisions.

title: 14672_Henkel
contents:
# Characters in Dying Light 2 Stay Human

**Henkel** is a survivor who appears in *Dying Light 2 Stay Human*. He serves as a teacher at a rooftop school in Trinity.

## Interactions

### The History Lesson

Learn about the March Massacre and light a candle to honor those who died protesting the confiscation of guns.

## Conversations

**The History Lesson**

- **Aiden**: "What's going on here?"

- **Henkel**: "Hello. I'm Henkel. This student here was curious about my lesson today, about when the guns were confiscated in Villedor and what happened afterwards. He wants to light a candle on the site of the March Massacre."

- **Aiden**: "(The March Massacre?) The March Massacre?"

- **Henkel**: "Yes. 64 people died that day. Gunned down like sitting ducks. If you want to know more, you should go and see for yourself."

- **Aiden**: "(Why can't he?) Why can't he?"

- **Henkel**: "No one can leave the building while school is in session, children shouldn't walk around the Bazaar on their own."

- **Aiden**: "Hm... I thought you'd be more worried about them falling into a dark zone..."

- **Henkel**: "Oh, kids nowadays are too smart to fall into a silly hole. Anyway, could you light a candle for him, young man? You might learn something yourself."

- **Aiden**: "Sure. Though I was pretty lousy at history."

- **Henkel**: "History is boring when someone tells you about it. It starts being fascinating when you can touch it."

- **Aiden**: "Touch it?"

- **Henkel**: "Yes. Take this candle and go to the monument of the World Art Congress. Or... what's left of it. It's close by. Contact me when you get there. You'll see what my lesson was about today."

(At the monument)

- **Aiden**: "Hey, Henkel? I'm at the monument. You were right. Not much left of it."

- **Henkel**: "Good. Look closely. There is much more to it than meets the eye."

(Upon investigating the plaque)

- **Aiden**: "What happened here?"

- **Henkel**: "That is where the riots started. People were terrified. How could they protect themselves and their families? There was massive unrest. So, a curfew was put in place. And homes were raided to ensure no one was hiding any weapons. Punishment for those who didn't comply was quite severe."

(Upon investigating the list of names)

- **Aiden**: "There's a plaque here... a lot of names on it. Are those the victims of the Massacre?"

- **Henkel**: "Yes, 64 names... Things were starting to get pretty bad outside the walls around then, and the army needed more weapons. So, they confiscated the civilians' weapons. Private ownership of any sort of firearm and its ammunition was forbidden thereafter."

(Upon investigating the bullet holes)

- **Aiden**: "Shots were fired."

- **Henkel**: "The army started shooting at people. Panic broke out. And, of course, things only got worse. The riots escalated. It was the beginning of the end. Light the candle."

(Upon placing the candle)

- **Aiden**: "So you're saying that Pratt made a bad call, taking people's guns away?"

- **Henkel**: "Hard to know for sure, but it didn't end well for anyone. In fact, the main irony is that the army soon ran out of ammunition. And just like that, firearms became obsolete. At least, that's what's generally believed to have happened. Now, you'll hear some folks claim that Pratt kept a secret stash of ammunition somewhere in the city. But if so, he took that secret to the grave... so I guess we'll never really know. And that's the thing about history: we rarely ever really know. It's not a hard science. History is fragile as the passing of time. It takes the vigilance of people like myself to make sure it's not rewritten to suit the whim of each new generation's self-righteous fight. The duty of remembrance. Everyone should practice it. Farewell now, Pilgrim. I hope this little trip down memory lane has illuminated your path."
